Ka igkarangeb ne baseen meyitenged te me

The second document about

Hari

Kings

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka Igkarangeb ne Hari sumpul te guhuren meyitenged te daruwa ne migharian te me Israilita ne ware neimpusi diye te Hun-a ne Hari. Ka seini ne Libru nabaad te daruwa: 1/ Ka guhuren meyitenged te daruwa ne migharian puun te egliwaraanan ka igkasiyam ne siglu te ware pad neetew si Hisus taman te natalu e ka Samarya, wey nataman seini te neimpus e ka migharian diye te igkahibang ne balabahan te leg-un ne 722 te ware pad neetew si Kristu. 2/ Ka guhuren meyitenged te migharian te Huda puun te pegkatalu te migharian te Israil taman te pegkalundus wey te pegkahuhus te Hirusalim pinaahi ki Hari Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya te leg-un 586 te ware pad neetew si Kristu. Diye neimpusi ka guhuren te neyimu e ne gubirnadur si Gidalya diye te Huda diralem te pegmandu te Babilunya, wey te impaligwe e si Hari Hihuwakin ne naprisu diye te Babilunya.

The Second King is the continuation of the story about the two kingdom of Israilitas which wasn't finish in the First King. This document is divided into two: 1/ The story about the two kingdom from the middle of the ninth century before Christ was_born until the Samarya was defeated, and it ends when the kingdom there in the north(LIT left side) was finished in the year 722 before Christ was_born. 2/ The story about the kingdom of Huda from the (time when) kingdom of Israil was defeated until the collapse and destruction of Hirusalim by_means_of Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya in the year 586 before Hisus was_born. The story ends when Gidalya became a governor there in Huda under the ruling of Babilunya, and when King Hihuwakin was released who was imprisoned there in Babilunya.

Ka seini ne me karereetan, neyitabu diye te nasud te Israil puun su ware migtuman ka me Hari wey ka me keet-etawan te Huda te Manama. Ka pegkahuhus te Hirusalim wey ka pegkasakup te me keet-etawan te Huda iyan in-isip ne pinakarakel ne neyitabu te guhuren te Israil.

That destruction, happened in the nation of Israil because the kings and the people of Huda did not obey God (MS Manama). The destruction of Hirusalim and the capturing of the people of Huda is the one considered as big event in the history of Israil.

Si Prupita Ilisyu ka amana ne neila kayi te Igkarangeb ne Hari. Si Ilisyu ka migsubal ki prupita Ilyas.

Prophet Ilisyu was the (one who) was well known in the second King. Ilisyu was the one replaced by Ilyas.

Ka peglegpad te Manama ki Hari Ahasiyas

The punishing of God against King Ahasiyas

11 Te migpatey e si Hari Ahab, migribildi e te Israil ka me matig-Muwab, te timpu ne iyan e Hari si Ahasiyas ne anak ni Ahab.

11 When King Ahab died, the (ones) from_Muwab rebelled against Israil, in the time that King Ahasiyas the child of Ahab was_kinging.

2 Sabeka ne aldew, neulug si Ahasiyas te bintana te sinabeng din ne diye te dibabew te palasyu ne diye te Samarya, wey egpekeyibat-hibat naan de sikandin diye te hibatanan tenged su nalepuan sikandin. Ne migsuhu sikandin te me suluhuanen eyew egpeinseen ki Baal-Sibub ne manama te Ikrun, ke egkeulian naan pad sikandin. 3 Piru ingkahiyan te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama si prupita Ilyas ne matig-Tisbi, “Hipanew ka wey sinug-unga nu ka insuhu ne me suluhuanen te Hari te Samarya wey kahii nu, ‘Mania te diye kew egpanginginse ki Baal-Sibub ne manama te Ikrun? Ware bes Manama te Israil?’ 4 Purisu kahii niyu ka Hari te migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama diye te kandin,“Kene kad e egpekeenew te hibatanan nu. Egpatey kad en iya!’ ”

2 One day, Ahasiyas fell from the window of his room there at the top of the palace that was there in Samarya, and he just lying down there to bed because he got_broken_bones. And he commanded servants in_order to question Baal Sibub the god of Ikrun, if he would_recover still. 3 But Ilyas from_Tisbi was_spoken_to by the angel of the Lord God, “Go to meet(sg) the servants that commanded by the king of Samarya and say(sg), ‘Why are you(pl) asking there from Baal Sibub the god of Ikrun? Is there no God of Israil?’ 4 Therefore tell(pl) the king that the Lord says to him, “You(sg) won't be_able_to_rise from your(sg) lying_place. You(sg) will_ indeed _die!’ ”

Ne miggipanew e si Ilyas.5 Te peglibed e te me suluhuanen ne insuhu te Hari, mig-insaan e sikandan te Hari te migkahi, “Mania te migmanlibed kew?”

So Ilyas left.5 At the returning of the servants that commanded by the king, they were questioned by the king saying, “Why have_ you(pl) _returned?”

6 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Due etew ne migsinug-ung kanami ne migkahi te egpaliberen key e wey egpakahiyan ka Hari ne migsuhu kanami te seini ka inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Mania te migsuhu ka te me suluhuanen nu te pegpanginginse te manama te Ikrun ne si Baal-Sibub? Ware bes Manama te Israil? Tenged te seini ne hinimuwan nu, kene kad e egpekeenew te hibatanan nu. Egpatey kad en iya!’ ”

6 They answered, “There_was a person that met us(excl) that said we(excl) were_being_returned and told_to_tell the king that commanded us(excl) that this is what_ the Lord God _said, ‘Why did_ you(sg) _command your(sg) servants to question the god of Ikrun that's Baal-Sibub? Is there no God in Israil? Due to your(sg) doing this, you(sg) won't be_able_to_rise from your(sg) lying_place. You(sg) will_ indeed _die!’ ”

7 Ne mig-inse ka Hari kandan, “Mamenua ka ulaula te etew ne migsinug-ung kaniyu wey miglalag kaniyu kayi?”

7 And the king asked them, “Like_what was the face of the person who met you(pl) and informed you(pl) this?”

8 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Bulbulen sikandin wey migsisinturun te laplap te ayam.” Migkahi ka Hari, “Si Ilyas iya seeye ne matig-Tisbi.”

8 And they answered, “He was hairy and belted with skin of domestic_animal(s).” The king said, “That (was) indeed Ilyas from_Tisbi.”

9 Ne dutu, insuhu te Hari ka kepitan te me sundalu rin duma te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me sundalu eyew egpaangayen ki Ilyas. Ne diye nasapeni te kepitan si Ilyas te puntul te bubungan ka migpinpinnuu. Ne migkahiyan din sikandin, “Prupita te Manama, migkahi ka Hari te egpeendiyeen ka nikandin.”

9 And then, the king commanded the captain of his soldiers along_with fifty (50) soldiers to fetch Ilyas. And the captain caught Ilyas on the tip of a mountain sitting_down. And he told him, “Prophet of God, the king said that you(sg) are_to_go_there to_him.”

10 Piru migtabak si Ilyas te kepitan, “Ke prupita a te Manama, due perem hapuy ne egpuun te langit eyew egtutung keykew wey te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me sundalu nu!” Te sikan de, miggingume e ka hapuy puun te langit ne migtutung te kepitan wey te me sundalu rin.

10 But Ilyas answered the captain, “If I'm a prophet of God, then [hopefully] fire from the sky/heaven will_come in_order to_burn you(sg) and your(sg) fifty (50) soldiers!” Just then, fire arrived from heaven that burned the captain and his soldiers.

11 Ne migsuhu e man-e ka Hari te lein ne kepitan din duma te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me sundalu. Migtakereg ka kepitan wey ingkahiyan din e man-e si Ilyas, “Prupita te Manama, migkahi ka Hari te egpeendiyeen ka nikandin kuntee egparagdahawa.”

11 And the king again sent his different captain along_with fifty (50) soldiers. The captain ascended and he told Ilyas again, “Prophet of God, the king said that you(sg) are_to_go_there to_him straight_away.”

12 Ne migtabak si Ilyas, “Ke prupita a te Manama, due perem hapuy ne egpuun te langit eyew egtutung keykew wey te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me sundalu nu.” Te sikan de, miggingume e ka hapuy puun te langit ne migtutung te kepitan wey te me sundalu rin.

12 And Ilyas answered, “If I'm a prophet of God, then [hopefully] fire from the sky/heaven will_come in_order to_burn you(sg) and your(sg) fifty (50) soldiers.” Just then, fire arrived from heaven that burned the captain and his soldiers.

13 Ne dutu, migpeuyan e man-e ka Hari te igkatelu ne kepitan din duma te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me sundalu. Ne migtakereg ka kepitan diye te bubungan. Te pegginguma rin diye te ki Ilyas, migpanimbuel e sikandin diye te tangkaan din wey migpeyid-u hid-u ne migkahi, “Prupita te Manama, ikeyid-u a ubag nikeykew wey seini se lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me suluhuanen nu. Kene key re ubag nikeykew himatayi. 14 Nakanengneng a ne seeye se daruwa ne me kepitan duma te me sundalu ran, natutung e te hapuy ne egpuun te langit. Ne kuntee, ikeyid-u a ubag nikeykew.”

13 And then, the king again sent his third captain along_with fifty (50) soldiers. And the captain ascended the mountain. Upon his arrival at Ilyas, he kneeled there in front of him and pleaded saying, “Prophet of God, [embarrassedly] have_mercy(sg) on me and these fifty (50) servants of yours(sg). Don't(sg) [embarrassedly] kill us(excl). 14 I know that those two captains along_with their soldiers, were_burned by fire from the sky/heaven. And now/today, have_mercy(sg) [embarrassedly] on me.”

15 Ne migkahiyan te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Ilyas, “Duma kad e kandin wey kene ka kaaldek.” Purisu migdume en iya si Ilyas te kepitan peendiye te Hari. 16 Te pegginguma ni Ilyas diye te Hari, migkahi e sikandin, “Seini ka inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Mania te migsuhu ka te me suluhuanen nu te pegpanginginse te manama te Ikrun ne si Baal-Sibub? Ware bes Manama te Israil ne egkeinsaan nu? Ne puun su inggimu nu seini, kene kad e egpekeenew te hibatanan nu. Egpatey kad en iya.’ ”

15 And the angel of the Lord God told Ilyas, “Accompany(sg) with him and don't(sg) be_afraid.” Therefore Ilyas indeed accompanied the captain going to the king. 16 Upon Ilyas' arrival there at the king, he said, “This (is) what_ the Lord God _said, ‘Why did you(sg) command your(sg) servants to question the god of Ikrun that's Baal-Sibub? Is there no God of Israil that you(sg) may_question? And because you(sg) did this, you(sg) won't be_able_to_rise from your(sg) lying_place. You(sg) will_ indeed _die.’ ”

17 Purisu migpatey iya ka Hari sumale te inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi ki prupita Ilyas. Na, puun su ware anak din, si Huram ne suled din ka neyimu ne Hari subal kandin. Igkarangeb ne leg-un seeye te peghari ni Hari Hihuram ne anak ni Hihusapat ne Hari te Huda. 18 Ka duma ne neneyitabu te peghari ni Ahasiyas, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil.

17 Therefore the king indeed die according to what_ the Lord God _said through the prophet Ilyas. So, because he had no child, Huram his sibling/cousin (was) the (one who) became king replacing him. That was the second year of the kinging of King Hihuram the child of Hihusapat the king of Huda. 18 The rest of the events/what had happened of Ahasya's kinging, were_written in the Written_document of the Stories of the kings of Israil.

Ka pegbatun ki Ilyas diye te langit

The ascension of Ilyas to the sky/heaven

21 Te mahaan e egbatuna si Ilyas te Magbebaye ne Manama peendiye te langit ne egpeunturen te balisusu, sasangan ne miggipanew ensi Ilyas ki Ilisyu puun te inged ne Gilgal. 2 Te sasangan e sikandan ka eggipanew, migkahiyan ni Ilyas si Ilisyu, “Kayi ke re, su egpeendiyeen a te Magbebaye ne Manama te Bitil.”

21 When Ilyas was almost taken_up by the Lord God to the sky/heaven riding a whirlwind, Ilyas currently traveling with Ilisyu from the place of Gilgal. 2 While they were_ still _traveling, Ilisyu was_told by Ilyas, “Just stay_here(sg), because I've been_sent by the Lord God to Bitil.”

Piru migtabak si Ilisyu ne migkahi, “Mengeyibet te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama wey keykew ahalen ku, kene ku iya sikeykew eg-engkeran.” Sikan naa ka migpatupang e sikandan peendiye te Bitil.

But Ilisyu answered saying, “Swearing by the strong/powerful Lord God and to you(sg) my master, I won't leave you(sg) indeed.” That's why they descended towards Bitil.

3 Ne diye te Bitil, due mig-ugpe ne punduk te me prupita ne miggendiye te ki Ilisyu wey mig-inse, “Nakataha ke naa te kuntee ne aldew, egkuen e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka ahalen nu?”

3 And there at Bitil, there_was a group of prophets that went to Ilisyu and asked, “Do you(sg) know that this day, your(sg) master will_be_taken_away by the Lord God?”

Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Uya nakataha a, piru kene ki re due egwangal-wangal.”

And Ilisyu answered, “Yes I know, but let's(incl) not make a commotion.”

4 Nataman, migkahiyan e man-e ni Ilyas si Ilisyu, “Kayi ke re, su egpeendiyeen a te Magbebaye ne Manama te Hiriku.”

4 Then, Ilisyu was_told again by Ilyas, “Just stay_here(sg), because I've been_sent by the Lord God to Hiriku.”

Piru migtabak si Ilisyu ne migkahi, “Mengeyibet te manekal ne Mabebaye ne Manama wey keykew ahalen ku, kene ku iya sikeykew eg-engkeran.” Sikan naa ka migpabulus e sikandan ka egpeendiye te Hiriku.

But Ilisyu answered saying, “Swearing by the strong/powerful Lord God and to you(sg) my master, I won't leave you(sg) indeed.” That's why they continued going to Hiriku.

5 Ne diye te Hiriku, due mig-ugpe ne punduk te me prupita ne miggendiye te ki Ilisyu wey mig-inse, “Nakataha ke naa te kuntee ne aldew, egkuen e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka ahalen nu?”

5 And there at Hiriku, there_was a group of prophets that went to Ilisyu and asked, “Do you(sg) know that this day, your(sg) master will_be_taken_away by the Lord God?”

Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Uya, nakataha a, piru kene ki re due egwangal-wangal.”

And Ilisyu answered, “Yes, I know, but let's(incl) not make a commotion.”

6 Nataman migkahiyan e man-e sikandin ni Ilyas, “Kayi ke re, su egpeendiyeen a te Magbebaye ne Manama te Weyig ne Hurdan.”

6 Then he was_told again by Ilyas, “Just stay_here(sg), because I've been_sent by the Lord God to the River Hurdan.”

Piru migtabak sikandin, “Mengeyibet te manekal ne Mabebaye ne Manama wey keykew ahalen ku, kene ku iya sikeykew eg-engkeran.” Sikan naa ka miggendiyad e sikandan se daruwa.7 Ne due lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me prupita ne migduma kandan. Ne diye de sikandan migmanasindeg te madmariyu ka egpipitew engki Ilyas wey Ilisyu te migsanggel diye te ilis te Weyig ne Hurdan. 8 Ne inluung ni Ilyas ka ingkukuyumbu din ne hinabel, wey inlulun din seini wey miglapas sikandin te weyig. Ne nabaad e ka weyig te daruwa, wey miglapas e sikandan diye te elat te nabaad ne weyig diye te nammara ne tane. 9 Te nakalapas e sikandan, mig-insaan ni Ilyas si Ilisyu, “Kahii a ke nekey-a ka igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen ku keykew te kene e pad egbatunen?”

But he answered, “Swearing by the strong/powerful Lord God and to you(sg) my master, I won't leave you(sg) indeed.” That's why the two of them went_there.7 And there were fifty (50) prophets also accompanied them. And they just stood there at_some_distance watching Ilyas and Ilisyu stopped at the edge of the River Hurdan. 8 And Ilyas took_off the woven_cloth from_his_shoulders, and he rolled_ it _up and he struck the river/water. And the river/water was_divided into two, and they crossed in the middle of the water that has been_divided there on dry ground. 9 When they had_crossed, Ilisyu was_asked by Ilyas, “Tell me what you(sg) desire that I do for you(sg) before I'm ascended?”

Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Egkeupian a perem ne eggalin keddi ka geem nu eyew egkaangken ku ka katungdanan nu isip pangulu.”

And Ilisyu answered, “I desire hopefully that your(sg) power will come to me so_that I'll receive your(sg) position as leader.”

10 Ne migtabak si Ilyas, “Malised sika se egbuyuen nu, piru ke egkiteen a nikeykew ka egkabatun, egkarawat nu ka egbuyuen nu, piru ke kena a egkiteen nikeykew, kene nu egkarawat seini.”

10 And Ilyas answered, “What_ you(sg) _asked (is) difficult, but if I'm seen by_you(sg) ascending, you(sg) can_receive what_ you(sg) _requested, but if I'm not seen by_you(sg), you(sg) won't receive it.”

11 Te sasangan e sikandan ka eggipanew ne migpahuhurey, sahuhune ne due miglepew ne hapuy ne karwahi ne ingganuy te hapuy ne me kudde. Sika ka egpuunan ne nekegsuwey sikandan se daruwa, ne nabatun e si Ilyas diye te langit ne nekeuntud te balisusu. 12 Nakita ni Ilisyu seini wey migmemetmetan din te migpanguleyi, “Ahalen ku! Ahalen ku! Seinid e ka me karwahi te Israil wey ka migmangudde.”

11 While they were_walking and talking_together, suddenly there_was a fire chariot that was pulled by fire horses. That's the reason why the two of them were_separated, and Ilyas was_ascended to the sky/heaven riding a whirlwind. 12 Ilisyu saw this and he stared_at_it shouting, “My master! My master! Here (are) the chariots of Israil and the horse-riders.”

Ne hengkayi te ware din e nakita si Ilyas, inggisi din e ka kumbale din patamtamani te pegpapitew te pegkalaggew rin.13 Ne dutu, impurut din e ka hinabel ne ingkukuyumbu ni Ilyas ne neulug puun te lawa rin, wey miglibed e si Ilisyu migsasindeg diye te ilis te Weyig ne Hurdan. 14 Ne in-uyan din e ka ingkukuyumbu ni Ilyas ne hinabel ne neulug puun te lawa rin, wey inlampesan din e ka weyig te migkahi, “Hendeid e ka Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama ni Ilyas?” Te nalampesan din e ka weyig, nabaad e ka weyig te daruwa, wey miglapas e si Ilisyu. 15 Te pegkakita te punduk te me prupita ne migmanasindeg diye te madmariyu ki Ilisyu te egpalinggumaan e, migkahi e sikandan, “Diyad ki Ilisyu ka geem ni Ilyas.” Ne nangendiyad sikandan ka egsinug-ung ki Ilisyu ne migpanimbuel diye te tangkaan din. 16 Migkahi sikandan, “Pitew ka, due lalimma ne pulu (50) ne mannekal ne me etew ne duma te me suluhuanen nu. Peyipanawa nu sikandan eyew te pegpamitew te ahalen nu, su kema ke diye de sikandin uyana te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama te bubungan wey ke diye naa te napu.” Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Kene niyud sikandan peyipanawa.” 17 Piru kene dan iya egpeen-enengan si Ilisyu, sikan naa ka neyilew e sikandin ka egbalibad. Purisu migkahi e sikandin, “Ne peyipanawa niyud iya sikandan.” Sikan naa ka impeyipanew ran e ka lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me etew eyew te pegpamitew ki Ilyas. Natateluwan sikandan ka migpamitew, piru ware dan iya nakita sikandin. 18 Te peglibed dan e diye te ki Ilisyu ne diye pad te Hiriku te seeye ne timpu, migkahiyan e sikandan ni Ilisyu, “Migkahiyan kud ma iya sikaniyu te kene kew e hipanew.”

And when he no_longer saw Ilyas, he ripped his upper_clothes intensely for showing his sadness.13 And then, he picked_up the woven_cloth that Ilyas had_worn that had_fallen_off from his body, and Ilisyu returned to stand there at the edge of the River Hurdan. 14 And he took the woven_material that Ilyas had_worn that had_fallen_off from his body, and he struck the water/river saying, “Where is the Lord God, the God of Ilyas?” When he struck the water/river, the water/river was_divided into two, and Ilisyu crossed_over. 15 When the group of prophets that standing there at a distance saw Ilisyu that coming, they said, “The power of Ilyas is now with Ilisyu.” And they went to meet Ilisyu and kneeled in front of him. 16 They said, “Look(sg), there_are fifty (50) strong(pl) people along_with your(sg) servants. Send(sg) them in_order for searching for your(sg) master, because what_if he was just carried by the Spirit of the Lord God to the mountain or to the plain.” And Ilisyu answered, “Don't(sg) send them.” 17 But they weren't silent to Ilisyu, that's why he was_ashamed to disagree. Therefore he said, “Ok send(pl) them.” So then they sent the fifty (50) people in_order for_searching for Ilyas. They took_three_days searching, but they didn't indeed find him. 18 Upon their returning there to Ilisyu who was still at Hiriku at that time, they were_told by Ilisyu, “Indeed I told you(pl) not to go(pl).”

19 Sabeka ne aldew, migkahiyan te me matig-Hiriku si Ilisyu, “Pitew ka ahalen, meupiya ka natahuan te seini ne siyudad, piru kene ne meupiya ka weyig wey kene egbebehas ka me pinamula.”

19 One day, Ilisyu was_told by the (ones) from_Hiriku, “Look(sg) master, the placement in this city (is) good, but the water (is) not good and the crops don't bear.”

20 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Uyani a te iyam ne yahung wey tahui niyu te asin.” Ne in-uyanan dan e sikandin te yahung. 21 Nataman miggendiyad e si Ilisyu te sebseb te weyig wey insabulakan din e seini te asin te migkahi, “Seini ka inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Migmalinis e ka seini ne weyig. Kenad e seini egpakapatey wey kenad e egpakarereet te me pinamula.’ ” 22 Ne migmalinis en iya ka weyig taman kuntee, sumale te inlalag ni Ilisyu.

20 And Ilisyu said, “Bring me a new bowl and put(pl)_ salt _in_it.” Then they brought him a bowl. 21 Then Ilisyu went to the spring of water and he threw_a_handful of salt in it saying, “This is what_ the Lord God _says, ‘This water is_ now _clean. It will_ no_longer _kill and will_ no_longer _destroy crops.’ ” 22 Then the water indeed became_clean until now, according to what_ Ilisya _said.

23 Nataman, miggipanew e si Ilisyu peendiye te inged ne Bitil. Te sasangan e sikandin ka eggipanew, due me lukes-lukes ne miglepew ne diye egpuun te siyudad ne migyangyang kandin ne migkahi, “Upew, upew, awe ka kayi!”

23 Then, Ilisyu traveled towards the place of Bitil. While he was traveling, there_were young_boys that appeared that came_from the city that jeered_at him saying, “Baldy, baldy, leave(sg) here!”

24 Ne miglilingey si Ilisyu wey intengtengan din sikandan, wey indilus din sikandan pinaahi te ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne dutu, due daruwa ne usu ne miglihawang diye te mabbenes wey impamindas-bindas e ka hep-at ne pulu wey daruwa (42) te seeye ne me lukes-lukes.

24 And Ilisyu turned and he looked_at them, and he cursed them by_means_of the name of the Lord God. And then, there_were two bears that exited from the wilderness and tore_apart the forty-two (42) of those young_boys.

25 Ne dutu, miggendiyad e sikandin te bubungan te Karmil. Ne nataman, miglibed e man-e sikandin diye te inged ne Samarya.

25 And then, he went to the mountain of Karmil. And then, he returned again to the place that's Samarya.

Ka peggira te Israil wey te Muwab

The fighting of Israil and of Muwab

31 Te igkasapulu e wey walu (18) ne leg-un te peghari ni Hari Hihusapat diye te inged te Huda, neyimu e ne Hari diye te Israil ka anak ni Ahab ne si Huram wey diye te Samarya ka ugpaan din te mighari. Ne mighari si Huram te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne leg-un diye te Samarya. 2 Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, piru kene de ne iling kareet te hinimuwan te amey rin ne si Hari Ahab wey te iney rin ne si Rayna Hisibil, su ingguhus din ma mule ka me sungkaleg te diyus-diyus ne si Baal ne inggimu te amey wey iney rin. 3 Piru minsan pad due, in-ilingan din iya ka mareet ne hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat, ne iyan e egpuunan ne nakasale ka me matig-Israil. Ne ware iya sikandin mig-engked te mareet ne hinimuwan din. 4 Ne ka Hari te Muwab ne si Misa, talagpaahad te karniru. Ne tagse leg-un, egpeuyanan din ka Hari te Israil te sabeka ne hatus ne libu (100,000) ne nati te karniru, wey te bulbul te sabeka ne hatus ne libu (100,000) ne lukesan ne karniru. 5 Piru te pegkapatey e ni Hari Ahab, migribildi e te Hari te Israil ka Hari te Muwab ne si Misa. 6 Te seeye ne aldew, inlibulung ni Hari Huram ka langun ne sundalu te Israil, wey miglihawang e sikandan diye te Samarya eyew te pegbubunu. 7 Ne dutu, migpeuyanan din e te lalag ka Hari te Huda ne si Huram te migkahi, “Egpakig-ehet keddi ka Hari te Muwab, egkaayun ded ne egbulihan a nikeykew te pegbubunu kandin?” Ne migtabak si Hari Hihusapat, “Uya, egduma a keykew, igpahamit ku keykew ka me etew ku wey ka me kudde ku.” 8 Ne mig-inse pad man-e sikandin, “Hendei ki naa egbaye ka eglusud?”

31 On the eighteenth (18) year of kinging by King Hihusapat there in the place of Huda, Ahab's child Huram became king there in Israil and there at Samarya was his place when reigning. And Huram reigned in Samarya for twelve (12) years. 2 His deeds were evil in front of the Lord God, but not really evil like what his father King Ahab and his mother Queen Hisibil had done, because he destroyed on_the_contrary the posts of the idol Baal that his father and mother made. 3 But despite that, he indeed followed the wicked deeds of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat, which was the reasoned the (ones) from_Israil have sinned. He indeed never stopped his wicked deeds. 4 And the king of Muwab Misa, the one_who_allowed_copulation of the sheep. And every year, he sent one hundred thousand (100,000) lambs to the king of Israil, and the hair of one hundred thousand (100,000) male sheep. 5 But when King Ahab died, the king of Muwab Misa rebelled against the king of Israil. 6 On that day, King Huram gathered_together the soldiers of Israil, and they came_out there in Samarya in_order to fight. 7 And there, he sent word to the king of Huda Huram that goes, “The king of Muwab fight against me, is it possible for you(sg) to_help me fight_against him?” And King Hihusapat answered, “Yes, I will_go with you(sg), I will_allow_ my people and my horses _to_be_used by you(sg).” 8 And he asked again, “Where (should) we(incl) go to attack?”

Migtabak si Huram, “Diye ki egbaye te disirtu ne diye te inged te Idum.”

Huram answered, “We(incl) will_go_through to the desert there in the place of Idum.”

9 Sikan naa ka migligkat e ka Hari te Israil, ka Hari te Huda, duma te Hari te inged ne Idum. Te pitu e ne aldew sikandan ka migparid ne migpaalingkus, naaminan e sikandan te weyig ne eg-inumen para te me sundalu wey te me ayam dan ne indulanan te me inuyanan dan. 10 Ne migkahi ka Hari te Israil, “Keyey! Sikanta se tatelu ne Hari, hendue te igbehey ki te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hari te Muwab.” 11 Piru mig-inse si Hari Hihusapat, “Duen buwa prupita te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkeinsaan ta kayi ke nekey ka eggimuwen ta?”

9 That's why the king of Israil, the king of Huda, with the king of the place of Idum left. When they marched around for seven days already, they were ran_out of drinking water for the soldiers and for their animals that carried their supplies (LIT what_they_bring). 10 And the king of Israil said, “Oh no! The three of us(incl), it seems that the Lord God has_given us(incl) into the king of Muwab.” 11 But King Hihusapat asked, “Is there a prophet of the Lord God that we(incl) could ask for what we(incl) are_going to do?”

Ne due sabeka te upisyal te Hari te Israil ne migtabak, “Duma ta kuntee si Ilisyu, ka anak ni Sapat. Hibateen sikandin dengan ni Ilyas.”

And there_was one of the king of Israil's officials answered, “Ilisyu is with us(incl) right now, the child of Sapat. He was Ilyas disciple before.”

12 Ne migkahi si Hihusapat, “Uya, malehet sikandin ne prupita.” Purisu nangendiye te ki Ilisyu ka Hari te Israil, te Huda, wey ka Hari te inged ne Idum.

12 And Hihusapat said, “Yes, he is true prophet.” Therefore the king of Israil, Huda, and the king of Idum went to Ilisyu.

13 Ne migkahiyan ni Ilisyu ka Hari te Israil, “Mania te egbulihan ku sikeykew? Diye ka buyu te bulig te me prupita te me manama ne insimba te amey wey iney nu.”

13 And Ilisyu told the king of Israil, “Why (should) I help you(sg)? Ask(sg) help there to the prophets of the gods your(sg) father and mother worshiped.”

Piru migtabak si Huram ne Hari te Israil, “Kene, su ka Magbebaye ne Manama ka migpeumew kanami te tatelu eyew egkatalu te Hari te Muwab.”

But Huram the king of Israil answered, “No, the Lord God (was) the (one who) caused_ the three of us(excl) _to_be_called in_order to_be_defeated by the king of Muwab.”

14 Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Igpahunlibet ku diye te neuyag ne Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye ne impamakey ku. Ke kene ne puun te pegtahud ku ki Hihusapat ne Hari te Huda, kene kud iya eg-el-eliten sikeykew wey minsan te pegsil-ap naan de keykew. 15 Piru uyani a te egkateu ne egpangelit te alpa.”

14 And Ilisyu answered, “I will_swear to the living Very Strong Lord that I served. If it's not because of my respecting Hihusapat the king of Huda, I will_ never _welcome you(sg) and even to look at you(sg). 15 But bring me (a person) who can play harp.”

Te sasangan e ne egpangelit ka talagpangelit te alpa, migleneb e ka geem te Maresen ne Magbebaye diye te ki Ilisyu.16 Ne migkahi e si Ilisyu, “Seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Eggipenuen ku te weyig seini se mammara ne beuhan.’ 17 Su seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Ware egkiteen niyu ne uran wey ke egpangalamag naa, piru egkapenu te weyig ka beuhan eyew sikaniyu, ka me baka, wey ka duma pad ne me ayam niyu, egpekeinum te weyig.’ 18 Malemu re amana seini te Magbebaye, igbehey rin degma ka me Muwabihanen kaniyu. 19 Keilangan ne egkatalu niyu ka me siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu, wey panempuha niyu ka langun ne mabehas ne kayu wey subunga niyu ka me sebseb te weyig, wey dereeti niyu ka meupiya ne tane dan pinaahi te pegpanabulak te me batu.”

When the strummer strum the harp, the power of the Lord Almighty entered (LIT soak in) to Ilisyu.16 And Ilisyu said, “This is what the Lord God said, ‘I'm going to fill this dry stream with water.’ 17 Because this is what the Lord God said, ‘You(pl) will_ not _see rain and windy, but the stream will_be_filled with water so_that you(pl), your(pl) cattle, and your(pl) other livestock, can drink water.’ 18 This is just_very_easy for the Lord, and he also give the Muwabihanuns to you(pl). 19 You(pl) should defeat the fortified cities (LIT cities walled with high and thick stones), cut down all fruitful trees and blocked the streams of water, and destroyed their fertile (LIT good) land by throwing stones.”

20 Te pegkapawe e, te uras e te pegpanubad, sahuhune ne due miglepew ne weyig ne migtulayas puun diye te inged te Idum taman te duen e weyig minsan hendei.

20 At dawn, the hour for sacrificing, suddenly the water appeared and run_down from the place of Idum until there_is water everywhere.

21 Te pegkarineg te me Muwabihanen te egbubunu kandan ka tatelu ne Hari, impeumew ran e ka langun ne egpekeeleg e te panganiban, puun de iya te me bate pad peendiye te me buyag eyew te pegbubunu, wey sikandan ka impasungu te bunuanan. 22 Te peggimata ran te maselem, wey te migsilaan e te aldew ka weyig, nakita ran ne migmalalab e ka weyig iling te langesa. 23 Ne migkahi sikandan, “Langesa ma mule seini! Migpeehetey iya ka me sundalu te tatelu ne Hari wey migpeyimhimatayey e sikandan, kuwa kid e, egpanguen tad ka me kasangkapan dan.”

21 When the Muwabihanons heard that the three kings will_fight_against them, they caused_all_who can bear arms to_be_called, from the young ones to the matured ones in_order to fight, and they were the ones stationed_at_front of the fighting_place. 22 When they woke_up in the morning, and when the water was shining by the sun, they saw that the water became red like blood. 23 And they said, “This is blood on_the_contrary! The soldiers of the three kings fight indeed and killed each other, let's go, (let's) take their possessions.”

24 Piru te pegginguma ran e diye te kampu te matig-Israil, migmanasindeg e ka me matig-Israil wey migpakigbunu kandan, taman te nakapallahuy e sikandan. Ne inlupug sikandan te me matig-Israil te migpangimatey taman te ugpaan dan. 25 Indereetan dan ka me siyudad, wey ka tagse sabeka kandan migpandegpak te me batu diye te meupiya ne tane taman te nabunbunan e seini. Ne insubung dan man-e ka me sebseb te weyig wey impameled dan ka me mabehas ne me kayu. Ka Kir-Harisit wey ka alad ne batu naan de kayi ka nasame, piru inlingutan wey inlusuran seini te me sundalu ne nanguyan te lambuyug wey natalu ran e.

24 But when they arrived there in the camp of the (ones) from_Israil, the (ones) from_Israil stand_up and attacked them, until they were able to flee. Then they were chased by the (ones) from_Israil to kill until to their living_place. 25 They destroyed the cities, and each one of them throw a stone on the good land until it was_covered. And they also blocked the streams of water and they cut down the fruitful trees. And only the Kir-Harisit and the stone fence of it was left, but it surrounded and attacked by the soldiers who brought slingshots and they defeated (it).

26 Te pegkakita te Hari te Muwab ne egkatalu e sikandan, induma rin e ka pitu ne pulu ne gatus (700) ne me sundalu rin ne kampilan se me panganiban, wey inggeraman dan e te eglusud ka me sundalu ne kuntere dan eyew egpakabaye sikandan peendiye te Hari te Idum, piru ware sikandan nakabaye. 27 Purisu, ingkuwa te Hari ka panganey ne anak din ne lukes ne iyan perem egsubal kandin eghari, wey impanubad din ne intutung diye te alad te siyudad ne matikang wey makepal. Ne puun dutu, nabbelu-belu e ka me matig-Muwab te me matig-Israil, purisu nangawe e diye ka me matig-Israil wey nanguli e diye te inged dan.

26 When the king of Muwab saw that they were_defeated, he took his seven hundred (700) soldiers whose weapons (were) swords, and they tried to attack their enemy soldiers so_that they could_pass toward_there to the king of Idum, but they weren't able_to_pass. 27 Therefore, the king took his firstborn male child who was supposed to succeeding him in kinging, and he offered him by burning on the fortified city (LIT cities walled with high and thick). And from there, those_from_Muwab were_very_angry toward of those_from_Israil, so those_from_Israil left there and they went back_home to their place.

Ka pegbulig ni Ilisyu te egkaayu-ayu ne balu

The helping of poor widow by Ilisyu

41 Sabeka ne aldew, due balu ne malitan ne asawa dengan te sabeka ne prupita ne miggendiye te ki Ilisyu ne migbalbalukan ne migkahi, “Migpatey e ka suluhuanen nu, ne asawa ku. Nakanengneng ka ne ka suluhuanen nu, due pegkaaldek te Magbebaye. Piru kuntee, seinid e ka etew ne neutangan din, eg-angayen din e ka daruwa ne anak ku su eg-uripenen din e isip bayad te utang.”

41 One day, there_was a widow woman who was the spouse of one of the prophets before who came to Ilisyu crying_out_loud saying, “Your(sg) servant, my husband is dead. You(sg) know that your(sg) servant, had fearing of the Lord. But now, the man whom he owed money is here now, he will_take away my two children and he's going_to_enslave them as payment for debt.”

2 Ne migtabak si Ilisyu kandin, “Nekey-a ka igkabulig ku keykew? Nangeni a, nekey a ka kasangkapan nu diye te baley nu?” Ne migtabak sikandin, “Warad iya, gawas te deisek naan de ne lana.”

2 And Ilisyu answered her, “What can I help you(sg)? Tell me, what are your(sg) possessions at your(sg) house?” And she answered, “Nothing, except a small oil.”

3 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Hendiye ka te me sumbaley nu, sambey ke naa te ware tahu ne me banga wey masuluha nu te egsambey. 4 Seled ke naa diye te baley niyu wey lelekeb kew se taltalaanak. Panahui nu naa ka me banga te lana, ne emun ke egkapenu e, irapig nud e.” 5 Purisu miggipanew e ka malitan te peggimu te ingkahi ni Ilisyu. Te nekeuli e sikandin, miglelekeb e sikandan se taltalaanak. Ne impamehayan e sikandin te me anak din te banga wey inggipenu din e seeye te lana. 6 Te napenu e ka langun ne me banga, migkahiyan din e ka me anak din, “Behayi e pa man-e te banga.”

3 And Ilisyu said, “Go(sg) to your(sg) neighbors, borrow the empty jars and borrow many. 4 Go(sg) inside your(pl) house and you(pl) including_your_children lock_up. Put(sg) oil in the jars, and when they are full, put(sg) them aside.” 5 Therefore the woman went to do what Ilisyu said. When she return_home, she_and_her_children locked the door. And her children gave him jars and she filled them with oil. 6 When the jars were all full, she said to her children, “Gave me more jars.”

Ne migtabak ka anak din, “Warad e banga.” Ne migpeeneng-eneng e ka lana ne egtulayas.

And her children answered, “No more jars.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

7 Te nahuhuran e te malitan si Ilisyu, migkahi e si Ilisyu, “Na, ibelegye nud e ka lana wey bayari nud ka utang nu. Ne ka same naa, egpekeuyag e kaniyu te taltalaanak.”

7 And when the woman told Ilisyu, Ilisyu said, “Okay, sell(sg) the oil and pay(sg) your(sg) debt. And the left_over, can_help_ you(pl) including_your_children _to_live_on.”

Ka peg-uyag ni Ilisyu te anak te meyaman ne malitan

The giveing_life (LIT raise_to_live) to the rich woman's child by Ilisyu

8 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye si Ilisyu te inged te Sunam. Ne due meyaman ne malitan ne mig-ugpe diye, ne migpehes migginggat kandin ne egkeen. Tagse eglihad sikandin dutu, egtulan iya sikandin eyew egkeen. 9 Migkahiyan te malitan ka asawa rin, “Nakanengneng a ne ka etew ne layun egtulan kayi te kanta, matulus ne suluhuanen te Manama. 10 Egkaayun buwa ne eggimu ki te deisek ne sinabeng dutu te atep, ne egtahuan ta te hibatanan, lamisa, bangku wey sulu eyew due egkeyirehaan din ke eggendini sikandin.”

8 One day, Ilisyu went to the place of Sunam. And there_was a rich woman who lived there, who invited him insistedly to eat. Everytime he passed there, he indeed would have drop_in there to eat. 9 The woman told her husband, “I know that the man who often drop_in here to us(incl), is holy servant of God. 10 Can we(incl) make a small room on the rooftop, and we(incl) will_put a bed, table, chair and light so_that he can have a room to sleep whenever he comes.”

11 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye si Ilisyu te Sunam. Ne migpamaneyik e sikandin diye te sinabeng eyew eggimmeley diye. 12 Ne insuhu din ka suluhuanen din ne si Gihasi, “Umawa nu ka matig-Sunam ne malitan.” Sikan naa ka in-umew rin e ka malitan wey miggendiyad e te kandin. Te duen e ka malitan, 13 migkahiyan e ni Ilisyu si Gihasi, “Insei nu naa sikandin kuntee ke nekey ka igkabales ta kandin te peg-atiman din kanta. Duen naa igpalalag din kanta diye te Hari wey ke diye naa te pangulu te me sundalu?”

11 One day, Ilisyu went to Sunam. And he went_up to the room to rest there. 12 And he commanded his servant Gihasi, “Call the woman that's from_Sunam.” That's why he called the woman and she came to him. When the woman was there already, 13 Ilisyu said to Gihasi, “Ask her now what can we(incl) give_back to her for taking_care of us(incl). Does she has something for us(incl) to speak to the king (on her behalf) or to the leader of the soldiers?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Matubung e ka keugpe ku kayi duma te me karumaan ku.”

Then the woman answered, “My living_situation here is abundant with my relatives.”

14 Ne migkahi e si Ilisyu, “Nekey naa mule ka egkeyimu ta kandin?”

14 Then Ilisyu said, “What can we(incl) do for her?”

Ne migtabak si Gihasi, “Ware anak din, wey buyag e ka asawa rin.”15 Ne migkahiyan e man-e ni Ilisyu si Gihasi, “Umawa nu pa man-e sikandin.” Te pegginguma te malitan, diye de sikandin migsasindeg te gumawan. 16 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Puun kuntee, te iling ded kayi ne aldew te seup ne leg-un, egsapipi kad e te anak nu ne lukes.”

And Gihasi answered, “She has no child, and her husband is already old.”15 And Ilisyu said to Gihasi, “Call her again.” When the woman came, she was just standing in the doorway. 16 And Ilisyu said, “From now on, next year same as this day, you(sg) will_holding_ your(sg) male child in your(sg) _arms.”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “I, kene ke ma genendue ahalen, kene ka uubat, suluhuanen ke pe ma te Manama.”

And the woman answered, “Hey, don't be like that master, don't lie, you(sg) (are) a servant of God.”

17 Piru, naberes iya ka malitan, wey mig-anak sikandin te lukes te iling iya ne timpu te ingkahi ni Ilisyu.

17 But, the woman indeed got pregnant, and she gave birth to a male about the time Ilisyu had said.

18 Sabeka ne aldew te migtulin e ka bate, migsundul sikandin te amey rin diye te kamet duma te me talaggaani. 19 Ne sahuhune ne migpanguleyi ka bate diye te amey rin ne migkahi, “Masakit ka ulu ku, masakit ka ulu ku!”

18 One day when the child grew, he followed his father there to the field with the harvesters. 19 And suddenly the child cried_out to his father saying, “My head is sore, my head is sore!”

Ne migkahiyan e te amey te bate ka sabeka te me suluhuanen din, “Uyana nu pa ka bate diye te iney rin.”

And the father of the child said to one of his servants, “Bring the child to his mother.”

20 Ne insapipi e te suluhuanen ka bate peendiye te iney rin. Ne inggibe e te iney ka bate taman te meudtu, nataman nabigtawan e ka bate. 21 Ne dutu, insapipi e te iney ka bate peendiye te ampew ne sinabeng, wey impeyibat din e diye te hibatanan ni Ilisyu ne prupita. Ne inlekeban din e ka gumawan wey miggipanew e sikandin. 22 Nataman, in-umew rin e ka asawa rin te migkahi, “Peuyani a te sabeka ne suluhuanen wey sabeka ne asnu, eyew egpakaragdahew a egpekeendiye te suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey eyew mahaan e re egpakalibed.” 23 Ne migkahi ka asawa rin, “Mania te egkeupian ka ne eggendiye kuntee? Te kene mem pad kuntee ne an-anayan ne pegsile te bulan wey ke Aldew te Peggimeley naa?”

20 And the child was carried back to his mother by the servant. The mother put_ him _on_her_lap until noon, and then the child died. 21 And there, the mother carried the child to the room upstairs, and she caused_ (him) to _lie_down to Ilisyu the prophet's bed. And she closed the doorway and she traveled. 22 And then, she called her husband and said, “Send me one servant and a donkey, so_that I can go immediately to the servant of the Lord God, and so_that I can immediately come_back_home.” 23 And his husband said, “Why do you(sg) want to go there now? This is not the time yet of the first month or either the Day of Resting?”

Ne migtabak ka malitan, “Egkaayun ded sika.”24 Ne dutu insakangan din e ka asnu wey migkahiyan din e ka suluhuanen din, “Kuwa kid! Ne kene nu naa pepahan-ganara seini gawas ke egkahiyan ku sikeykew.” 25 Sikan naa ka miggipanew e sikandin ka miggendiye ki prupita Ilisyu diye te bubungan te Karmil. Te madmariyu pad sikandin, nakite e sikandin te prupita ne si Ilisyu, sikan naa ka migkahiyan e ni Ilisyu ka suluhuanen din ne si Gihasi, “Pitawa nu! Sika ka malitan ne matig-Sunam ne egpeendini kanta. 26 Palahuy ka ka egsinug-ung kandin wey insei nu ke meupiya red sikandin. Insei nu sikandin ke meupiya red ka asawa rin wey ka anak din.”

Then the woman said, “It's till possible.”24 And then she saddled the donkey and she said to her servant, “Let's go! And don't cause_ it _to_slow_down unless I tell you(sg).” 25 Therefore she went to prophet Ilisyu to the mount Karmil. When she was still somewhat_distant, she was_seen by the prophet Ilisyu, therefore Ilisyu said to his servant Gihasi, “Look(sg)! That's the woman from_Sunam that will_come here. 26 Run to meet her and ask her if she is just good. Ask if her husband is just good and her child.”

Te neinsaan e ni Gihasi ka malitan, migtabak ka malitan kandin ne miggenendue, “Meupiya key red.”27 Piru te pegginguma rin e diye te ki Ilisyu diye te bubungan, migpanimbuel e sikandin diye te tangkaan ni Ilisyu ne miggen-gen te paa ni Ilisyu. Ne migdugpu si Gihasi eyew te pegpaawe te malitan, piru insaparan sikandin ni Ilisyu te migkahi, “Balahara nu sikandin! Su amana nalaggew sikandin, inggeles seini te Magbebaye wey wara a nikandin panengnenga.”

When the woman asked already by Gihasi, the woman answered him goes_like_this, “We're all good.”27 But when she came to Ilisyu on the mountain, she kneeled_down in front of Ilisyu and holding Ilisyu's feet. And Gihasi came to take_ the woman _away, but he was_scolded by Ilisyu saying, “Leave(sg) her alone! Because she is very sad, God hide it and he didn't let me know about his.”

28 Ne migkahi ka malitan, “Ahalen, wara a migbuyu keykew te anak ne lukes, migkahiyan ku mem pad iya sikeykew te kena a ubati.” 29 Ne migkahiyan e ni Ilisyu si Gihasi, “Taggel kad, uyana nu seini se tuked ku, wey hendiye ka te baley te malitan. Ke due egkasinug-ung nu, kene ka elit-elit, wey ke due eg elit-elit keykew, kene ka tabak. Pegginguma nu, iragket nu naa ka tuked ku diye te ulaula te bate.”

28 And the woman said, “Master, I didn't ask you(sg) for a male child, I even told you(sg) not to lie to me.” 29 Then Ilisyu told Gihasi, “Be ready, bring my staff, and go(sg) to the woman's house. When you(sg) meet_someone_on_the_way, don't greet (him/her), or if someone greets you(sg), don't answer. When you(sg) arrive, place/touch my staff on the child's face.”

30 Piru migkahi ka iney te bate, “Mengeyibet te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama wey keykew, te kena a iya eg-uli ke kene ku egkaruma sikeykew.” Sikan naa ka migparumeey e sikandan peendiye te baley te malitan. 31 Ne miggun-e e mule si Gihasi wey imparagketan din e te tuked ka ulaula te bate, piru ware nakeyimata ka bate. Sikan naa ka migpalilibed e si Gihasi diye te engki Ilisyu ne migkahi kandan, “Ware nekeyimata ka bate.”

30 But the mother of the child said, “I swear to the living Lord God and to you(sg), that I won't go home if I can't (convince) you(sg) to come with me.” That's why they went together to the woman's house. 31 And Gihasi on_the_contrary went ahead (of them) and he placed/touched the child's face by the staff, but the child didn't wake_up. That's why Gihasi went back to Ilisyu and told them, “The child didn't able_to_wake_up.”

32 Te nekeume e si Ilisyu diye te baley, migpamaneyik e sikandin diye te sinabeng wey nakita rin e ka bate ne migpatey e ne impaley-as diye te hibatanan din. 33 Ne migseled sikandin wey miglelekeb, wey daruwa ran naan de te bate. Ne dutu, mig-ampu e sikandin diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 34 Nataman, migkatut e si Ilisyu diye te hibatanan wey miglangkeban din e ka bate, wey impalenged din ka be-be din diye te be-be te bate, wey ka mata rin diye te mata te bate, wey ka me belad din diye te me belad te bate. Te sasangan e sikandin ka miglangkeb te bate, migmeinit e ka lawa te bate. 35 Ne migsasindeg e man-e si Ilisyu wey miggiphipanew diye te sinabeng, nataman migkatut e man-e sikandin diye te hibatanan wey miglangkeban din e man-e ka bate. Ne dutu, nekeetise e ka bate te kapapitu, nataman miggimelat e sikandin. 36 Ne dutu, in-umew e ni Ilisyu si Gihasi te migkahi, “Umawa nu ka iney te bate.” Sikan naa, in-umew rin e ka malitan. Te pegginguma te malitan, migkahi e si Ilisyu, “Seini red ka anak nu, sapipiya nud e sikandin.” 37 Ne migdugpu e ka malitan wey mig-usengul sikandin diye te paa ni Ilisyu. Ne insapipi rin e ka anak din wey miglihawang e sikandin.

32 When Ilisyu arrived at the house, he went_up to the room and saw the child lying dead on his bed. 33 Then he entered and closed_ the _door, and only two of them (inside). And there, he prayed to the Lord God. 34 Then, Ilisyu step_up on the bed and he lay_face_down over the child, he placed his mouth on the child's mouth, and his eyes on the child's eyes, and his hands on the child's hands. While lying_face_down on the child, the child's body get_warm. 35 And Ilisyu stand_up again and walked around the room, then he step_up again on the bed and he lay_face_down again over the child. And there, the child was_able_to_sneeze seven times, then he opened_ his _eyes. 36 And then, Ilisyu called Gihasi saying, “Call the child's mother.” So then, he called his mother. When the woman came in, Ilisyu said, “Here's your(sg) child, carry him.” 37 The woman approached and she bent_over to Ilisyu's feet. And she carried her child and she went_outside.

Ka daruwa pad man-e ne kein-inuwan

Another two wonders

38 Nataman, miglibed e si Ilisyu diye te inged te Gilgal. Te seeye ne timpu, due dakel ne gutas su gulabung te seeye ne inged. Sabeka ne aldew, miglibulung ka punduk te me prupita duma kandin, ne migkahiyan din ka suluhuanen din, “Iriken nu ka dakel ne kuren, wey pakihulay ka te igpakeen ta te seini se me prupita.” 39 Ne sabeka kandan ka miggendiyad e te mabbenes eyew egpakihulay, wey nakakita sikandin te laag ne egpekeiling te tebesal. Ne migpamupu e sikandin te eleg din de te eg-uyan. Te nakalibed e sikandin, impangalad din e seini wey insubuk din e te kuren minsan ware din nataheyi ke nekey seeye. 40 Ne impangeun dan e seini eyew igpakeen e te me etew. Piru te egbunsud e sikandan ka egkeen kayi, migbalbalukan sikandan ne migkahi, “Suluhuanen te Manama, egpakapatey ma mule seini se egkeenen!” Sikan naa ka ware dan e seini keena. 41 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Uyani a te harina.” Ne imbukbukan din e ka kuren te migkahi, “Na, isendad niyud seini te me etew.” Ne dutu, naawe e ka egpekeyilu dutu.

38 Then, Ilisyu went_back to the place of Gilgal. At that time, there_was a huge famine because that place was droughted. One day, the group of the prophets gathere_together with him, and he said to his servant, “Put_ the big _cooking_pot (on fire), and get_vegetables to feed these prophets.” 39 And one of them went to the bush in_order to get_vegetables, and he found a wild (stuff) like squash. And picked (some of it) as he could carry. When he went_back, he sliced_ them _up and put them in the pot though he didn't know what they are. 40 And they served it to feed the people. But when they start to eat it, they shouted saying, “Servant of God, this food on_the_contrary can_kill!” Therefore they didn't eat it. 41 And Ilisyu said, “Bring me (some) flour.” Then he sprinkled the pot and said, “Now, served it to the people.” So then, the poisoned disappeared.

42 Sabeka ne aldew, due etew ne diye egpuun te inged te Baal-Salisya. Mig-uyan sikandin te daruwa ne pulu ne buuk ne paan ne inggimu puun te sibada, puun seeye te an-anayan ne nahaani ne sibada. Ne mig-uyan man-e sikandin te iyam nahaani ne sibada wey imbehey rin seini ki Ilisyu. Ne migkahiyan ni Ilisyu ka suluhuanen din, “Ibehey nu seini diye te me etew eyew igpakeen kandan.”

42 One day, there_was a man who came from the place of Baal-Salisya. He brought twenty pieces of bread that made from barley, that was the first harvest. And he also brought a new harvest barley and he gave it to Ilisyu. And Ilisyu said to his servant, “Give this to the people in_order to feed them.”

43 Ne migtabak ka suluhuanen din, “Kene buwa ma mule ne eleg seini te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne me etew?”

43 And his servant answered, “It seems this is not enough for a hundred (100) people?”

Piru mig-abey si Ilisyu migkahi, “Ibehey nu seini te me etew su migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama te kene dan de seini egkaamin wey duen pad egkasame.”44 Purisu insendad e te suluhuanen seeye diye te me etew. Ne nangeen e sikandan wey duen pad iya nasame sumale te ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama.

But Ilisyu said again, “Give this to people because the Lord God said that they won't be_able_to_finish it and there will_be_some_left_over.”44 Therefore the servant served it to the people. Then they ate and there were some left over according to what the Lord God said.

Ka pegkabawii ni Naaman

The healing of Naaman

51 [xr]Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Naaman, kumandir sikandin te me sundalu te Hari te Aram ne migngaranan ded degma te Sirya. Amana igkahale sikandin te Hari su taheed te migpangulu sikandin te me sundalu, imbulihan layun sikandan te Manama te pegtalu te me kuntere dan. Mabulut sikandin ne sundalu piru ibungen. 2 Na kuntee, te senge-pegbubunu te matig-Sirya diye te Israil, nakarakep sikandan te beyi-beyi ne neyimu e ne suluhuanen te asawa ni Naaman. 3 Sabeka ne aldew, migkahiyan te beyi-beyi ka ahalen din ne malitan, “Meupiya perem ke egpekeendiye ka ahalen ku te prupita ne diye mig-ugpe te Samarya eyew egkabawian sikandin te ibung din!” 4 Te pegkarineg ni Naaman te ingkahi te beyi-beyi ne matig-Israil, miggendiyaan din e ka ahalen din ne Hari wey ingguhud din e seini. 5 Ne migkahi ka Hari te Sirya, “Hendiye ka, egpeuyanen ku sikeykew te sulat para te Hari te Israil.”

51 [xr]And there was a man named Naaman, the commander of the soldiers of the king of Aram that was also called Sirya. The king was really pleased with him because while he commanding soldiers, they were always helped by God to defeat their enemies. He was brave soldier but he was a leper. 2 And now, one of the fightings of from_Sirya to Israil, they were able_to_captive a girl who became a servant of Naaman's wife. 3 One day, the girl told her woman master, “It would_be good if my master can go to the prophet who lived in Samarya so_that his leprosy will_be_healed!” 4 When Naaman heard of what the girl from_Israil said, he went to his master the king and he reported it. 5 Then the king of Sirya said, “Go(sg), I'll_have_ you(sg) _bring a letter for the king of Israil.”

Sikan naa ka miggipanew e sikandin ne mig-uyan te tatelu ne gatus wey hep-at ne pulu (340) ne kilu ne pelata, wey hen-em ne pulu wey walu (68) ne kilu ne bulawan, wey sapulu ne mateles wey iyam pad ne kumbale.6 Ne in-uyan ni Naaman ka sulat diye te Hari te Israil ne miggenendue, “Te seini ne sulat, igpeila ku keykew ka upisyal ku ne si Naaman. Eghangyu a keykew te bawii nu sikandin te ibung din.”

Therefore he set_out taking three hundred and forty (340) kilograms of silver, sixty eight (68) kilograms of gold, and ten beautiful and new clothes.6 And Naaman brought the letter to the king of Israil saying, “With this letter, I will_introduce to you(sg) my officer Naaman. I'm pleading you(sg) to cure him of his leprosy.”

7 Te pegkeimpus te Hari te egbasaa te sulat, imbindas din e ka kumbale din te migbalbalukan ne migkahi, “Manama a? Duen naa katenged ku te pegbuut ne egpatey wey ke egkeuyag pad ka etew ne egderalu? Mania te egpabawian din keddi seini se ibungen ne etew? Egpamitew re iya sikandin te egpuunan ne egpekeg-ehet key!”

7 When the king finished reading the letter, he tore his clothes and exclaimed saying, “Am I God? Do I have authority to decide that a sick person will_die or will_be_alive? Why does he ask me to cure this man who has leprosy? He is indeed looking for a reason for us(excl) to fight!”

8 Piru te pegkarineg ni Ilisyu ne suluhuanen te Manama te imbindas te Hari te Israil ka kumbale din, migpeuyan e sikandin te guhuren ne miggenendue, “Mania te imbindas nu ka kumbale nu? Ipeendini nu sikandin te keddi eyew egkatahaan din ne due prupita kayi te Israil.” 9 Purisu miggendiyad si Naaman duma te me kudde wey me karwahi rin, ne diyad iya migsanggel te gumawan te baley ni Ilisyu. 10 Ne migsuhu si Ilisyu te suluhuanen te pegkahi kandin, “Hendiye ka te Weyig ne Hurdan, lenep ka te kapapitu eyew egkeulian en iya sika se ibung nu.”

8 But when Ilisyu the servant of God heard that the king of Israil had torn his clothes, he sent a message that goes, “Why did you(sg) tear your(sg) clothes? Cause_ him _to_come to me so_that he may know there_is a prophet in Israil.” 9 Therefore Naaman went_there with (his) horses and his chariots, and indeed (he) stopped at the door of Ilisyu's house. 10 And Ilisyu sent servant to say to him, “Go to Jordan River, submerse for seven times so_that your(sg) leprosy will_ indeed _be_healed.”

11 Piru mig-awe de iya si Naaman ka nabelu-belu ne migsagsahukul ne migkahi, “Kahiyen ku ke eglihawang sikandin ka egsinug-ung keddi, wey eg-umawen din ka ngaran te Magbebaye ne Manama rin wey igtel-eb din ka belad din kayi te ibung ku eyew egkeulian ad! 12 Duen man ded iya weyig ne Abana wey Parpar diye te Damasku, ne meupiya pad du te me weyig kayi te Israil. Mani bes ke diye e re iya egseneb eyew egkeulian ad!” Ne miggipanew e sikandin ne nabelu-belu. 13 Piru miggendiyaan si Naaman te me suluhuanen din wey migkahiyan, “Ahalen, ke egsuhuen ka te prupita te malised ne eggimuwen, kene nu naa eggimuwen seini? Eggimuwen nu iya, ne iyan naan pa sika se egpaseneben ke re ne egkeulian kad e.”

11 But Naaman just went_away angry and complaining saying, “I thought he will_come_out to meet me, and he will_call the name of the Lord his God and he will_place_ his hand _on_top of my leprosy so_that I will_be_cured! 12 There are indeed water of Abana and Parpar there in Damasku, that's much better than waters here in Israil. So_what (surprise) if I'll just bath (LIT to dive_in_water) there so_that I'll be healed!” And he went_on very_angry. 13 But Naaman's servants came to him and said, “Master, if the prophet told you(sg) to do a difficult task, don't you(sg) do it? Indeed you(sg) will_do it, how much more it is just for you(sg) to submerse and you(sg) will_be_cured.”

14 Sikan naa ka migtupang e si Naaman diye te Weyig ne Hurdan wey miglenep e sikandin te kapapitu sumale te inlalag te suluhuanen te Manama, ne ka sapu din, neulian e wey nekeiling e te sapu te bate pad wey neulian e sikandin. 15 Nataman, miglibed e si Naaman duma te me etew rin diye te suluhuanen te Manama, wey migsasindeg sikandin diye te tangkaan din ne migkahi, “Kuntee, nakanengneng ad te ware lein ne manama angin e te Manama te Israil, purisu dawata nu ka dasag puun te suluhuanen nu.” 16 Piru migtabak si Ilisyu, “Egpahunlibet a te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama ne impamakey ku, te kenaa iya egdawat minsan nekey.”

14 So then Naaman went_down to Jordan River and he submersed seven times just as the servant of God had said, and his flesh, was cured and it was like a flesh of a baby and he was healed. 15 And then, Naaman went_back with his men to the servant of God, and he stood_up in front of him and said, “Today, I realized that there_is_no other god except the God of Israil, therefore accept a gift from your(sg) servant.” 16 But Ilsyu answered, “I'll swear by the strong/living Lord God whom I serve, that indeed I won't accept anything.”

Ne minsan migpamehes si Naaman ne egparawat te dasag din piru ware iya migdawat si Ilisyu.17 Purisu migkahi si Naaman, “Ke kene ka egdawat, peuyana a ubag nikeykew te tane ne eleg ne igdulan te daruwa ne kudde[fn] ne eg-uyanen ku te peg-uli ku su eyew due egkapes-ekan ku te altar. Su puun kuntee kena ad eghalad te egtutungen diye te lein ne manama su ka Magbebaye ne Manama naan de iya. 18 Piru egpasayluwen a perem te Magbebaye ne Manama ke egdumeen a te ahalen ku ne eggendiye te timplu te manama te Sirya ne si Rimmun eyew egpanimbuel wey egsimba kayi. Egpasayluwen a perem te Magbebaye ne Manama!”

And though Naaman insisted that he accept his gift but indeed Ilisyu didn't accept it.17 Therefore Naaman said, “If you(sg) won't accept (it), please cause_me_to_take a soil that sufficient to load_cargo of the two horses[fn] that I will_take when I return_home so_that there_is a place_where_ I _will_build altar. Because from now I won't offer burnt_offering to the other god but_instead only the Lord God indeed. 18 But may the Lord God forgive me when my master takes_ me _along to go to the temple of the god of Sirya which is Rimmun in_order to worship it and I also_bow. May the Lord God forgive me!”

19 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Uya, ne hipanew kad ne malinawen.”

19 And Ilisyu said, “Yes, go in peace.”

Piru te marani pad ka nabayaan ni Naaman,20 migsuman-suman si Gihasi ne suluhuanen ni Ilisyu, “Amana re ne hiid-uwen ka ahalen ku ki Naaman ne matig-Sirya su ware din dawata ka igbehey kandin. Igpahunlibet ku te manekal ne Magbebaye ne Manama, egtalukunan ku sikandin wey egbuyuan ku te minsan nekey.” 21 Sikan naa ka mig-iyal-iyal migtalukun si Gihasi ki Naaman. Te pegkakita ni Naaman ne due migpallahuy ne eglupug kandin, migpamaneug e sikandin te karwahi rin ka egsinug-ung. Ne mig-inse si Naaman, “Nekey naan e, meupiya kew red?”

But when Naaman had gone a close_distance,20 Ilisyu's servant Gihasi said to himself, “My master is just so kind to Naaman from_Sirya because he didn't accept what he was offering him. I'll swear to the strong/living Lord God, I will_ran_after him and ask him whatever.” 21 So then Gihasi hurriedly ran_after Naaman. When Naaman saw that someone running_after him, he climb_down of his chariot to meet him. And Naaman asked, “How (is it), are you(sg) good?”

22 Ne migtabak si Gihasi, “Uya meupiya man ded, insuhu a te ahalen ku su epakahiyan ka te due daruwa ne kanakan ne me prupita ne sikan pad iya miglepew puun diye te bubungan te Ipraim, behayi nu ubag sikandan te tatelu ne pulu ne kilu ne pelata wey daruwa ne mateles ne kumbale.”

22 And Gihasi answered, “Yes everything is good, my master sent me to tell you(sg) that there are two young_men prophets who just arrived from the mountain of Ipraim, please give them thirty kilograms of silver and two_pieces of beautiful clothes.”

23 Ne migkahi si Naaman, “Ne, kuwa kad iya te pitu ne pulu (70) ne pelata.” Ne impehes e ni Naaman si Gihasi ne egdawat dutu, ne intahu din ka pelata diye te daruwa ne puyungut. Ne dutu, imbehey rin e seeye duma te daruwa ne kumbale diye te daruwa ne suluhuanen. Sikandan ka mig-uyan dutu para ki Gihasi. 24 Piru te pegginguma enni Gihasi diye te baley ne in-ugpaan ni Ilisyu ne diye te bubungan, ingkuwa rin e ka me puyungut wey ka me kumbale diye te daruwa ne suluhuanen wey intahu din e diye te baley. Ne impeyipanew rin e sikandan. 25 Nataman, miggendiyad e sikandin ki Ilisyu. Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Ilisyu, “Hendei ka-a migpuun Gihasi?”

23 And Naaman said, “Okay, take(sg) seventy (70) kilograms of silver.” And Naaman insisted Gihasi to accept it, and he put the silver in two cloth_bags. And there, he gave/handed it and the clothes to the two servants. They were the one carrying for Gihasi. 24 When Gihasi and_company reached to his house in the mountain, he took the cloth_bags and the clothes from the two servants and he put them into the house. And he cause_ them _to_leave. 25 Then, he went to Ilisyu. And Ilisyu asked him, “Where have you(sg) been Gihasi?”

Ne migtabak si Gihasi, “Kayi man de iya ahalen.”

Gihasi answered, “Just here master.”

26 Piru migkahi si Ilisyu, “Kahiyen nu buwa ne ware migduma keykew ka panisingan ku? Nakita ku ka pegpamaneug te etew te karwahi rin eyew te pegsinug-ung keykew. Kene pad ne aldew kuntee te pegdawat te seleppi, me kumbale, me parasan, me ulibuwan, karniru, baka, wey me lukes wey malitan ne suluhuanen. 27 Purisu ka ibung ni Naaman, eggalin due te keykew wey diye te kabuhalan nu te ware egkatamanan.” Te peg-awe e ni Gihasi, sahuhune ne migmaangkag iling te binggala ka laplap din tenged te ibung.

26 But Ilisyu said, “Do you(sg) think my spirit didn't come accompany with you(sg)? I've seen the man got_out from his chariot in_order for meeting you(sg). It's not the day today to accept money, clothes, vineyards, olive_groves, sheep, cattle, and male and female servants. 27 Therefore Naaman's leprosy, will_transfer/afflict on you(sg) and to your(sg) descendants without end.” When Gihasi left, suddenly his skin became white like cassava because of the leprosy.

Ka wasey ne miggampung

An axe floated

61 Sabeka ne aldew, migparani ki Ilisyu ka duma ne me prupita wey migkahi, “Malig-et e seini se temuwanan ta. 2 Tuhuti key ne eggendiye te Weyig ne Hurdan eyew egpanggeed te igbebaley ney eyew due egkeugpaan ney.”

61 One day, some prophets came to Ilisyu and said, “This our(incl) meeting_place is too narrow. 2 Allow us(excl) to go to Jordan River to cut_round_timber for us(excl) to build_a_house so_that we(excl) have (something) to_live_in.”

Ne mig-uyun si Ilisyu.

And Ilisyu agreed.

3 Ne migkahi ka sabeka kandan, “Ahalen, dumeyi key ubag nikeykew.” Ne mig-uyun si Ilisyu ne egduma kandan. 4 Purisu migdume e sikandin kandan. Te pegginguma ran diye te Weyig ne Hurdan, migbunsud e sikandan ka egpameled te me kayu. 5 Piru te sasangan e sikandan ka egmamepeled, due sabeka kandan ne napesukan te wasey rin wey neulug e diye te weyig. When they arrived at the Jordan River, they started cutting trees. 5 But while they were cutting_trees, one of them pulled_ his _axe_out_of_its_handle and it dropped into the water. 6 Ne mig-inse si Ilisyu, “Hendei neulug?”

6 And Ilisyu asked, “Where did it drop_in?”

Ne impanulu din e sikandin ke hendei seeye neulug. Ne dutu, migtamped te sugpang si Ilisyu, wey in-antug din diye te neuluhan te wasey, wey miggampung e ka wasey.7 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Puruta nud e.” Purisu impurut din e seini.

And he showed him where it dropped_in. And there, Ilisyu cut_off a branch, and threw it into where the axe dropped_in, and the axe floated.7 And Ilisyu said, “Pick_it_up.” Therefore he picked_it_up.

Ka pegkatalu te me sundalu te Sirya

The defeat of the soldiers of Sirya

8 Sabeka ne aldew, migpakiggira te Israil ka Hari te Sirya. Inlibulung din ka me upisyal rin wey ingkahiyan din ke hendei ka naalam din ne egkekampuwan dan.” 9 Piru impanpanayan ni Ilisyu ka Hari te Israil te migkahi, “Kene ka baye te seeye ne inged su diye egkekampu ka Hari te Sirya.” 10 Purisu kamasulug panpanayi te Hari te Israil ka me mahinged dutu sumale te ingkahi ni Ilisyu eyew egpakabantey sikandan.

8 One day, the king of Sirya was at war against Israil. He gathered_together his officers and told (them) where he had chosen that they should set_up their camp.” 9 But Ilisyu warned the king of Israil saying, “Don't pass_through that place because the king of Sirya is_going to camping there.” 10 Therefore the king of Israil warned the inhabitants there many times according to what Ilisyu said so_that they can be_on_guard.

11 Ne nakapabelu seeye te Hari te Sirya. Purisu impeumew rin e ka me upisyal rin te migkahi, “Hentew-a kayi te kaniyu ka egpanugtul te me planu ku diye te Hari te Israil? Hentew-a kaniyu ka eglapig te Hari te Israil?”
