12 Ne migkahi ka sabeka te me upisyal rin, “Ware kayi te kanta Mahal ne Hari. Si Ilisyu ne prupita te Israil ka talagpangguhud te Hari te Israil te langun ne eglalahen nu, minsan ka planu nu te heles de.”

12 Then one of his officers said, “None from us(incl) Beloved king. Ilisyu the prophet is the one telling the king of Israil everything you(sg) say, even your(sg) secret plans.”

13 Ne migsuhu ka Hari te Sirya ne migkahi, “Ke iling ma rue, pammitawa niyu ke hendei sikandin eyew egpakasuhu a te egdakep kandin!”

13 Then the king of Sirya ordered saying, “If so, find_out where he is so_that I can_command the (one/ones who) will_capture him!”

Ne due nakahuhud te Hari ne diye te Dutan si Ilisyu.14 Ne migsuhu e sikandin te migmangudde ne me sundalu wey migmanguntud te karwahi eyew eglingut te siyudad. Marusilem e nenekeuma sikandan. 15 Pegkamaselem, te peglihawang te suluhuanen ni Ilisyu, nakita rin ka me sundalu ne migmangudde wey migmanguntud te karwahi ne nakalingut te siyudad. Ne migkahi e sikandin, “Keyey ahalen! Nekey naan e ka eggimuwen ta?”

And there_was (someone who) told the king that Ilisyu was in Dutan.14 And he commanded soldiers_riding_horses and riding_chariots to surround the city. They arrived at night. 15 The next_morning, when Ilisyu's servant went_out, he saw the soldiers riding_horses and chariots surrounding the city. And he said, “Oh no master! What are we(incl) going to do?”

16 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Kene ka kaaldek su masmasulug pad kandan ka duma ta ne me sundalu!” 17 Ne mig-ampu e si Ilisyu ne migkahi, “Magbebaye ne Manama, bulihi nu ne egkita ka suluhuanen ku.” Ne dutu impakite e kandin te Magbebaye ka bubungan ke hendei sikandan ne neempet te me kudde wey hapuy ne me karwahi ne nakalingut ki Ilisyu.

16 And Ilisyu said, “Don't be_afraid because there are more soldiers with us(incl) than theirs!” 17 Then Ilisyu prayed saying, “Lord God, help my servant to see.” Then the Lord caused_ him _to_see the hill where they are that covered/full with horses and chariots of fire around Ilisyu.

18 Te sasangan e ne egpeendiye te ki Ilisyu ka me kuntere, mig-ampu e sikandin diye te Magbebaye ne migkahi, “Magbebaye, ke egkaayun ne butura nu sikandan.” Ne dutu, nabutud en iya sikandan sumale te imbuyu ni Ilisyu. 19 Ne migparaniyan ni Ilisyu ka me sundalu wey migkahiyan, “Kene ne seini ka dalan peendiye te siyudad. Ikul kew te laheng ku su igpanulud ku sikaniyu diye te etew ne egpamitawen niyu.” Ne in-uyan din e sikandan diye te Samarya.

18 While the enemies were approaching Ilisyu, he prayed to the Lord saying, “Lord, if it's_possible make_ them _blind.” Then, they were indeed blinded according to what Ilisyu asked. 19 Then Ilisyu went to the soldiers and told (them), “This is not the way going to the city. Follow my voice because I'm going to lead you(pl) to the man whom you(pl) are looking_for.” And he took them to Samarya.

20 Te pegginguma ran diye te Samarya, mig-ampu e man-e si Ilisyu ne migkahi, “Magbebaye, ipeyimelat nud e ka me mata ran eyew egpakakite e sikandan.” Ne dutu, impeyimelat e sikandan te Magbebaye wey nakita ran ne diyad e sikandan te taliware te Samarya.

20 When they arrived there in Samarya, Ilisyu prayed again saying, “Lord, cause_ their eyes _to_open so_that they can see.” And there, the Lord caused_ their _eyes_to_open and they saw that they were in the middle of Samarya.

21 Te pegkakita te Hari te Israil kandan, migkahiyan din e si Ilisyu, “Menua, egpangimatayan kud e sikandan?” 22 Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Mahal ne Hari, ka naddakep ta te pegbubunu, ware te ma pangimatayi, iyan naan pa sikandan. Pakeena nu sikandan eyew egpakalibed e sikandan diye te ahalen dan.” 23 Purisu migpaandam te sahakeen ka Hari. Te nekeimpus e sikandan ka migkeen wey mig-inum, impeyipanew rin e sikandan wey impalibed e diye te ahalen dan. Ne pegkapenga dutu, migsanggel pad man-e sikandan miglusud te Israil.

21 When the king of Israil saw them, he said to Ilisyu, “What, should I kill them?” 22 Ilisyu answered, “Beloved king, the ones we(incl) captured when fighting, we(incl) didn't kill (them), how much more of them. Feed(sg) them so_that they can go back to their master.” 23 Therefore the king ordered a feast. When they finished eating and drinking, he let_ them _go and caused_them_back to their master. And after that, they paused fighting again against Israil.

Ka peglusud te Sirya te Samarya

The attacking of Samarya by Sirya

24 Piru nataman, inlibulung ni Hari Bin-Hadad ne Hari te Sirya ka langun ne sundalu rin eyew egpakig-ehet te Israil. Ne miggipanew e sikandan wey miglingutan dan e ka Samarya. 25 Ne puun due, miggingumaan te masumpit ne gutas ka Samarya, su minsan ka ulu te asnu, igbelegye e te me etew te walu ne pulu ne pelata, wey ka sabeka ne sakug ne tei te selepati, igbelegye e te lalimma ne pelata.

24 But then, Bin-Hadad king of Sirya gathered all his soldiers in_order to fight Israil. And they went and surrounded Samarya. 25 And from that, severe famine came to Samarya, because even the head of the donkey, people sell it for eighty silver, and one scoop of dove's dung, (they) sell it for five silver.

26 Sabeka ne aldew, taheed te miggiphipanew ka Hari te Israil diye te alad te siyudad ne batu ne matikang wey makepal, due malitan ne migbalbalukan kandin ne migkahi, “Mahal ne Hari, bulihi a!”

26 One day, while the king of Israil was_walking by on the stone fence of the city which is high and thick, there was a female that's shouting him and said, “Beloved King, help me!”

27 Ne migtabak ka Hari, “Ke kene egbulig ka Magbebaye ne Manama keykew, egmenuwen ku naa te egbulig sikeykew? Ware trigu ku wey binu!” 28 Nataman, mig-inse e ka Hari kandin, “Nekey-a ka igkalaggew nu?”

27 And the king answered, “If the Lord God is not helping you(sg), how can I help you(sg)? I don't have grain and wine!” 28 Then, the king asked her, “What's your(sg) worry?”

Migtabak ka malitan, “Migkahi ka seini ne malitan te egkeenen ney kun ka anak ku kuntee, ne seup ne aldew, ka kandin e degma.29 Sikan naa ka inggilutu ney e ka anak ku wey ingkeen ney e. Te seup e ne aldew, migkahiyan ku sikandin te anak din e degma ka egkeenen ney, piru inggeles din e ka kandin.”

The woman answered, “This woman said that we(incl) will_eat my child now, and next day, hers also.29 So we(incl) cooked my child and we(incl) ate him/her. Next day, I told her that we(incl) will_eat her child also, but she hid him/her.”

30 Te pegkarineg te Hari te inlalag te malitan, imbindas din e ka kumbale din. Neyitabu seeye te sasangan pad sikandin ka miggipanew diye te batu ne alad te siyudad ne matikang wey makepal. Ne nakita sikandin te me etew ne migsaluub te saku[fn] ne migpariralem te kumbale din. 31 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Eglegparan a perem te Manama ke kene ku egkatamperan te ulu si Ilisyu ne anak ni Sapat te seini ne aldew.” 32 Te seeye ne timpu, diye si Ilisyu te baley rin duma te me impurtanti ne igbuyag te Israil. Migsuhu ka Hari te sabeka ne etew diye te ki Ilisyu. Piru te ware pad migginguma ka suluhuanen ne insuhu te Hari, migkahiyan e ni Ilisyu ka me igbuyag, “Pitew kew, migsuhu ka mangngimatey ne Hari ne igpatamped ka ulu ku. Emun ke eglepew ka suluhuanen ne insuhu din, ilekeb niyu ka gumawan wey kene niyu sikandin paselera su migsinundul kandin ka Hari.” 33 Piru taheed te sasangan pad sikandin ka egpangasak, miggingume e ka suluhuanen wey ingguhud din e ka inlalag te Hari, “Ka seini ne karereetan, diye egpuun te Magbebaye ne Manama! Mania te egpabulus e pad ka egtetahad te bulig din?”

30 When the king heard what the woman said, he tore his clothes. It happened while he was still walking by on the stone fence of the city which is high and thick. And the people saw him that he wore sack[fn] under his clothing. 31 And he said, “God will_punish me if I can't cut Ilisyu's head the child of Sapat on this day.” 32 At that time, Ilisyu was in his house with the important elders of Israil. And the king sent a man to Ilisyu. But before the servant that commanded by the king arrive, Ilisyu said to the elders, “Look(pl), the murderer king sent ordered (someone) to cut my head. When the servant that he commanded arrives, close the door and don't (allow) him to enter because the king follow_behind him.” 33 But while he was still speaking, the messenger came and reported that the king says, “This destruction, comes from the Lord God! Why should I continue waiting for his help?”

71 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Pamineha nu ka inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama: Te iling ded ne uras kayi kaaselem, igbelegye naan de diye te palingkiyan te Samarya ka senge-hantang ne harina te sabeka ne pelata wey ka daruwa ne gantang ne sibada te iling ded ne kentiddad.”

71 And Ilisyu said, “Listen(sg) to what_the_ Lord God _said: At this same hour here tomorrow, one measure of flour will_be_sold there at the market in Samarya for just one silver (coin) and two measures of barley for just the same price.”

2 Piru migkahiyan si Ilisyu te kepitan ne duma te Hari, “Egbusbusen naa te Manama ka egkakeen puun te langit? Kene egkeyitabu ka ingkahi nu!”

2 But the captain who was the companion of the king said to Ilisyu, “Is God going to pour_down food from heaven? What_ you(sg) _said won't happen!”

Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Egkakita nu seini piru kene ka egpakakeen kayi.”

And Ilisyu answered, “You(sg) will_see this but you(sg) won't be_able_to_eat it.”

3 Ne due hep-at ne ibungen diye te lihawangan te gumawan te siyudad. Migpalalahey sikandan ne migkahi, “Mania te egpinpinnuu ki re kayi te egpatey ki man ded? 4 Ke egseled ki te siyudad, egkapatey ki te gutas, wey emun ke kayi ki re man-e egpinpinnuu, iling ded iya man-e. Meupiya pad ke eggendiye ki te kampu te matig-Sirya, ne emun ke kene ki eggimatayan, egkeuyag ki. Piru ke eggimatayan ki nikandan, ne egpatey ki ma iya.” 5 Ne hengkayi te egpangilumkilum e, migligkat e sikandan ka eggendiye te kampu te matig-Sirya. Piru te pegginguma ran diye, warad e me etew. 6 Tenged su imparineg sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama te dahing te me karwahi wey me kudde wey masulug ne me sundalu, nakakahi ka tagse sabeka kandan, “Pitew kew, imbayaran e te Hari te Israil ka me Hari te Hitihanen wey te Ihiptuhanen eyew egpakig-ehet kanta.” 7 Purisu te egkasagkup e, migpamallahuy e sikandan wey impangengkeran dan e ka me balungbalung dan, me kudde dan, wey ka me asnu ran. Nangawe sikandan diye te kampu ne ware nanguwa te minsan nekey ne kasangkapan dan.

3 And there_were four lepers there outside the gate of the city. They talked_to_each_other and said, “Why are we(incl) just sitting here for we(incl) will_die still? 4 If we(incl) enter the city, we(incl) will_die of hunger, and if we(incl) stay sitting here, it'll be just the same as_well. It's better if we(incl) go_there to the base_camp of the (ones) from_Sirya, and if we(incl) are_ not _killed, we(incl) will_live. But if we(incl) are killed by_them, then we(incl) will_die anyway.” 5 And when it_started_getting_dark, they left to go to the base_camp of the (ones) from_Sirya. But upon their arrival there, there_were_no people. 6 Because the Lord caused_them_heard the sound of chariots and horses and many soldiers, each one of them said,“Look(pl), the kings of Hitihanon and of Ihiptuhanon paid already by the king of Israil in_order to fight (against) us(incl).” 7 Therefore at dusk, they fled and left their tents, horses, and donkeys. They left the camp without taking any of their belongings.

8 Te pegginguma te me ibungen diye te kampu, migseled e sikandan te hun-a ne balungbalung. Ne migkeen e sikandan wey mig-inum e wey impanguyan dan e ka me pelata, me bulawan, wey me kumbale ne nakita ran. Ne miglihawang e sikandan wey impangeles dan e seeye. Nataman, migseled e man-e sikandan diye te lein ne balungbalung wey iling ded ka inggimu ran. 9 Nataman, migpalalahey e sikandan ne miggenendue, “Kene ne meupiya seini se eggimuwen ta. Su ka seini ne aldew, aldew te meupiya ne panugtulen, ne ware ta mule iwangal-wangal. Emun ke egpasigpawaan te pad seini, kema ke eglegparan ki. Kuwa kid e, eglibed ki diye te siyudad eyew igpanengneng seini diye te me upisyal te Hari.” 10 Purisu miglibed sikandan diye te siyudad wey inlalahan dan e ka me talagtameng te gumawan te siyudad te miggenendue, “Miggendiye key te kampu te me matig-Sirya, wey ware minsan sabeka ne nakita wey narineg ney diye! Me kudde naan de wey me asnu ne impangiket, wey ware nabalbalawi ka me balungbalung.”

8 When the lepers came to the camp, they entered into the first tent. And they eat and drink and they took silver(pl), gold(pl), and clothes that they saw. And they went_out and hid those (stuffs). Then, they entered into another tent and did the same thing. 9 Then, they talked_to_each_other saying, “What we(incl) did is not right. Because this day, is day of the good news, and yet we(incl) didn't tell_ it _openly. If we(incl) let this until_morning, what if we(incl) will_be_punished. Come(incl), let's(incl) return to the city in_order_to make_(it)_known to the king's officials.” 10 Therefore they went_back to the city and they told the guards of the city gate that goes, “We(excl) went to the camp of the (ones) from_Sirya, and we(excl) didn't even see or hear anyone there! Only horses and donkeys are tied, and the tents stay as they were (LIT nothing change at all).”

11 Te sikan de, migbalbalukan e ka me talagtameng te gumawan te siyudad ne migpangguhud diye te me etew. Ne ka guhuren, nekeyinguma diye te palasyu. 12 Ne mig-enew ka Hari te seeye ne marusilem wey migkahiyan din ka me upisyal rin, “Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te planu te matig-Sirya. Nakataha sikandan ne egpanggutasan ki, sikan naa ka mig-awe e sikandan diye te me balungbalung dan wey miggeles e diye te me kamet su mig-isip sikandan ne eglihawang ki te siyudad ka egpamitew te egkeenen ta, ne egpandakepen kid e nikandan wey eg-ahawen dan e ka siyudad.”

11 At once, the guards of the city called_out telling the people. And the news/story, reached to the palace. 12 And the king got_up that night and said to his officers, “I will_tell you(pl) what the (ones) from_Sirya have plan. They know that we(incl) are starving, that's why they left their tents and hid there in the fields because they were thinking that we(incl) will_go_out the city to find food_to_eat, and_then they will_capture us(incl) and take_away/grab the city.”

13 Ne migtabak ka sabeka te me upisyal rin, “Duen ma iya kudde ta ne nasame diye te siyudad. Suhu ke naa te me etew ne egpepanguddeen te lalimma ne me kudde eyew egleuy diye. Ne balahad e ke eggimatayan sikandan, su iling man ded ke eg-uugpe sikandan kayi, egpatey man ded duma kanta. Ne egpitawen te naa ke nekey ka egkeyitabu.” 14 Purisu mig-alam sikandan te daruwa ne etew ne eg-untud te karwahi. Insuhu sikandan te Hari ne egpanengnengen ke nekey ka neyitabu te me sundalu te Sirya. 15 Ne in-ikul ran e ka nabayaan te me matig-Sirya taman diye te Weyig ne Hurdan, wey nakita ran ka natalagtag ne me kumbale wey me kasangkapan diye te dalan ne neengkeran te me matig-Sirya ne migpamallahuy. Ne miglibed e ka daruwa ne me suluhuanen ne insuhu wey impangguhuran dan e ka Hari. 16 Ne dutu, miglihawang e ka me etew wey impanguwa ran e ka me kasangkapan diye te kampu te matig-Sirya. Ne ka senge-hantang ne harina wey ka daruwa ne gantang ne sibada, igbelegye naan de te sabeka ne pelata sumale te ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama.

13 And one of his officers answered, “We(incl) have horses left in the city. Order (some) men to ride_ five _horses in_order to check there. And never mine if they die, because it's the same_thing if they stay here, they will_still_die with us(incl). And we(incl) will_see what happen.” 14 Therefore they chose two men to ride the chariots. They were ordered by the king to check what happened to the soldiers of Sirya. 15 And they followed the pathway of the (ones) from_Sirya until River Hurdan, and they saw scattered clothes and things/possessions on the road that were left by the (people) from_Sirya when running_away. And the two servants who were sent returned and told the king. 16 So then, the people went_out and took the possessions in the camp of the (ones) from_Sirya. And one measure of flour and two measures of barley, sold for one silver according to what the Lord God said.

17 Ne in-alam e te Hari ka sinalihan din ne upisyal ne iyan egpatamengen te gumawan te siyudad. Piru insusukeung de sikandin wey indiri-diekan te me etew diye te gumawan, wey migpatey iya sikandin sumale te ingkahi te prupita ne si Ilisyu te timpu ne miggendiye te baley rin ka Hari. 18 Su migkahiyan te prupita ka Hari, “Te iling ded ne uras kayi kaaselem, igbelegye naan de diye te palingkiyan te Samarya ka senge-hantang ne harina te sabeka ne pelata, wey ka daruwa ne gantang ne sibada te iling ded ne kentiddad.” 19 Ne migkahi ka upisyal diye te ki Ilisyu, “Egbusbusen naa te Manama ka egkakeen puun te langit? Kene egkeyitabu ka ingkahi nu!” Piru migtabak si Ilisyu, “Egkakita nu seini piru kene nu egkaheraman ka ingkahi ku ne keenen.” 20 Ne seeye iya ka neyitabu kandin, insukeung wey indi-diekan sikandin te me etew wey migpatey e.

17 Then the king choose his trusted_servant to guard the city gate. But he was banged_into and trampled by the people in the gate, and he indeed died according to what the prophet Ilisyu said at the time when the king went to his house. 18 Because the prophet said to the king, “The same hour tomorrow, one measure of flour will_be_sold in the market for one silver, and the two measure of barley for the same (price).” 19 And the officer said to the king, “Is God going to pour_down food from heaven? What_ you(sg) _said won't happen!” But Ilisyu answered, “You(sg) will_see this but you(sg) can't taste the food that I am_talking_about.” 20 And indeed that's what happened to him, he was banged_into and trampled by the people and died.

Ka peglibed te malitan ne matig-Sunam

The returning of the woman from_Sunam

81 Sabeka ne timpu, migkahiyan ni Ilisyu ka malitan ne matig-Sunam ne in-uyag din se anak, “Awe ka duma te pamilya nu, wey hendiye kew te inged ne igkeupii niyu, tenged su migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama te due egginguma ne gutas te seini ne inged seled te pitu ne leg-un.” 2 Ne migpalintutuu ka malitan ki prupita Ilisyu, wey miggipanew e sikandin duma te pamilya rin wey diye mig-ugpe te inged te me Pilistihanen seled te pitu ne leg-un.

81 One day, Ilisyu said to the woman from_Sunam whose child he had brought_back_to_life, “Go(sg) with your(sg) family, and go to a place you(pl) like, because the Lord God said that there will_be_famine in this place within seven years.” 2 And the woman agreed prophet Ilisyu, and she went along_with her family and lived there in the place of the Pilistihanons for (LIT inside) seven years.

3 Pegkapenga te pitu ne leg-un ne gutas, miglibed e ka malitan diye te Israil puun te inged te me Pilistihanen. Ne miggipanew e sikandin peendiye te Hari ka egpeyid-u-hid-u ne iglibed ded diye te kandin ka baley rin wey ka tane din. 4 Te seeye ne timpu, migpakiglalag ka Hari ki Gihasi ne suluhuanen ni Ilisyu. Ne migkahi ka Hari, “Guhuri e la te me kein-inuwan ne neyimu ni Ilisyu.” 5 Te sasangan pad ne egpangguhud si Gihasi te Hari meyitenged te bate ne in-uyag ni Ilisyu, sahuhune ne miglepew ka malitan ne iney te bate, wey migpeyid-u-hid-u te Hari ne eggawi te baley wey tane din. Kahi ni Gihasi, “Mahal ne Hari, seini iya ka malitan, wey seini ka anak din ne in-uyag ni Ilisyu.” 6 Ne mig-insaan e te Hari ka malitan meyitenged te neyitabu te anak din, wey impangguhuran din e ka Hari. Puun dutu, migsuhu ka Hari te upisyal rin ne iyan eg-atiman te malitan. Migkahi sikandin, “Ilibed nu ka langun ne kandin, minsan ka kentiddad te nenaggaani puun te aldew ne mig-awe sikandin taman kuntee.”

3 After seven years of famine, the woman returned to Israil from the place of the Pilistihanons. And she travels towards_there to the king to beg to give_back there to her the house of her and the land/soil of her. 4 At that time, the king was talking to Gihasi the servant of Ilisyu. The king said, “Tell me the wonders that Ilisyu did.” 5 While Gihasi was still telling the king about the child that Ilisyu had brought_back_to_life, suddenly the woman whose the mother of the child came, and begged the king to take_back her house and land/soil. Gihasi said, “Beloved King, this is the woman, and this is the child that Ilisyu had brought_back_to_life.” 6 And the king asked the woman about what_happened to her child, and she told the king. From that, the king ordered his officer to take_care of the woman. He said, “Return all of hers, even the value of what's harvested from the day she left until today.”

Miggimatayan ni Hasail si Bin-Hadad

Hasail kills Bin-Hadad

7 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye si Ilisyu te Damasku. Te seeye ne timpu migderalu si Hari Bin-Hadad ne Hari te Sirya, wey nakahiyan sikandin te egginguma si Ilisyu. 8 Ne migkahiyan te Hari si Hasail, ka sabeka te me upisyal rin, “Uyan ka te dasag ne ibehey nu ki Ilisyu. Ne peinsei nu naa kandin ka Magbebaye ne Manama ke egkeulian naan pad kayi ka dalu ku.” 9 Purisu miggipanew e si Hasail ka mig-uyan te langun ne kasangkapan wey egkakeen puun te Damasku ne indulan din te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne kamil. Te nekeume e si Hasail diye te ki Ilisyu, migkahi e sikandin, “Insuhu a te suluhuanen nu ne si Hari Bin-Hadad, ka Hari te Sirya ne egpeinseen keykew ke egkeulian kun naam pad sikandin te dalu rin?”

7 One day, Ilisyu went to Damasku. At that time King Binhadad the king of Sirya was sick, and he was_told that Ilisyu is_coming. 8 And the king said to Hasail, one of his officers, “Take(sg) a gift and give it to Ilisyu. And let him ask the Lord God if I will_be_cured of this my illness.” 9 Therefore Hasail left taking all possessions and food from Damasku and he loads (them) to forty (40) camels. When Hasail came to Ilisyu, he said, “I was_sent by your(sg) servant King Binhadad, the king of Sirya to ask you(sg) if he will_be_cured from his illness?”

10 Ne migtabak si Ilisyu, “Hendiye kad e wey kahii nu sikandin te egkeulian ded sikandin, piru impakite e keddiey te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkapatey red iya sikandin.” 11 Ne migmemetmetan ni Ilisyu si Hasail taman te neyilew e sikandin. Ne sahuhune ne migpandalawit si Ilisyu. 12 Ne mig-insaan ni Hasail si Ilisyu, “Mania te migpandalawit ka, ahalen?”

10 And Ilisyu answered, “Go(sg) and tell him that he will_be_healed, but the Lord God showed me that he will_ indeed _die.” 11 Then Ilisyu stared_at Hasail until he was embarrassed. Then suddenly Ilisyu wept. 12 Hasail asked Ilisyu, “Why are you(sg) weeping, master?”

Migtabak si Ilisyu, “Uya su natahaan ku ka makaliyas-liyas ne eggimuwen nu te me kabuhalan ni Israil. Egpanilaban nu ka kampu ney, wey egpangimatayan nu ka me kanakan ney pinaahi te kampilan, wey egpanulengen nu ka me bate wey egpangebuan nu ka egkengaberes pad.”

Ilisyu answered, “Because I know the terrible_things you(sg) will_do to Israil's descendants. You(sg) will_burn our(excl) camp, and you(sg) will_kill our(excl) young_men by the sword, and you(sg) will_strike the children and you(sg) will_rip_open the pregnant(pl).”

13 Piru migkahi si Hasail, “Ahalen, egmenuwen ku te eggimu te iling due? Suluhuanen e re seini!”

13 But Hasail said, “Master, how can I do that? I am just a servant!”

Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Impakita keddiey te Magbebaye ne egkeyimu ka ne Hari te Sirya.”

And Ilisyu said, “The Lord showed it to me that you(sg) will_become_king of Sirya.”

14 Sikan naa ka mig-engkeran din e si Ilisyu wey miglibed e diye te ahalen din. Ne mig-insaan e sikandin, “Nekey-a ka ingkahi ni Ilisyu?” Migtabak sikandin, “Migkahiyan a nikandin te egkeulian ke red.” 15 Piru te seup ne aldew, migkuwa sikandin te makepal ne hinabel, wey insubid din. Ne dutu, imbunbunan din e ka ulaula te Hari taman te migpatey. Sikan naa ka si Hasail e ka nakasubal kandin ne mighari.

14 So then he left Ilisyu and went_back to his master. And he was asked, “What did Ilisyu said?” He answered, “He told me that you(sg) will_get well.” 15 But on the next day, he got a thick cloth, and he soaked_it_in_water. And there, he covered the face of the king until he died. That's why Hasail was the one kinging in his place.

Ka peghari ni Hihuram te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Hihuram

(2 Kru 21:1‑20)

(2 Chr 21:1‑20)

Ataliya was his mother a grandchild of Umbri the king of Israil. 27 He still followed the deeds of the family of Ahab and his deeds/acts were bad/evil in_front of the Lord God, because his deeds was evil like the deeds of his father-in-law Ahab. 28 Then Ahasiyas accompanied Huram the child of Ahab to_fight_against Hasail the king of Sirya. Ka peg-alam ki Hihu ne eghari te Israil

91 Ne impeumew ni prupita Ilisyu ka sabeka te me prupita wey migkahiyan, “Pangandam ka, uyana nu diye te Ramut-Gilyad seini se banga ne due lana. 2 Ne emun ke egpekeuma kad e diye, pamitawa nu naa si Hihu ne apu ni Hihusapat, ne anak ni Nimsi. Kahii nu sikandin te egpaaween puun te me duma rin wey parumaa nu sikandin keykew diye te sinabeng. 3 Ne kua nu naa ka banga ne due lana, wey itisi nu ka ulu rin wey kahii nu, ‘Migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “In-alam ku sikeykew ne eghari te Israil.” ’ Ne emun ke egpekeimpus kad e, kene kad lamu-lamu, wey dagdahew kad hipanew.” 4 Purisu miggendiyad e te Ramut-Gilyad ka kanakan ne prupita. 5 Pegginguma rin diye, nalibulung e ka me ahalen te me sundalu. Ne migkahiyan din sikandan, “Due pangguhuren ku keykew ahalen!”

91 And Ilisyu called for one of the prophets and said, “Prepare(sg), take this jar that has oil to Ramut-Gilyad. 2 And when you(sg) arrive there, look for Hihu the child of Hihusapat, the grandchild of Nimsi. Tell him to leave from his companions and let him accompany you(sg) there to a room. 3 Then take the jar that has oil, and pour his head and tell him, ‘The Lord God said, “I chose you(sg) to be king of Israil.” ’ And when you(sg) are done, don't delay, and go(sg) quickly.” 4 That's why the young prophet went to Ramut Giliyad. 5 When he arrived there, the leaders of the soldiers were already gathered_together. And he said to them, “I have message to you(sg) sir!”

Ne mig-inse si Hihu, “Hentew-a kanami?”

And Hihu answered, “Which of us(excl)?”

Ne migtabak ka prupita, “Sikeykew.”6 Sikan naa, migsasindeg si Hihu wey migseled te baley duma te kanakan, wey in-itisan e te kanakan te lana ka ulu ni Hihu wey migkahiyan, “Seini ka inlalag te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil, ‘In-alam ku sikeykew ne eghari te keet-etawan ku ne matig-Israil. 7 Himatayi nu ka ahalen nu ne Hari, ne anak ni Ahab, eyew egkasulian ku si Hisibil ka migpangimatey te me suluhuanen ku ne me prupita wey te duma ne me suluhuanen ku. 8 Su keilangan ne egpatey ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Ahab. Eggimatayan ku ka langun ne me lukes kayi te Israil, uripen ma wey se kene ne uripen. 9 Eggimuwen ku ka me kabuhalan ni Ahab ne egpekeiling te me kabuhalan ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat, wey egpekeiling te me kabuhalan ni Baasa ne anak ni Ahiha. 10 Egkeenen te me asu ka lawa ni Hisibil diye te tane te Hisriil wey ware egpakalebeng kandin.’ ” Nataman miglihawang e ka kanakan ne prupita wey migpallahuy e.

And the prophet said, “You(sg).”6 So then, Hihu stood_up and entered into the room with the young_man, and Hihu's head was_being_poured with oil by the young_man saying, “This is what the Lord God, the God of Israil said, ‘I chose you(sg) to_king my people from_Israil. 7 Kill the king your(sg) master, the child of Ahab, so_that I will_revenge Hisibil the one killing my servants prophets and my other servants. 8 Because it's_necessary that all descendants of Ahab will_die. I will_kill all males here in Israil, slaves and not (slaves). 9 I will_make the descendants of Ahab like the descendants of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat, and like the descendants of Baasa the child of Ahiha. 10 Hisibil's body will_be_eaten by the dogs there in the land of Hisriil and no (one) can_bury her.’ ” Then the young prophet came_out and ran_away.

Ka peggimatey ki Rayna Hisibil

30 Ne miggendiyad e si Hihu te Hisriil. Te pegkarineg ni Hisibil meyitenged kayi, mighimhimasad e sikandin wey migsulew diye te bintana. 31 Te pegseled e ni Hihu te gumawan te siyudad, migbalukan e si Hisibil ka migkahi, “Hey! Nataman migkahi e sikandin, “Kua niyu sika se indilus ne malitan wey ilebeng niyu su anak sikandin te Hari!” 35 Piru hengkayi te egkuen dan e ka lawa te minatey eyew iglebeng, warad e lein ne nasame te lawa rin, iyan naan de ka tul-an te ulu rin, tul-an te me paa, wey tul-an te me belad din. 36 Purisu miglibed e sikandan wey migpangguhuran dan e si Hihu. Ne migkahi si Hihu, “Seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama ne inlalag te suluhuanen din ne si Ilisyu ne matig-Tisbi, ‘Egkeenen te me asu ka sapu ni Hisibil diye te inged te Hisriil. 37 Ne egkalagtag ka egkasame ne lawa rin iling te tei diye te tane eyew ware egpekeila ne si Hisibil bes seini.’ ”

30 Then Hihu went to Hisriil. When Hisibil heard about this, she made_herself_beautiful and look_out in the window. 31 When Hihu entered the door of the city, Hisibil shouted saying, “Hey! You(sg) who are_like Simbri who killed his master, is your(sg) purpose of coming here good?” 32 Then Hihu looked_up at the window and called_out, “Who among you(sg) is on_ my _side?” And there were two or three officers look_ him _out in the window. 33 And Hihu said, “Throw_ her _down!” Therefore they threw_ Hisabil _down; and her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses, and she was stampled by the horses. 34 And Hihu entered into the palace and he ate and drank. Then he said, “Take that cursed woman and bury her because she was a king's child!” 35 But when they were about to take the body of the dead to bury (her), nothing left of her body, only the bone of her head, bones of (her) feet, and bones of (her) hands. 36 Therefore they went_back and told Hihu. Then Hihu said, “This is what the Lord God said to his servant Ilisyu from_Tisbi, ‘Hisibil's flesh will_be_eaten by the dogs in the place of Hisriil. 37 The remainder of her body will_be_scattered like dung on the ground so_that no_one recognize that it is Hisibil.’ ”

Impangimatayan ka me kabuhalan ni Ahab

Purisu impeuyanan ni Hihu te me sulat ka me talagmandu, wey me ahalen, lagkes ka me talagbantey te kabuhalan ni Ahab. 2 Migkahi sikandin diye te sulat din, “Sikaniyu ka me talagtameng te kabuhalan te me Hari, te me karwahi ran, te me kudde dan, te me panganiban dan, wey te me siyudad ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu. Purisu, te pegkarawat niyu te seini ne sulat, 3 alam kew te subla ne meupiya wey subla ne manekal ne kabuhalan te Hari wey himuwa niyu ne Hari. Ne pakigbunu kew ka egpangabang kandin.” 4 Amana naaldek ka me pangulu wey migkahi, “Ke ware sikandin natalu ni Hari Huram wey ni Hari Ahasiyas, iyan ki naan pa iya?” 5 Sikan naa ka migpeuyan te guhuren diye ki Hihu ka impiyalan te palasyu wey ka impiyalan te siyudad wey ka duma ne me talagmandu wey me pangulu ne migkahi, “Me suluhuanen key nikeykew, eggimuwen ney ke nekey ka igkeupii nu. Piru kene key eg-alam te Hari, sikan naa, himuwa nu ka minsan nekey ne insuman-suman nu ne eleg ne eggimuwen.”

101 There were seventy (70) descendants of Ahab who lived in the city of Samarya. Therefore Hihu sent a letter to the rulers, and masters, including the watchers/guardians of Ahab's descendants. 2 He said in his letter, “You(pl) (are) the guardians of the king's descendants, his chariots, his horses, their weapons, and of the city that is fenced by a high and thick stone. Therefore, when you(sg) received this letter, 3 select the very good and very strong descendants of the king and make him the king. And fight(pl) to defend him.” 4 The rulers were so afraid and said, “If King Huram and King Ahasiya didn't able_to_defeat him, how can we(excl)?” 5 So then the_one in_charge_of the palace and the_one in_charge_of the city and the other rulers and leaders sent a message to Hihu that said, “We(excl) are your(sg) servant, we(excl) will_do whatever you(sg) like. But we(excl) do not choose a king, so then, do whatever you(sg) think that's correct to do.”

6 Purisu migpeuyan si Hihu te igkarangeb ne sulat ne miggenendue, “Emun ke eglapig kew iya keddi, wey andam ne egtuman keddiey, tamperi niyu te me ulu ka me kabuhalan ni Ahab wey uyana niyu kayi te keddi te Hisriil kaaselem te iling ded kayi ne uras.”

6 Therefore Hihu sent his second letter that says, “If you(pl) are really on_ my _side, and ready to obey me, cut the head of Ahab's descendants and bring (them) to me at Hisriil tomorrow at this hours.”

Ne kuntee, intanggu e te me pangulu te siyudad te Samarya seeye se pitu ne pulu (70) ne me kabuhalan ni Ahab.

And now, those seventy (70) descendants of Ahab brought up by the leaders of the city Samarya.

7 Te narawat e te me talagmandu ka sulat ni Hihu, migpangimatayan dan e ka pitu ne pulu (70) ne kabuhalan ni Ahab wey intahu dan te me baskit ka me ulu ran wey impeuyan dan e diye ki Hihu diye te Hisriil.

7 When the rulers received Hihu's letter, they killed (all) seventy (70) of Ahab's descendants and they put them their heads in the baskets and sent them to Hihu in Hisriil.

Ne nangendiye ka langun ne egsimba ki Baal, wey ware nasame. And no one will_be_left_out because I'm going to offer a great offering to Baal. I will_kill (anyone) who does not come_here.” However this (was) only Hihu's cunning_plan so_that he can_kill all that worship Baal. 20 So then, Hihu ordered saying, “Let's(pl) gather_together to worship Baal!” Therefore they indeed made_it_known. 21 Hihu informed all people in entire Israil. And all who worship Baal went there, and there_was_no (one) remaining. Na, puun kuntee kene niyud gamita ka seleppi te kaniyu ne keilangan. Keilangan ne egkahamit sika te peg-ayad-ayad te timplu.” 8 Ne mig-uyun ka me talagpanubad ne kenad e ne sikandan ka egdawat te pelata, wey kenad ne sikandan ka impiyalan te peg-ayad-ayad te timplu.

6 But it reached twenty three (23) years of kinging by King Huwas, not even one part of the temple repaired. 7 Therefore Huwas summoned Hihuyada the sacrificer and (those) other sacrificers and said, “Why haven't you(pl) repaired the temple? Now, from now_on don't use the money for your(pl) (own) needs. It should be used for repairing the temple.” 8 And the sacrificers agreed that they would not accept/collect the silver, and they would not be the ones entrusted/in-charge of repairing the temple.

9 Ne migkuwa si Hihuyada te kehun wey inlungahan din ka suppe, wey intahu din seini diye te igkakawanan te panubaran diye te timplu te Magbebaye. Emun ke due egbehey te seleppi diye te timplu, ka me talagpanubad e ne migbantey te gumawan te timplu ka egtahu dutu diye te kehun. 10 Ne emun ke egkapenu e ka kehun, egseelen e te labew ne talagpanubad wey te sikritari te Hari ka seleppi wey igpanahu dan e te me puyungut. 11 Egkataman, igbehey ran e ka pelata diye te me etew ne impiyalan te peg-ayad-ayad te timplu te Magbebaye. Ne duen dan e egkua ka igbayad te me panday wey te me trabahanti, 12 te me masun, wey me talagperi te batu. Ne duen e degma egkua ka igbeli te me kayu, me sinapsapan ne batu ne egkeilanganen te peg-ayad-ayad te timplu, wey te duma pad ne galastuwan. 13 Piru ware sikandan miggamit te sika ne pelata eyew te peggimu te pelenggana ne pelata, te igpanempug te me pebilu te sulu, me yahung wey ke trumpita naa, wey ke duma pad iling te bulawan wey ke pelata naa. 14 Imbehey ran langun seini te seeye se eg-ayad-ayad te timplu te Magbebaye. 15 Ne ware dan e insa a ke immenu te eggastu ka me pelata te seeye se imbeheyan dan te seleppi, tenged su egkengasalihan ma sikandan. 16 Ka inhalad ne pelata puun te sale ne ware tuyui, wey te sale ne intuyuan, warad e uyana diye te timplu su para seini te me talagpanubad.

9 Then Hihuyada took a box and he made_a_hole in the lid, and he put it in the right_side of the altar in the temple of the Lord. If someone gives money to the temple, the sacrificers who guards at the door of the temple were the ones to put (it) in the box. 10 And if the box was full, the high sacrificer and the secretary of the king will_count the money and they put it in the bags/pouch. 11 Then, they will_give the silver to the people who are_entrusted/in-charge to_repair the temple of the Lord. They will_get_out of it what_to_pay the carpenters and workers, 12 masons, and stone cutters. And also they_will_get out_of_it what_to_buy woods, whittled stones that needed to repair the temple, and other expenses. 13 But they didn't use that money to make silver basin, cutters of the light wick, bowls or trumpet, or other things like gold or silver. 14 They gave it all to the ones who repair the temple of the Lord. 15 And they didn't ask how the silver spent by those (people) to whom they given the money, because they were trustworthy. 16 The silver offering for unintentional sin, and for the intentional sin, wasn't brought to the temple because it was for the sacrificers.

17 Te seeye ne timpu, inlusuran ni Hasail ne Hari te Sirya ka inged ne Gat wey naahew rin iya seini. Te pegkeimpus dutu, migpabulus e sikandin diye te Hirusalim eyew iyan din e man-e eglusuran. 18 Piru impanguwa ni Hari Huwas ka langun ne inhalad diye te Magbebaye te kaap-apuan din ne si Hihusapat, Hihuram, wey ni Ahasiyas ne me Hari dengan te Huda, lagkes ka me dasag din mismu, wey ka langun ne bulawan ne diye nakatahu te timplu wey te palasyu wey imbehey rin e diye te ki Hasail. Purisu warad e migpabulus miglusud si Hasail diye te Hirusalim.

17 At that time, Hasail the king of Sirya attacked the place of Gat and he indeed seized it. After that, he continued to go_there to Hirusalim for invading it. 18 But King Huwas took all the offerings to the Lord of his ancestors Hihusapat, Hihuram, and Ahasiya the kings of Huda before, including his own gifts, and all the gold that had_been_stored in the temple and the palace and he gave (it) there to Hasail. Therefore Hasail didn't continue to_invade Hirusalim.

19 Ka duma pad ne himu ni Huwas, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda.

19 The rest of Huwas' deeds, were_written in the writing_document of the kings of Huda.

20 Te katammanan, implanuwan si Huwas te mareet te me upisyal rin, wey inggimatayan dan e sikandin diye te Bit-Milu, ka dalan peendiye te Sila. 21 Ensi Husakar ne anak ni Simit wey si Husabat ne anak ni Sumir ka miggimatey kandin. Ne diye dan sikandin ilebeng te Hirusalim duma te me kaap-apuan din. Ne si Amasiyas ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

20 At the end, Huwas officers planned evil against him, and they killed him in Bit-Milu, while going to Sila. 21 He was_killed by Husakar the child of Simit and Husabat the child of Sumir. And he was_buried with his ancestors in Hirusalim. And Amasiyas his child replaced him to reign.

Ka peghari ni Huwakas te Israil

The kinging of Israil by Huwakas

131 Te igkararuwa ne pulu wey tatelu (23) e ne leg-un te peghari ni Huwas ne anak ni Ahasiyas diye te Huda, migbunsud e degma mighari si Huwakas ne anak ni Hihu diye te Israil wey diye te Samarya ka ugpaan din te mighari. Ne mighari sikandin te sapulu wey pitu (17) ne leg-un diye te Samarya. 2 Mareet ka hinimuwan ni Huwakas diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, mig-ilingan din ka mareet ne hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat ne iyan egpuunan ne nakasale ka me matig-Israil. 3 Purisu nabelu ka Magbebaye te me matig-Israil, ne puun due layun din e sikandan ipatalu ki Hasail ne Hari te Sirya wey nataman diyad e man-e te anak din ne si Bin-Hadad. 4 Ne migpeyid-u-hid-u si Huwakas diye te Magbebaye wey imbulihan iya sikandan tenged su neyid-u ka Magbebaye kandan te imbaybayaran te Hari te Sirya. 5 Purisu impeuyanan te Magbebaye te talagluwas ka me matig-Israil, wey naluwas iya sikandan puun te matig-Sirya. Purisu migmalinawen e ka me matig-Israil iling te dengan. 6 Piru minsan pad due, migpabulus ded sikandan ka miggimu te sale iling te hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam ne iyan migpuunan ne nakasale ka me matig-Israil. Ne ware dan degma awaa ka sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira diye te Samarya.

131 In the twenty-third (23) year of kinging by Huwas child of Ahasiyas there in Huda, Huwakas child of Hihu began also to_king in Israil and Samarya was his living_place of reigning. And he reigned there in Samarya for seventeen (17) years. 2 Huwakas deeds in front of the Lord God were evil, he imitated the wicked deeds of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat which was the reasoned that the (ones) from_Israil have_sinned. 3 Therefore the Lord was angry with the (ones) from_Israil, and from that he repeatedly caused_them_to_be_defeated by Hasail the king of Sirya and then to his child Bin-Hadad. 4 And Huwakas begged the Lord and indeed they were_given_helped because the Lord pitied them that were_oppressed by the king of Sirya. 5 Therefore the Lord sent a savior of the (ones) from_Israil, and indeed they were save from the (ones) from_Sirya. Therefore the (ones) from_Israil were peaceful like before. 6 But even that, they continued doing evil like the deeds of Hirubuwam which was the reasoned the (ones) from_Israil sinned. And they didn't take_away the pillar that's image of Asira there in Samarya.

7 Ne nasamaan naan de si Huwakas te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne sundalu ne migpangude, sapulu ne karwahi wey sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne me sundalu ne miggipanew, su impangimatayan man e ka me duma ran te Hari te Sirya, wey indi-diekan de iling te alinepung.

7 And there were only fifty (50) horsemen left of Huwakas, ten chariots and ten thousand (10,000) soldiers that were_walking, because their companions were_killed by the king of Sirya, and (they) were just trampled like dust.

8 Ka duma ne neyitabu te peghari ni Huwakas, lagkes ka neyimu rin wey ka karesen din, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 9 Ne migpatey si Huwakas wey diye ilebeng te Samarya, ne si Hihuwas e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

8 The rest of the events/what had happened of Huwakas kinging, including what he did and his power, were_written in the Written_document of the Stories of the kings of Israil. 9 And Huwakas died and was_buried in Samarya, and Hihuwas his child replaced him kinging.

Ka peghari ni Hihuwas te Israil

The kinging by Hihuwas in Israil

10 Te igkatatelu ne pulu wey pitu (37) ne leg-un te peghari ni Huwas diye te Huda, migbunsud e degma mighari si Hihuwas ne anak ni Huwakas diye te Samarya. Ne mighari sikandin te sapulu wey hen-em (16) ne leg-un. 11 Piru mareet ded degma ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye, mig-ilingan din ka mareet ne hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat, ne iyan egpuunan ne nakasale ka me matig-Israil. 12 Ka duma ne hinimuwan ni Hihuwas, lagkes ka neyimu rin wey ka karesen din te pegpakig-ehet ki Amasiyas ne Hari te Huda, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 13 Te pegpatey ni Hihuwas, si Hirubuwam e[fn] ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari. Ne diye sikandin ilebeng te Samarya, diye te inlebengan te duma ne me Hari te Israil.

10 In the thirty seven (37) years of kinging by Huwas there in Huda, Hihuwas the child of Huwakas began to reign there in Samarya. And he reigned for sixteen (16) years. 11 But his deeds were also evil in front of the Lord, he imitated the evil deeds of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat, which was the reasoned the (ones) from_Israil sinned. 12 The rest of Hihuwas deeds, the story about what_ he _did and his power to fight Amasiyas the king of Huda, were_written in the Written_document of the Stories of the kings of Israil. 13 When Hihuwas died, his child Hirubuwam[fn] replaced him in kinging. And he was_buried in Samarya, there in the burial_place of the other kings of Israil.

Ka pegpatey ni Ilisyu

The death of Ilisyu

14 Sabeka ne aldew te ware pad migpatey si Hihuwas, migderalu si Ilisyu te mangune-kune. Ne miggendiye si Hihuwas ka egleuy kandin. Migsinehew sikandin ne migkahi, “Ahalen! Ahalen! Nekey naan e ka egkeyimu te egmangudde wey te egmangantud te karwahi te Israil ke ware kad?”

14 One day before Hihuwas died, Ilisyu was terribly_sick. And Hihuwas went to him to visit. He cried saying, “Master! Master! What can_ (those) horsemen and chariotmen of Israil _do without you(sg)?”

15 Ne migkahiyan sikandin ni Ilisyu, “Kua nu ka piet nu wey tunud.” Purisu ingkuwa rin e degma seini. 16 Ne migkahi si Ilisyu, “Bengata nu ka piet.” Purisu imbengat din e ka piet. Ne intel-eban e ni Ilisyu te belad din ka belad te Hari. 17 Ne migkahi e sikandin, “Lukati nu ka bintana ne dapit te igsile”, wey inlukatan din e degma seini. Ne impapane e ni Ilisyu ka tunud ni Hari Huwas wey migkahiyan e man-e sikandin ni Ilisyu, “Sika ne pane ka palinneu ne egpakapanalu ka te me matig-Sirya, egdereetan nu iya ka me matig-Sirya diye te Apik.” 18 Migkahi pad man-e si Ilisyu, “Kuwa ke pa te lein ne me tunud wey ilampes nu te tane,” wey ingkuwa rin e seini wey inlapes din e diye te tane te katatelu, wey migpeeneng-eneng e sikandin. 19 Piru nabelu si Ilisyu wey ingkahiyan din ka Hari, “Kalalimma wey ke keen-em nu perem ilampes, su eyew egkatalu nud iya ne malehet ka Sirya. Na kuntee, katatelu nu re iya degma egkatalu sikandan.”

15 And Ilisyu said, “Get your(sg) bow and arrow.” Therefore he got it. 16 Ilisyu said, “Pull_back(sg) the bow.” Therefore he pulled_ the bow _back. Then Ilisyu covered the hands of the king with his hands. 17 And he said, “Open the window at the east_side”, and he opened it. And Ilisyu caused_ King Huwas _to_shoot the arrow then Ilisyu said to him again, “That arrow is the sign that you(sg) can_defeat the (ones) from_Sirya, you(sg) will_ indeed _destroy the (ones) from_Sirya there in Apik.” 18 Ilisyu said again, “Get another arrows and hit the ground/land,” and he took it and hit the ground/land three_times, and he stopped. 19 But Ilisyu was angry and he said to the king, “You(sg) should hit (it) five or six times, so_that you(sg) will_ indeed _defeat Sirya. And now, you(sg) will_ only _defeat them three times.”

20 Nataman migpatey e si Ilisyu wey inlelebeng dan e sikandin.

20 Then Ilisyu died and they buried him.

Ne ka me matig-Muwab, nabatasan dan ne eglusud te Israil te pegbunsud te leg-un.21 Sabeka ne timpu, miglelebeng ka me matig-Israil te sabeka ne lukes. Ne sahuhune ne nakakita sikandan te me etew ne eglusud. Ne sikan de, ingkaregpak dan e ka minatey diye te inlebengan ki Ilisyu. Saliet de iya te nakaragket ka lawa te minatey diye te tul-an ni Ilisyu, neuyag e ka minatey wey migsasindeg e.

Then the (ones) from_Muwab, they were accustomed to invade Israil at the beginning of the year.21 One day, the (ones) from_Israil were burying a man. And suddenly they saw people invading. And at once, they threw the body of the dead (man) into Ilisyu's buried_place. As_soon_as the dead body touched Ilisyu's bone, the dead (man) came_back_to_life and (he) tood_up.

Ka pegpahidgireey te Israil wey Sirya

The warring of Israil and Sirya

22 Ne imbaybayaran ni Hasail ne Hari te Sirya ka me matig-Israil te langun ne timpu te peghari ni Huwakas. 23 Piru neyid-u ka Magbebaye ne Manama kandan, wey imbulihan din ded sikandan tenged te kasabutan din engki Abraham, Isaak, wey Hakub. Ne puun due, ware din dereeti wey balahara ka keet-etawan din.

22 And Hasail the king of Sirya treated_ the (ones) from_Israil _harshly each day when Huwakas was king. 23 But the Lord God pitied them, and he helped them because of his promised to Abraham, Isaak, and Hakub. And from that, he didn't destroy and ignore his people.

24 Ne migpatey e si Hasail ne Hari te Sirya, wey si Bin-Hadad e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari. 25 Natalu ni Hihuwas ka Sirya te katatelu, wey naawi din ded diye ki Bin-Hadad ka me siyudad te Israil ne naahew te amey rin ne si Hasail puun te amey rin ne si Huwakas.

24 And Hasail the king of Sirya died, and his child Bin-Hadad replaced him kinging. 25 Hihuwas defeated Sirya for three times, and he took_back from Bin-Hadad the cities of Israil that Hasail took_away from his father Huwakas.

Ka peghari ni Amasiyas te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Amasiyas

(2 Kru 25:1‑24)

(2 Chr 25:1‑24)

141 Te igkarangeb ne leg-un te peghari ni Hihuwas ne anak ni Huwakas te Israil, neyimu e degma ne Hari te Huda si Amasiyas ne anak ni Huwas. 2 Daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma (25) ka idad ni Amasiyas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te daruwa ne pulu wey siyam (29) ne leg-un. Si Hihu-Adan ne matig-Hirusalim ka iney rin. 3 Meupiya ka hinimuwan ni Amasiyas diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, piru kene amana ne iling keupiya te hinimuwan te kaap-apuan din ne si Dabid. Su in-ikul rin ma ka langun ne hinimuwan te amey rin ne si Huwas. 4 Ne ware naawe ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan, wey migpabulus ded migmanubad ka me etew wey migmanutung te insinsu diye.

141 In the second year of kinging over Israil by Hihuwas the child of Huwakas, Amasiyas the child of Huwas also became a king in Huda. 2 Amasiyas was twenty five (25) years old when he became king, and he kinged in Hirusalim for twenty nine (29) years. Hihu-Adan from_Hirusalim was his mother. 3 Amasiyas deed was good there in front of the Lord God, but not totally like the goodness of the deeds of his ancestor Dabid. Because he followed all his father's deeds Huwas. 4 And the sacrificial_places in the mountains were not removed, and the people just continued sacrificing(pl) and burning(pl) incense there.

5 Te migmaresen e ka peghari din, impeyimatayan din e ka me upisyal rin ne miggimatey te amey rin ne Hari. 6 Piru ware din mule ilagkes te eggimatey ka me anak dan, su sumale te nakahi diye te sinulat ni Muwisis ne balaud te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Keilangan ne kene eggimatayan ka amey tenged te sale te anak din, wey keilangan ne kene degma eggimatayan ka anak tenged te sale te amey rin. Egpatey re ka etew tenged te sale din mismu.”

5 When his kinging became_strong/firmly, he caused_ his officers who killed his father the king _to_be_killed. 6 But he didn't include their children, because according to Muwisis' writings in the law of the Lord God, “The father must not be killed because of the sin of his child, and also the child must not be killed because of the sin of his father. A person dies due to his own sin.”

7 Ne nekeyimatey si Amasiyas te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne sundalu ne me matig-Idum diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Asin, wey naahew ran iya ka Sila ne migngaranan dan e seini te Huktiil. Ne seinid en iya ka ngaran te inged taman kuntee.

7 And Amasiyas killed ten thousand (10,000) soldiers from_Idum in the valley that's named Asin, and they took_away Sila which they called Huktiil. And indeed this is the name of the place until today.

8 Sabeka ne aldew, migsuhu si Amasiyas te me suluhuanen ne egpeendiyeen te Hari te Israil ne si Hihuwas ne anak ni Huwakas ne anak ni Hihu te pegkahi, “Hendini ka su egpabunuey ki.” 9 Ne migtabak si Huwas ne Hari te Israil pinaahi te seini ne pangguhuren, “Due sapinit diye te Libanun ne migkahi diye te kayu ne sidar, ‘Ipaasawa nu mule ka anak nu ne malitan te anak ku.’ Piru due miglihad ne mahintalunan ne mananap wey indi-diekan din e ka sapinit. 10 Migpaambug kad ubag Amasiyas su natalu nu ma ka me matig-Idum. Eleg e perem sika su migpanalu kad ma. Uugpe kad mule te baley nu. Mania te egpamitew ka te gubut ne iyan egpakarereet keykew wey te keet-etawan te Huda?”

8 One day, Amasiyas ordered servants to go to the king of Israil Huwas the child of Huwakas the child of Hihu to say, “Come_here(sg) for we(incl) will_fight_each_other.” 9 And Huwas the king of Israil answered by this story, “There was a thorn_bush there in Libanun that said to the cedar tree, ‘Let your(sg) daughter marry my son.’ But a wild animal passed and it trampled the thorn_bush. 10 You(sg) boasted [embarrassedly] Amasiyas because you(sg) have defeated the (ones) from_Idum. It should be enough because you(sg) already won. On_the_contrary stay(sg) in your(sg) house. Why are you(sg) seeking war which can_destroy you(sg) and the people of Huda?”

11 Piru ware migpammineg si Amasiyas. Purisu inlusuran ni Hihuwas ne Hari te Israil si Amasiyas wey migpabunbunuey sikandan diye te Bit-Simis ne sakup te Huda. 12 Ne natalu te Israil ka Huda wey migpamallahuy e ka me sundalu te Huda wey migpanguli e diye te me ugpaan dan. 13 Ne narakep ni Hari Hihuwas si Hari Amasiyas diye te Bit-Simis. Ne miggendiyad si Huwas te Hirusalim wey impangguhus din e ka matikang wey makepal ne batu ne alad; puun te Gumawan ni Ipraim taman te Gumawan te Pikungan ne me sabeka ne gatus wey walu ne pulu (180) ne mitrus se kariyuan puun te Gumawan ni Ipraim. 14 Ne impanguwa rin e ka langun ne bulawan, pelata, wey ka me kasangkapan ne nakita rin diye te timplu te Manama. Impanguwa rin degma ka me karatuan te Hari ne diye te palasyu, lagkes ka nenaddakep ne me etew wey impanguyan din e diye te Samarya.

11 But Amasiyas didn't listen (to it). Therefore Hihuwas king of Israil attacked Amasiyas and they fought in Bit-Simis which was under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. 12 And Israil was_able_to_defeat Huda and the soldiers of Huda ran_away and went_home to their home_places. 13 And King Amasiyas was_captured_by King Hihuwas there in Bit-Simis. Then Huwas went to Hirusalim and he destroyed the high and thick stone fence/wall; from the Gateway of Ipraim until there in the Gateway of the Corner which the distance was one hundred eighty (180) meters from the Gateway of Ipraim. 14 And he took all the gold, silver, and material_possessions that he found in the temple of God. He took also the wealth of the king there in the palace, including the captured people and he brought(pl) (them) there to Samarya.

15 Ka duma ne hinimuwan ni Hihuwas lagkes ka pegpanalu rin te timpu ne migpakig-ehet sikandin ki Amasiyas ne Hari te Huda, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 16 Te pegpatey ni Hihuwas, diye ded sikandin ilebeng te Samarya, diye te lebenganan te me Hari te Israil, wey si Hirubuwam e[fn] ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

15 The rest of deeds of Hihuwas including his victory when he fought Amasiyas the king of Huda, were_written in the Writing_document of the Stories of the kings of Israil. 16 And when Hihuwas died, he was_buried also in Samarya, there to the buried_place of the kings of Israil, and Hirubuwam[fn] his child replaced him in kinging.

Ka pegkapatey ni Amasiyas ne Hari te Huda

The death of King Amasiya the king of Huda

(2 Kru 25:25‑28)

(2 Chr 25:25‑28)

17 Neuyag pad si Amasiyas ne anak ni Huwas ne Hari te Huda te sapulu wey lalimma (15) ne leg-un puun te pegpatey ni Hari Huwas ne anak ni Huwakas ne Hari te Israil. 18 Ne ka duma pad ne guhuren meyitenged te peghari ni Amasiyas, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda.

17 Amasiyas the child of Huwas the king of Huda was still alive for fifteen (15) years after king Huwas the son of Huwakas the king of Israil died. 18 And the rest stories concerning the kinging of Amasiyas, were_written there in the Written_document of the Stories of the kings of Huda.

19 Ne due me etew te Hirusalim ne migplanu ne eggimatey ki Amasiyas. Purisu migpallahuy sikandin puun te Hirusalim peendiye te siyudad te Lakis. Piru impatalukunan sikandin te me kuntere din wey impeyimatayan diye. 20 Ne indulan dan e te kudde ka lawa rin wey in-uyan diye te Hirusalim wey inlebeng dan e sikandin diye te inlebengan te me kaap-apuan din diye te siyudad ni Dabid. 21 Ne migweil-weil ka keet-etawan te Huda wey impasubal ran e ipahari ka anak din ne si Usiyas ne sapulu wey hen-em (16) pad se idad. 22 Sikandin ka mig-ayad-ayad te siyudad te Ilat ne naawi din eyew egkasakup ded man-e te Huda te migpatey e ka amey rin.

19 And there were people who planned to kill Amasiyas. Therefore he fled to the city of Lakis. But his enemies caused_him_to_be_ran_after and caused_him_to_be_killed there. 20 And they got_ his body _carried (LIT loaded) by horse and brought to Hirusalim and they buried him there in the burial_place of his ancestors there in the city of Dabid. 21 Then the people of Huda took_action and they got his child Usiyas replaced him in kinging who was still sixteen (16) years old. 22 He (was) the_one_who repaired the city of Ilat that he taken_back in_order to be part of Huda again when his father died.

Ka peghari te Israil te lein ne Hirubuwam

The kinging of the another Hirubuwam in Israil

23 Te igkasapulu wey lalimma (15) ne leg-un te peghari ni Amasiyas diye te Huda, mighari e degma si Hirubuwam[fn] diye te Israil, diye te Samarya. 23 In the fifteen (15) years of kinging by Amasiyas in Huda, Hirubuwam[fn] also reign there in Israil, there in Samarya. Hirubuwam reigned for forty one (41) years. 24 His deeds were evil in front of the Lord God, because he followed all evil_ways of Hirubuwam the child of Nibat, which was the reasoned the (ones) from_Israil have_sinned. 25 And Hirubuwam was the (one who) too_back of the places of Israil that snatched before so_that the boundary of Israil will_extend again there to Hamat until dead sea. Because that was what the Lord promised, the God of Israil which he caused_ his servant Hunas the child of Amitay from_Gat-Hipir _speak. 26 Then the Lord saw that the (ones) from_Israil were suffering so_much. None of them didn't suffer, even slaves or not slave, and no (one) can_help them. 27 But it's not the Lord's plan to kill_all the (ones) from_Israil until no (one) left here on_top of the earth, therefore he helped them by sending Hirubuwam the child of Hihuwas.

28 Ne ka duma ne me hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam wey ka langun ne immangimu rin, ka karesen din, ka pegbubunu din, ka peggawi din te Damasku wey te Hamat ne nasakup dengan te Huda, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil. 29 Te pegpatey ni Hirubuwam, diye sikandin ilebeng te lebenganan te me Hari te Israil. Ne si Sakariyas ne anak din ka neyimu ne Hari subal kandin.

28 And the other acts of Hirubuwam and everything that he did(pl), his power, his fighting, his getting_back Damasku and Hamat which was under_the_jurisdiction before of Huda, were_written in the Document of the Stories of the Kings of Israil. 29 When Hirubuwam died, he was_buried in the burial_place of the kings of Israil. 151 In the twenty-seventh (27) year of kinging by Hirubuwam[fn] in Israil, Usiyas[fn] the child of Amasiyas began kinging in Huda also. 2 Usiyas was sixteen (16) years old be he became king, and he reigned in Hirusalim for fifty-two (52) years. 13 Te igkatelu e ne pulu wey siyam (39) ne leg-un te peghari ni Usiyas diye te Huda, migbunsud e degma mighari diye te Israil si Salum ne anak ni Habis. He also made_offerings for the peace and he sprinkled the blood on the altar. 14 [xr]Then he caused_ the old bronze _to_be_removed from its location in front of the temple of the Lord, between his altar and the temple, and he caused_ it _to_be_put on into the north (LIT left_side) of the new altar. 15 Then Ahas said to Uriyas, “From now on, use this big altar to sacrifice burnt_offering for the morning and to sacrifice food for the evening. Sprinkle the blood of all the sacrifices on this, but don't include the bronze altar because I'm using it when I pray.” 16 And Uriyas obeyed the king's order.

17 [xr]Nataman impangawe e ni Hari Ahas ka langun ne me burunsi ne impeunturan te me pelenggana ne inggamit te eglaglag te weyig para te timplu. Migpeyimu degma sikandin te batu ne eg-unturan te tahuanan te weyig ne egngaranan te Dahat su eyew egkakuwa rin ka baka ne inggimu puun te burunsi ne impeunturan kayi. 18 Ne in-awe din man-e ka egpin-pinuuwan ne in-atepan diye te timplu ne eggamiten te Aldew te Peggimeley wey inlekeban din ka dalan ne bayaanan te Hari peendiye te timplu, eyew te pegpahale te Hari te Asirya.

17 [xr]Then King Ahas took_apart all the bronze that sitting-places of the basins that were used to fetch/carry water for the temple. He also caused_to_be_made a stone sitting-place for the water container named Sea so_that he could take_away the cow made of bronze where it was put on_top. 18 He also took_away the sitting_place that roofed there in the temple that was used on the Days of Resting and he closed the way/road of the king going to the temple, in_order to please the king of Asirya.

19 Ne ka duma pad ne neyitabu te peghari ni Ahas wey ka langun ne neyimu rin, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. 20 [xr]Ne migpatey e si Ahas wey diye sikandin isabal te siyudad te Hirusalim diye te insabalan ded te me kaap-apuan din.
