19 And the rest of the events of Ahas kinging and everything that he did, were written in the Writing_document of the Stories of the kings of Huda. 20 [xr]And Ahas died and he was_wrapped_and_stored in the city of Hirusalim where his ancestors wrapped_and_stored. And his child Isikiyas was the (one who) replaced him in reigning.

Ka peghari ni Husiyas te Israil

The kinging of Israil by Husiyas

171 Te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne leg-un te peghari ni Ahas te Huda, migbunsud e degma mighari te Israil si Husiyas ne anak ni Ila. Diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Samarya wey mighari sikandin diye te Israil te siyam ne leg-un. 2 Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, piru kene de ne iling kareet te hinimuwan te me Hari te Israil ne nekewun-a kandin. 3 Inlusuran sikandin wey insakup ni Salmanisir ne Hari te Asirya wey impabayad sikandin te buhis. 4 Piru nanengnengan ni Salmanisir ne Hari te Asirya ne mig-akalan de sikandin ni Husiyas su migpakigsabut sikandin ki Su ne Hari te Ihiptu, wey warad e degma migbehey sikandin te buhis din te tagse leg-un. Purisu imparakep sikandin ni Salmanisir wey impaprisu.

171 In twelfth (12) year of reigning by Ahas over Huda, Husiyas the child of Ila began to_kinging there in Israil also. He lived in Samarya and he kinged there in Israil for nine years. 2 His deeds were evil in front of the Lord God, but not really evil like the deeds of the kings of Israil that were ahead of him. 3 He was_invaded and colonized by Salmanisir the king of Asirya and he was_made_to_pay taxes. 4 But Salmanisir the king of Asirya discovered that he was betrayed by Husiyas because he made_an_agreement with Su the king of Ihiptu, and he didn't give his tax that year. That's why he was arrested by Salmanisir and imprisoned (him).

Ka pegkatalu te Samarya

The defeating of Samarya

5 Nataman, inlusuran e te Hari te Asirya ka Israil, wey inlingutan dan ka Samarya taman te tatelu ne leg-un. 6 Ne naahew ni Salmanisir ka Samarya te igkasiyam ne leg-un te peghari ni Husiyas. Ne impandakep din e ka me matig-Israil wey impanguyan e diye te Asirya, wey impeugpe din sikandan diye te siyudad te Hala, diye te me inged ne ilis te weyig ne Habur ne diye te Gusan, wey ka duma diye te me siyudad te Midiyan.

5 Then, the king of Asirya invaded Israil, and they surrounded Samarya until three years. 6 And Salmanisir seized Samarya in the nineth year of kinging by Husiyas. Then the (ones) from_Israil captured by him and taken to Asirya, and he had them settled in the city of Hala, to the places along_side of the river of Habur in Gusan, and others there in the cities of Midiyan.

7 Neyitabu seeye tenged su nakasale ka me matig-Israil te Magbebaye ne Manama ran ne iyan migpalihawang kandan puun te Ihiptu wey migluwas kandan puun ki Paraun ne Hari te Ihiptu. Ne migsimba sikandan te duma ne me manama 8 wey mig-ikul te me hinimuwan te me nasud ne imparelrel te Magbebaye te me Israilita puun te tane dan su eyew iyan e egpekeugpe kayi ka me Israilita. Mig-ikul man-e sikandan te hinimuwan te me Hari te Israil. 9 Ne miggeles-heles sikandan miggimu te igkeepes te Magbebaye ne Manama ran. Te tagse inged, deisek ma wey se dakel, miggimu sikandan te panubaran diye te me bubungan. 10 [xr]Migpasasindeg man-e sikandan te me sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira diye te me bubungan wey diye te egkaralungan te me kayu. 11 Migtutung sikandan te me insinsu diye te langun ne me panubaran diye te me bubungan iling te inggimu te keet-etawan ne imparelrel te Magbebaye te me Israilita puun te tane dan su eyew iyan e egpekeugpe kayi ka me Israilita. Ne miggimu sikandan te mareet ne me himu ne igkabelu te Magbebaye. 12 Ne migsimba sikandan te me diyus-diyus minsan ke impanpanayan e sikandan te Magbebaye ne kene igpeyimu seeye.

7 That happened because the (ones) from_Israil sinned against the Lord their God who was the (one who) cause them to be free (LIT go_out) from Ihiptu and saved them from Paraun the king of Ihiptu. And they worshiped other gods 8 and followed the deeds of the other countries that the Lord caused_ the Israilitas _to_chase_away from their land so_that the Israilitas would live_in it. And they followed the deeds of the kings of Israil. 9 And they secretly_hide doing what the Lord their God dislikes. In every inhabited-place, whether small or large, they made sacrificing_places on the mountains. 10 [xr]They also put a stone pillars and Asira's images there in the mountain and in the shades of the trees. 11 They burnt incense into all sacrificial_house in the mountains just_like people that the Lord caused_ the Israilitas _to_chase_away from their land so_that the Israilitas would live_in it. They did evil deeds that makes the Lord angry. 12 They worshiped false_god even if they were_told ahead by the Lord not to do those (things).

13 Ne impanpanayan te Magbebaye ka Israil wey ka Huda pinaahi te langun ne me prupita wey te me manenagne ne migkahi, “Engkeri niyud e ka maddeet ne hinimuwan niyu. Tumana niyu ka igsuhu ku kaniyu wey ikula niyu ka me tulumanen ne insuhu ku te me kaap-apuan niyu, wey impanulu ku kaniyu pinaahi te me suluhuanen ku ne me prupita.” 14 Piru ware sikandan migpalintutuu. Makehal ka me ulu ran iling te kaap-apuan dan ne ware migpalintutuu te Magbebaye ne Manama ran. 15 Ware dan tumana ka me tulumanen ne impanulu din kandan ne igpeyimu wey imbalahad dan ka kasabutan ne inggimu rin duma te me kaap-apuan dan, wey ka pegpaney-paney rin kandan. Nasi migsimba sikandan te me diyus-diyus ne ware karuan wey neyimu degma sikandan ne ware karuan. Mig-ikul sikandan te batasan te me etew diye te duma ne nasud minsan impanpanayan e sikandan te Magbebaye. 16 [xr]Ware dan tumana ka me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ran. Miggimu sikandan te larawan te daruwa ne nati te baka wey te sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira, wey insimba ran si Baal wey ka langun ne bituen diye te aw-awangan. 17 [xr]Ne intutung dan ka me anak dan isip igpanubad dan, miggimu sikandan te minsan nekey ne mareet te pegtengteng te Manama, wey migparani sikandan diye te me manenagne wey me timbusawen. Nakapabelu seini te Magbebaye. 18 Tenged te subla ne langet din te me matig-Israil, indelrel rin sikandan. Ne iyan naan de nasame ka me kabuhalan ni Huda.

13 The Lord warned Israil and Huda through all the prophets and fortune-tellers saying, “Leave_behind(pl) your(pl) evil deeds. Obey what_ I _ordered you(pl) and follow the customs that I commanded your(pl) ancestors, and I taught you(pl) by_means_of my servants the prophets.” 14 But they didn't listen. Their head are hard like their ancestors that didn't believe the Lord their God. 15 They didn't obey the customs he instructed them to do and they ignored the agreement he made with their ancestors, and his warning them. Instead they worship the false_gods that has no value and they also became no value. They followed the behavior of the people in other country even if they were_warned by the Lord. 16 [xr]They didn't obey the commands of the Lord their God. They made image of the two calves of a cow and of the post that's image of Asira, and they worshiped Baal and all the stars in the sky. 17 [xr]They burnt their children as their sacrifices, they did whatever that evil in God's sight, and they came_near to the fortune_tellers and (those) sorcerers. These (things) caused_the Lord_to_get_angry. 18 Because of his extreme anger with the (ones) from_Israil, he drove_ them _away. The only remainder (are/were) the descendants of Huda.

19 Piru ware ded man-e migtuman ka me kabuhalan ni Huda te me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ran, su nasi de iya sikandan mig-ikul te me matig-Israil. 20 Purisu, in-ang-anggaan e te Magbebaye ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Imparusaan din sikandan wey impeuripen te me kuntere dan, taman te warad nasame kandan.

19 But Huda's descendants still didn't obey the commands of the Lord their God, but instead they just followed the (ones) from_Israil. 20 Therefore, the Lord rejected all descendants of Israil. He punished them and let_ them _enslaved by their enemies, until no (one) of them is left.

21 Te peglein te Magbebaye te migharian te Israil puun te migharian te Huda,[fn] te si Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat ka neyimu ne Hari te Israil, sikandin ka egpuunan ne nakapariyu ka me matig-Israil te Magbebaye wey nekeyimu te dakel ne sale. 22 In-ikul te me matig-Israil ka langun ne mareet ne hinimuwan ni Hirubuwam wey migpabulus-bulus sikandan miggimu te mareet. 23 Nataman ne mig-ang-anggaan e te Magbebaye ka me matig-Israil sumale te impapaney-paney rin kandan pinaahi te me prupita. Purisu naddakep wey neuyan sikandan diye te Asirya wey diye ded sikandan taman kuntee.

21 When the Lord made the_kingdom_of_Israil_separated from the kingdom of Huda,[fn] when Hirubuwam the child of Nibat became king of Israil, he was the reason the (ones) from_Israil separated (LIT were_caused_to_distance) from the Lord and made a big sin/mistake. 22 The (ones) from_Israil followed all the evil deeds of Hirubuwam and they continued doing evil (things). 23 Then the Lord rejected the (ones) from_Israil as he had warned to them through his prophets. Therefore they were_captured there in Asirya and they are still there until now.

Ka peg-ugpe te matig-Asirya diye te Israil

The living of the (ones) from_Asirya in Israil

24 Ne in-uyan te Hari te Asirya ka me matig-Babilunya, matig-Kuta, matig-Aba, matig-Hamat, wey matig-Siparbayim eyew igpeugpe diye te me siyudad te Samarya subal te me matig-Israil. 25 Te an-anayan ne peg-ugpe dan diye, ware sikandan migsimba te Magbebaye ne Manama, sikan naa ka migpeuyan ka Magbebaye te me liyun, wey neyimatayan ka duma kandan. 26 Ne due nakahuhud te Hari ne migkahi, “Ka seeye se me etew ne impeuyan nu wey impeugpe nu diye te me lungsud te Samarya, ware nakanengneng ke egmenuwen te pegsimba te manama te sika ne inged. Sikan naa ka migpeuyan ka manama te me liyun wey neyimatayan ka duma kandan, su ware sikandan nakanengneng ke nekey ka egkeilanganen te sika ne manama.” 27 Seeye naa, migsuhu ka Hari te Asirya ne miggenendue, “Paliberi niyu ka Samarya te sabeka te me talagpanubad ne narakep ta, wey diye niyud sikandin peugpaa eyew egpakapanulu te me etew meyitenged te egkeilanganen te manama te seeye ne inged.” 28 Seeye naa ka impalibed dan e ka sabeka te me narakep dan ne talagpanubad diye te Samarya wey diye ipeugpe te Bitil. Ne impanulu din e ka me etew ke egmenuwen te egpamakey ka Magbebaye.

24 Then the king of Asirya took the (ones) from_Babilunya, from_Kuta, from_Aba, from_Hamat, and from_Siparbayim in_order to_cause_ (them) _to_live there in the cities of Samarya to replace of the (one) from_Israil. 25 At their first living there, they didn't worship the Lord God, that's why the Lord sent lions, some of them were_killed. 26 And (someone) was_told the king and said, “Those people whom you(sg) sent and settled in the towns of Samarya, didn't know how to worship the god in that place. That was the reasoned that god sent lions and some of them were_killed, because they didn't know what that god needed.” 27 So then, the king of Asirya ordered saying, “Send_ one of the sacrificers that we(incl) captured _back to Samarya, and get_ him _to_settle there so_that (he) can teach the people about the need of god in that place.” 28 That's why they sent_ one of their captured sacrificers _back to Samarya and got_ him _settled in Bitil. And he taught the people how to serve the Lord.

29 Piru minsan pad dutu, ka keet-etawan te duma ne nasud ne diye ipeugpe te me siyudad te Samarya, migpabulus ded migpangimu te me diyus-diyus dan wey diye dan ipanahu te me panubaran diye te me bubungan ne impangimu te me mahinged diye te Samarya. 30 Ne ka me matig-Babilunya, miggimu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Sukut-Binut. Ne ka me matig-Kuta, miggimu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Nirgal. Ne ka me matig-Hamat, miggimu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Asima. 31 Ne ka me matig-Abit, miggimu te diyus-diyus dan ne si Nibhas wey si Tartak. Ne ka me matig-Siparbayim, migtutung te anak dan eyew igpanubad te diyus-diyus dan ne si Adramilik wey si Anamilik. 32 Migsimba sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama, piru mig-alam ded man-e sikandan te talagpanubad ne duma ran ded eyew egpanubad diye te me panubaran ne diye te bubungan. 33 Ne minsan iya migsimba sikandan te Magbebaye, migpabulus ded sikandan migsimba te me manama ran iling te inggimu ran diye te me nasud ne impanguyanan kandan. 34 [xr]Ne sikan ded ka inggimu ran taman te seini ne timpu.

29 But even then, the people with the nation that were settled in the cities of Samarya, continued making their false_gods and they put (them) in the offering_places there in the mountains that were_made by the local_inhabitants there in Samarya. 30 And the (ones) from_Babilunya, made their false_god Sukutbinut. And the (ones) from_Kuta, made their false_god Nirgal. And the (ones) from_Hamat, made their false_god Asima. 31 And the (ones) from_Abit, made their false_god Nibhas and Tartak. And the (ones) from_Siparbayim, burnt their children to sacrifice to their false_god Adramilik and Anamilik. 32 They worshiped the Lord God, but they still chose the sacrificer which was still their fellow to offer there in the sacrificial_place in the mountain. 33 And indeed even if they worshiped the Lord, they continued to worship their gods like what they did there in the nations where they had been_taken_away. 34 [xr]And that's what they do until this time.

Ware sikandan migsimba te Magbebaye wey ware sikandan mig-ikul te me balaud ne igpatuman te kabuhalan ni Hakub ne ingngaranan te Israil.35 [xr]Miggimu ka Magbebaye te kasabutan te me matig-Israil wey migsuhu kandan ne migkahi, “Kene kew simba te duma ne me manama, wey ke egpanimbuel naa, wey ke egpamakey naa, wey ke egpanubad naa kandan. 36 [xr]Ke kene, sikeddi de simbaa niyu, ka Magbebaye ne migpalihawang kaniyu puun te Ihiptu pinaahi te karesen ku wey te geem ku. Keilangan ne sikeddi de panimbueli niyu wey panubari niyu. 37 Ne tumana niyu layun ka me balaud ku wey me suhu ne insulat ku para kaniyu. Kene kew en iya simba te duma ne me manama. 38 Kene niyu kalingawi ka kasabutan ne inggimu ku duma kaniyu wey kene kew simba te duma ne me manama. 39 Sikeddiey re simbaa niyu, ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, eyew egpangabangan ku sikaniyu puunn te me kuntere niyu.” 40 Piru ware migpammineg te Magbebaye ka me etew ne migsubal te me matig-Israil diye te Samarya, wey nasi migpabulus miggimu te nabatasan dan e ne eggimuwen.

They do not worship the Lord and they do not follow the laws that cause_to_be_obeyed by the descendants of Hakub that were called Israil.35 [xr]The Lord made an agreement with the (ones) from_Israil and commanded them saying, “Don't(pl) worship other gods, or kneel, or serve, or sacrifice to them. 36 [xr]Rather, worship me alone, the Lord who was the (one who) rescued you(pl) from Ihiptu by my strength and my power. You(sg) kneel_down and sacrifice me alone. 37 And you(pl) (should) always obey my laws and commandments that I wrote for you(pl). Don't(pl) ever worship other gods. 38 Don't(pl) forget our(incl) agreement that I have_made with you(pl) and don't(pl) worship other gods. 39 Worship(pl) me alone, the Lord your(pl) God, so_that I will_help you(pl) against your(pl) enemies.” 40 But the people who replaced the (ones) from_Israil in Samariya didn't listen to the Lord, and they even continued doing what they used to do.

41 Sikan naa, migsimba sikandan te Magbebaye, wey migsimba red man-e sikandan te ingkulit dan ne me larawan. Ne sikan ded degma ka eggimuwen te me kabuhalan dan taman kuntee.

41 So then, they worship the Lord, and they also worship their graven images. And that's what their descendants are_doing until today/now.

Ka peghari ni Isikiyas te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Isikiyas

(2 Kru 29:1‑2; 31: 31:1)

(2 Chr 29:1‑2; 31: 31:1)

181 Te igkatatelu ne leg-un te peghari ni Husiyas ne anak ni Ila diye te Israil, migbunsud e degma mighari diye te Huda si Isikiyas ne anak ni Ahas. 2 Daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma (25) ka idad ni Isikiyas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te daruwa ne pulu wey siyam (29) ne leg-un. Si Abiha ne anak ni Sakariyas ka iney rin. 3 Meupiya ka hinimuwan ni Isikiyas diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te hinimuwan te kaapuan din ne si Dabid. 4 [xr]Impangguhus din ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan, impanlupet din ka me pes-ek ne batu, wey impanempug din ka me sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira. Inlupet din degma ka burunsi ne uled ne inggimu ni Muwisis, su mighalad man ded kayi ka me etew taman te seeye ne timpu wey ingngaranan dan seini te Nihustan. 5 Migsalig si Isikiyas te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil. Sikan naa ka ware egpekeiling kandin ne Hari diye te Huda, nekewun-a ma kandin ne Hari wey ke namewuri naa. 6 Matinumanen amana si Isikiyas te Magbebaye, wey ware sikandin mig-engked ka egsinundul kandin. Intuman din ka me suhu ne impanengneng te Magbebaye ki Muwisis. 7 Indumaan sikandin te Magbebaye wey miglampus sikandin te langun ne inggimu rin. Migribildi sikandin te Hari te Asirya wey warad migparuma-ruma kandin. 8 Natalu rin ka me Pilistihanen taman te Gasa lagkes ka me inged ne sakup kayi, minsan ka dereisek ne bariyu wey ka derakel ne me siyudad.

181 In the third year of kinging by Husiyas the child of Ila there in Israil, Isikiyas the child of Ahas began kinging_over Huda. 2 The age of Isikiyas was twenty-five (25) when he became king, and he reigned there in Hirusalim for twenty-nine (29) years. Abiha the child of Sakariyas was his mother. 3 Isikiyas deed was good there in front of the Lord God like what_ Dabid his ancestor _did. 4 [xr]He destroyed the sacrificing_places on the mountains, he smashed the stone pillars, and chopped_down the posts that's images of Asira. He also smashed the snake bronze that Muwisis made, because the people still offering incense to it until that time and they named it Nihustan. 5 Isikiyas trusted the Lord, the God of Israil. So then there's_none like him (among) the kings in Huda, either king after him or before him. 6 Isikiyas is very faithful to the Lord, and he never stopped following him. He fulfilled the commands that the Lord had_made_known to Muwisis. 7 He was accompanied by the Lord and he succeeded in all that he do. He rebelled against the king of Asirya and he did not go_along_with him (anymore). 8 He defeated the Pilistihanons until Gasa including all the places under_ its _jurisdiction, even the small village and the big cities.

9 Te igkeep-at ne leg-un te peghari ni Isikiyas, wey igkapitu degma ne leg-un te peghari ni Husiyas te Israil, inlusuran ni Salmanisir ne Hari te Asirya ka Samarya wey inlingutan dan seini. 10 Nataman miglihad ka tatelu ne leg-un, te mighen-em e ne leg-un si Isikiyas ne mighari wey migsiyam e degma ne leg-un si Husiyas ne mighari, naahew e ni Salmanisir ka Samarya. 11 Ne impandakep e te Hari te Asirya ka me matig-Israil wey impanguyan e diye te Asirya, wey diyad ipeugpe te siyudad te Hala, diye te me inged ne marani te weyig ne Habur ne diye te Gusan wey diye te me siyudad te Midiyan. 12 Natalu ka me matig-Samarya su ware ma sikandan mig-ikul te suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ran wey insupak dan ka kasabutan ne inggimu rin duma kandan. Ne minsan ka insuhu kandan ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Magbebaye, ware dan pammineha wey tumana.

9 In the fourth year of kinging by Isikiyas, and also seventh year of kinging by Husiyas there in Israil, Salmanisir the king of Asirya invaded Samarya and they surrounded it. 10 Then three years had passed, when Isikiyas kinged for six years already and Husiyas kinged for nine years also, Salmanisir conquered Samarya. 11 Then the (ones) from Israil were captured and taken to Asirya by the king of Asirya, and (he) have them settled in the city of Hala, there in the places near the river of Habur in Gusan and in the cities of Midiyan. 12 Those from_Samarya was_defeated because they didn't follow/imitate the commands of the Lord their God and they disobeyed the agreement he made with them. And even what the servant of the Lord Muwisis ordered them, they didn't listen and obey (it).

Ka peglusud ni Sinakirib te Huda

The invading of Sinakirib in Huda

(2 Kru 32:1‑19)

(2 Chr 32:1‑19)

13 Te igkasapulu wey hep-at (14) ne leg-un te peghari ni Isikiyas diye te Huda, inlusuran te Hari te Asirya ne si Sinakirib ka langun ne siyudad te Huda ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu, wey naahew rin seini langun. 14 Purisu migpeuyan si Isikiyas ne Hari te Huda te seini ne lalag diye te Hari te Asirya ne diye te Lakis, “Nakasala a keykew. Piru igbehey ku keykew ka minsan nekey ne egbuyuen nu eyew eg-awe kad e kayi.” Sikan naa ka migbuyu ka Hari te Asirya te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne kilu ne pelata wey sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne kilu ne bulawan. 15 Ne imbehey ni Isikiyas kandin ka langun ne pelata ne diye te timplu te Magbebaye wey ka diye te tinesanan te karatuan te palasyu. 16 Insu-su din ka bulawan ne impareket te gumawan te timplu wey ka me bulawan ne impareket diye te egtangenan te gumawan, wey imbehey rin e te Hari te Asirya.

13 In the fourteenth (14) year of the kinging by Isikiyas there in Huda, all the cities of Huda that were_fenced by a high and thick stone were_invaded by Sinakirib the king of Asirya, and he snatched them. 14 Therefore Isikiyas the king of Huda sent this message to the king of Asirya who was in Lakis, “I have sin against you(sg). 23 Ne migpabulus migkahi ka labew ne upisyal, “Pakigsabut ka te ahalen ku ne iyan ka Hari te Asirya. (Isa 37:1‑7)

(Isa 37:1‑7)

191 Te pegkarineg ni Hari Isikiyas te guhuren, inggisi din e ka kumbale din, wey migsaluub e sikandin te saku te pegpeila te peglungku, wey miggendiyad sikandin te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 2 Ne impeendiye din ki prupita Isayas ne anak ni Amus si Ilyakim ne sinalihan te palasyu, wey si Sibna ne sikritari, wey ka igbuyag te me talagpanubad. Migsaluub sikandan langun te saku. 3 Seini ka lalag ne igpahuhud din diye ki prupita Isayas, “Aldew seini te peg-antus, pegdusa, wey pegkeyilew. Iling ki te malitan ne egpalelesut ne warad keseg. 4 Insuhu te Hari te Asirya ka labew ne upisyal rin te pegbaley-baley te manekal ne Manama. Ne kema ke narineg te Magbebaye ne Manama nu ka impanlalag te labew ne upisyal wey egdusaan sikandin tenged te impanlalag din. Purisu ampu ka para kanta te nenasame.”

191 When King Isikiyas heard the story, he tore his clothes, and wore sack as a sign of mourning, and he went_there to the temple of the Lord God. 2 And he sent Ilyakim the (one) entrusted of the palace, and Sibna the secretary, and the elders of the sacrificers there to prophet Isayas child of Amus. 5 Te nakapangguhud e ki Isayas seeye se me upisyal ne insuhu ni Hari Isikiyas, 6 migkahiyan e sikandan ni Isayas, “Kahii niyu ka ahalen niyu ne si Hari Isikiyas te seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama, ‘Kene ka kaaldek tenged te narineg nu ne pegbaley-baley keddi te suluhuanen te Hari te Asirya. 7 Pammineg ka! Egparinehen ku ka Hari te Asirya te me guhuren ne iyan egpuunan ne eglibed e sikandin diye te nasud din mismu. Ne egpeyimatayan ku sikandin diye pinaahi te kampilan.’ ”

5 When those officers that commanded King Isikiyas told Isayas, 6 they were_told by Isayas, “Tell(pl) your(pl) master King Isikiyas that this is what the Lord God said, ‘Don't(sg) be_afraid due to what_ you(sg) _heard that the servants of the king of Asirya was_blaspheming me. 7 Listen(sg)! 8 Te peglibed te labew ne upisyal diye te me sundalu rin, narineg din ne ka Hari te Asirya migligkat e puun te Lakis wey migbubunu diye te Libna, sikan naa ka migsinundul e sikandin diye. 9 Te pegkarineg ni Hari Sinakirib te migligkat e si Tirhaka ka matig-Itiyupiya ne Hari te Ihiptu eyew egbubunu kandin, migsuhu e sikandin te me suluhuanen ne egpahuhuren din ki Isikiyas ne migkahi, 10 “Kahii niyu ka Hari diye te Huda ne si Isikiyas, ‘Kene ka palimbung te manama ne insalihan nu ne migsaad ne ka Hirusalim kene egkaahew te Hari te Asirya. 11 Pammineg ka! Narineg nu ka immangimu te me Hari te Asirya diye te langun ne nasud. Indereetan dan iya seini. Ne migsuman-suman ke naa ne due egpakaluwas keykew? 12 Indereetan te kaap-apuan ku ka me siyudad te Gusan, Haran, wey Risip wey impangimatayan ka me etew ne migpuun te Idin ne nangugpe diye te Tilasar. 8 When the high officer returned to his soldiers, he heard that the king of Asirya had left from Lakis and fought in Libna, so he followed him there. 9 When King Sinakirib heard that Tirhaka the (one) from_Itiyupiya king of Egypt left to fight against him, he sent his servants to tell Isikiyas saying, 10 “Tell(pl) Isikiyas the king of Huda, ‘Don't(sg) be deceived by god whom you(sg) trusted and promised that Hirusalim will_ never _be_taken_away by the king of Asirya. 11 Listen(sg)! 14 Te nekeimpus e si Isikiyas ka migbasa te sulat ne in-uyan te insuhu ne me suluhuanen, miggendiyad e sikandin te timplu te Magbebaye wey imbukelasan din e ka sulat diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 15 [xr]Ne mig-ampu sikandin ne migkahi, “He Amana ne Maresen ne Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, ne migpinnuu due te matikang ne trunu nu ne ampew te kirubin.[fn] Sikeykew re ka Manama ne migmandu te langun ne migharian te kalibutan, wey sikeykew ka miggimu te langit wey tane. 16 He Magbebaye ne Manama, pammineg ka wey pitawa nu ke nekey e ka egkeyitabu kanami. Purisu, nenaddeetan iya seeye. 19 Ne kuntee, Magbebaye ne Manama ney, luwasa key puun te geem te Asirya eyew egpakanengneng ka langun ne migharian kayi te kalibutan ne sikeykew re iya ka Manama.”

14 After Isikiyas read the letter that brought by those commanded servants to tell, he went to the temple of the Lord and he opened the letter in front/presence of the Lord. 15 [xr]And he prayed saying, “O Very Strong/Powerful Lord, the God of Israil, who sat on your(sg) high throne above the kirubin.[fn] You(sg) only the God who ruled of all kingdoms here in the world, and you(sg) are (the one) who made the heaven and land/earth. 16 Oh Lord God, listen(sg) and look what happens to us(excl). Listen(sg) to all that Sinakirib had said to mock you(sg) who are strong God. 17 O Lord, it is true that many nations have_been_destroyed by the kings of Asirya, 18 and they burned their false_gods because they are not true god, but rather, it's only rock and trees that were_made by people. Therefore, they were_destroyed. 19 And now/today, Lord our(excl) God, save us(excl) from the power of Asirya so_that all the kingdoms here in the world will_know that indeed you(sg) alone are God.”

(Isa 37:21‑38)

Si Hulda asawa ni Salum ne anak ni Tikbas, ne anak ni Harhas. Si Salum ka talagbantey dengan te me manggad diye te timplu wey ke me manggad naa te Hari. Ne ingguhuran dan e si Hulda te tuyu dan. 15 Ne ingkahiyan sikandan ni Hulda, “Guhuri niyu ka etew ne migpeendini kaniyu te seini ka ingkahi te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, 16 ‘Egdereetan ku ka seini ne inged wey ka nangugpe kayi. Igpaneem-neem ku kandan ka langun ne lalag ne nasulat diye te baseen ne imbasa diye te Hari te Huda. 17 Su in-engkeran e ma nikandan wey migpanubad e sikandan diye te me diyus-diyus. Nalangetan a tenged te immangimu ran. Purisu igpaneem-neem ku te seini ne inged ka langet ku ne mangune-kune wey ware egpakabalabag keddi. 18 Piru pangguhuri niyu ka Hari te Huda ne migpeendini kaniyu eyew te pegpanginginse te Magbebaye te seini ka inlalag te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil meyitenged te me lalag ne narineg din: 19 ‘Puun su nekegsendit ke ma wey migpariralem ka te pegkeetew nu kayi te tangkaan ku te pegkarineg nu te pegbebantak ku te seini ne inged wey te nangugpe kayi, wey inggisi nu ka insaluub nu tenged te pegkalaggew nu, wey migsinehew ka kayi te tangkaan ku, egpamminehen ku ka peg-ampu nu. 20 Purisu, taheed te neuyag ke pad, kene ku igpeyinguma ka mareet ne ingkahi ku meyitenged te seini ne inged; kene nu egkakita ka karereetan ne igpeuyan ku te seini ne inged, wey egpatey ka ne malinawen duma te me kaap-apuan nu.’ ” Ne ingguhuran dan e ka Hari te tabak ni Hulda.

14 Therfore Hilkiyas, Ahikam, Akbur, Sapan, and Asiyas, went to a woman prophet Hulda who lived there in Hirusalim. Hulda's husband was Salum the child of Tikba, the child of Harhas. Salum was the keeper of the king's clothes before. And they told Hulda their purpose. 15 And they were told by Hulda, “Tell(pl) to the person who caused_ you(pl) _to_come_here that this (is) what_was_said by the Lord, the God of Israil, 16 ‘I will_destroy this place and those who lived here. I will_let them_experience all the words that are written there on the reading_document which (was) read there to the king of Huda. 17 Because I (was) left_behind by_them and sacrificed there to the false_gods. I got_mad because of what_ they _did. Therefore I will_let_ my terrifying anger _be_experienced by this place and no one can block. 18 But tell(pl) the king of Huda who caused_you_to_come_here in_order to inquire to the Lord that this (is) what the Lord, God of Israil said concerning the words/messages he heard: 19 ‘Because you(sg) regretted and you(sg) humbled yourself here in_front of me when you(sg) heard my threatening of this place and of the inhabitants here, and because you(sg) tore what_you(sg)_wore in your(sg) sadness, and you(sg) cried here in_front of me, I will_listen your(sg) praying to me. 20 Therefore, while you(sg) are still alive, I will_ not _allow_to_come the bad (things) I mentioned about this place; you(sg) will_ not _see the destruction that I will_send in this place, and you(sg) will_die peacefully with your(sg) ancestors.’ ” Then they told the king of Hulda's answer.

Ware migsimba si Hari Husiyas te me diyus-diyus

King Husiyas didn't worship false_gods

(2 Kru 34:3‑7, 29‑33)

(2 Chr 34:3‑7, 29‑33)

231 Ne impeumew ni Hari Husiyas ka langun ne igbuyag te Huda wey te Hirusalim. 2 Ne miggendiye sikandan te timplu te Magbebaye duma te langun ne keet-etawan te Huda wey te Hirusalim, mabantug ma wey se lerew lagkes ka me talagpanubad wey ka me prupita. Ne diye te timplu, imbasa ni Husiyas diye te tangkaan dan ka langun ne nasulat te baseen te kasabutan te Manama ne nakita diye te timplu te Magbebaye. 3 Ne migsasindeg si Hari Husiyas diye te lenged te sungkaleg eyew egpakakita ka langun kandin wey migpahunlibet sikandin ne egtumanen din te intiru ne pusung din wey te gimukud din ka me suhu te Magbebaye, me tulumanen, wey me balaud ne nasulat diye te baseen. Te iling kayi ne paahi, inlig-en te Manama ka paahi diye te kasabutan ne nasulat te seini ne baseen. Migsaad degma ka me etew ne egtuman te kasabutan te Manama.

231 And king Husiyas had_ all elders of Huda and Hirusalim _called. 2 And they went to the temple of the Lord along with all the people of Huda and Hirusalim, whether (they're) famous or ordinary including the sacrificers and prophets. And there in the temple, Husiyas read in_front of them all that's written on the reading_document of the covenant of God that's found there in the temple of the Lord. 3 And King Husiyas stood_up near the pillar so_that everybody could see him and he swore that he will_obey in his entire heart and soul the commands of the Lord, the rituals/regulations, and his laws that's written there in the reading_document. In this way, God strengthened the ways in the agreement that were written in this book. People also promised to obey God's agreement.

4 Nataman, insuhu te Hari si Hilkiyas ka labew ne talagpanubad duma te me talagpanubad ne sinalihan din, wey seeye se me talagtameng te gumawan te timplu ne igpalihawang ka langun ne inggamit te pegsimba ki Baal, ki Asira ne diyus-diyus, wey te langun ne bituen diye te aw-awangan. Ne intutung din langun seini diye te lihawangan te Hirusalim, diye te marani te napu te Kidrun wey impeuyan din ka igmuk diye te Bitil. 5 Ne impaawe din degma ka me talagpanubad te me diyus-diyus. In-alam sikandan dengan te me Hari te Huda eyew egtutung te insinsu diye te me panubaran diye te me bubungan diye te me lungsud te Huda wey palingut te Hirusalim. Sikandan ka migtutung te me insinsu ne ighalad ki Baal, diye te aldew, te bulan, wey te langun ne me bituen wey te me punduk kayi. 6 Ne impalihawang din ka sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira diye te timplu te Magbebaye, wey in-uyan diye te lihawangan te siyudad te Hirusalim, diye te napu te Kidrun. Ne diye dan silabi seini taman te neigmuk e, ne in-uyan dan e ka igmuk diye te lebenganan te kene ne me inila ne me etew wey diye dan e isawed. 7 Ne impangguhus din pad man-e ka me ugpaanan te me lukes ne egpamelegye te lawa ran ne diye te timplu te Magbebaye. Ne diye egmangimu ka me malitan te me kumbale ne para te diyus-diyus ne si Asira. 8 Ne impaawe ni Husiyas ka langun ne me talagpanubad diye te Huda wey impeendiye din e te Hirusalim. Ne impahuhus din ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan ne egtutungan te me talagpanubad te me insinsu, puun te Giba peendiye te Birsiba. Impangguhus din man-e ka me panubaran ne diye te gumawan ne impangimu ni gubirnadur Huswi. Ka sika ne gumawan, egkakita dapit te igkahibang ke egseled ki te siyudad. 9 Ne ware tuhuti ne egpamakey diye te altar te Magbebaye ne diye te Hirusalim ka me talagpanubad ne migpamakey te me panubaran diye te me bubungan. Piru intuhutan ded sikandan ne egkeen te paan ne ware patulin duma te me duma ran ne me talagpanubad.

4 Then, the king ordered Hilkiyas the prominent sacrificer with his trustworth sacrificer, and those sacrificers who guard the door/gate of the temple to take_out all the things that were used worship Baal, Asira the false_gods, and all the stars in the sky. And he burned everything outside Hirusalim, there in the valley of Kidrun and he sent_away the ashes to Bitil. 5 And he also got_rid the sacrificers of the false_gods. They were_chosen before by the kings of Huda in_order to burn the incense there in the sacrificing_places on the mountains there in the towns of Huda and around Hirusalim. They were the (ones who) burned incense to offer Baal, to sun, to moon, and all the stars and their groups. 6 Then he caused_ the post that's image of Asira _to_come_out of the temple of the Lord, and (they) took it outside of the city in Hirusalim, there in the near of valley of Kidrun. And they burnt it there until it became ashes, and they took the ashes to the buried_place of the (people) who were not known and they scattered it there. 7 He also destroyed the place_ where the prostitute (LIT sell their body) men _lived in the temple of the Lord. That's where women made/wove clothes for the false_god Asira. 8 And Husiyas drove_away all the sacrificers there in Huda and he sent (them) to Hirusalim. And he caused_to_be_destroyed the sacrificing_places there on the mountains where the sacrificers burned incense, from Giba to Birsiba. He also destroyed the sacrificing_places at the door/gate that governor Huswi made. And that doorway, can_be_seen there on the left if we(incl) enter the city. 9 Then the sacrificers who served of the sacrificing_places in the mountains were not allowed to serve there in the altar of the Lord in Hirusalim. But they were allowed to eat bread without yeast along_with their companions who were sacrificers.

10 Ne migsuhu si Husiyas ne igpahuhus ka me altar te Tupit ne diye te inged ne Bin-Hinum, eyew warad e egpakatutung te anak dan isip igpanubad ki Muluk. 11 Ne impaawe din man-e ka me larawan te me kudde ne inhalad te me Hari te Huda isip pegsimba te aldew, wey impasilaban din ka me karwahi ne inhalad ded iya man-e. Diye nakatetahu sika langun te lama te timplu ne marani te ugpaan ni Natan-Milik ne ahalen ne upisyal te palasyu. 12 Ne impahuhus din degma ka me altar diye te atep, diye te ampew ne sinabeng ni Ahas ne impeyimu dengan te me Hari te Huda. Minsan ka daruwa ne altar ne diye te lama te timplu te Magbebaye ne impeyimu ni Manasis, impalupet din seini wey indegpak diye te napu te Kidrun. 13 Ne impahuhus ni Hari Husiyas ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan ne diye te igsile te Hirusalim, wey ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan te Bubungan te Ulibu ne inggimu ni Hari Sulumun, eyew te pegsimba te diyus-diyus te me matig-Sidun ne si Astarti, wey te diyus-diyus te me matig-Muwab ne si Kamus, wey te diyus-diyus te me matig-Amun ne si Muluk. 14 Ne impalupet din degma ka me matulus kun ne sungkaleg ne me batu wey sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira, wey impepanahuan din e te me tul-an te me etew ka immasasindehan kayi.

10 Then Husiyas ordered to cause_to_be_destroyed the_altar in Tupit in the place of Bin-Hinum, so_that no (one) can_burn their child as sacrifice to Muluk. 11 And he caused_to_be_removed the images of the horses that the kings of Huda offered as an (act) of worship the sun, and caused_to_be_burned the chariots that were offered too. All of that (were) there at the yard of the temple near the living_place of Natan-Milik the leader of the officials in the palace. 12 And he also caused_to_be_destroyed the altars on the roof_top, there in the upper room of Ahas that the kings of Huda caused_to_be_made. Even the two altars in the yard of the temple of the Lord that Manasis caused_to_be_made, he caused_to_be_smashed them and thrown into the valley of Kidrun. 13 And King Husiyas caused_to_be_destroyed the sacrificing_places on the mountains on the south (LIT on the right of east) of Hirusalim, and on the south of the Olive Mountain that King Sulumun made, in_order to worship Astarti the false_god of the (ones) from_Sidun, and Kamus the false_god of the (ones) from_Muwab, and Muluk the false_god of the (ones) from_Amun. 14 And he also caused_to_smash the stones holy [surprise] pillars and pole image of Asira, and he caused_to_put the bones of the dead people the place_where_ it was _built.

15 Ne kene ne sikan de, impahebe degma ni Husiyas ka altar ne panubaran ne impeyimu ni Hirubuwam ne anak ni Nibat diye te bubungan te Bitil, ne iyan egpuunan ne nakasale ka keet-etawan te Israil. Insilaban din seeye ne altar wey inlupet din e. Insilaban din degma ka sungkaleg ne larawan ni Asira. 16 Te peglangu-langu ni Husiyas, nakita rin ka me lebeng diye te bubungan, ne impakuwa rin ka me tul-an wey intutung din diye te halaran. Te iling due ne paahi, natuman ka impalalag te Magbebaye te prupita ne egguhusen din ka altar te timpu te migsasindeg si Hirubuwam diye te altar te timpu te pista. Te peglangu-langu ni Hari Husiyas, nakita rin ka lebeng te prupita ne migtagne kayi. 17 Ne mig-inse si Husiyas, “Hentew-a lebeng te sika?”

15 And not only that, Husiyas also caused_to_destroy the altar that's sacrificial_place that Hirubuwam the child of Nibat caused_to_be_made there in the mountain of Bitil, that was the reasoned that Israil have_sinned. He burned those altar and he smashed (it). He also burned the post that's image of Asira. 16 As Husiyas look_around, he saw graves in the mountain, and he had them took the bones and he burned them in the sacrificial_place. In this way, what the Lord caused_ the prophet _to-say when Hirubuwam stood at the altar during the festival that he will_destroy the altar was fulfilled. When King Husiyas looked_around, he saw the grave of the prophet who had prophesied this. 17 And Husiyas asked, “Whose grave is that?”

Ne migtabak ka me etew ne matig-siyudad te Bitil, “Lebeng sika te prupita te Magbebaye ne matig-Huda. Sikandin ka migpanagne te seini se inggimu nu kuntee ne pegdereet te me altar kayi te Bitil.”18 Ne migkahi si Husiyas, “Kene niyu hilabeti ka lebeng din!”

People in Bitil answered, “That is the grave of the Lord's prophet from_Huda. He (was) the one prophesied what you(sg) are_doing now destroying altars here in Bitil.”18 Then Husiyas said, “Don't touch his grave!”

Purisu ware dan e hilabeti ka me tul-an din wey ka me tul-an te duma rin ne prupita ne matig-Samarya.19 Ne impahuhus din pad man-e ka me panubaran diye te me bubungan diye te me siyudad te Samarya ne inggimu te me Hari dengan te Israil ne iyan egpuunan ne nabelu ka Magbebaye. Ne iling ded ka inggimu ni Husiyas te sika ne siyudad te inggimu rin diye te Bitil. 20 Ne migpangimatayan din diye te panubaran diye te me bubungan ka langun ne me talagpanubad te me diyus-diyus, wey impanutung din diye ka me tul-an te me etew. Nataman, mig-uli e sikandin diye te Hirusalim.

Therefore they didn't touch his bones and the bones of his fellow prophet from_Samarya.19 And he had him destroyed the sacrificing_places on the mountains in the cities of Samarya that were_made by the kings of Israil which was the reasoned the Lord got angry. Husiyas had done in that city just as he had done in Bitil. 20 Then he killed all the sacrificers of the false_gods there in the sacrificing_places on the mountains, and he burned there the bones of the people. Then, he went home in Hirusalim.

(2 Kru 35:1‑19)

(2 Chr 35:1‑19)

21 Ne ingkahiyan ni Hari Husiyas ka langun ne etew, “Egsahakeen ki te Peglihad te Panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama ta, sumale te nasulat diye te libru ne insulatan te kasabutan te Manama.” 22 Puun te timpu ne iyan pad migmandu te Israil ka me talewukum, taman te timpu e te me Hari te Israil wey Huda, ware de due iling dutu ne Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan. 23 Piru neyimu seeye se Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Manama diye te Hirusalim te igkasapulu wey walu (18) ne leg-un te peghari ni Husiyas.

21 Then King Husiyas said to all the people, “Let's(pl) feast of the Passing of the Angel of the Lord our(incl) God, according to what was written in the book where the agreement of God was written.” 22 From the time when judges ruled in Israil, until the periods/times of the kings of Israil and Huda, there was no feasting of the Passing_by of the Angel like this. 23 But that Feast of Passing the Angel of the Lord there in Hirusalim was_made on the eighteenth (18) year of kinging by Husiyas.

Ka duma pad ne inggimu ni Hari Husiyas

Other deeds of King Husiyas

24 Ne kene ne sikan de, impaawe e man-e ni Husiyas seeye se egpakiglalag te me gimukud, ka me manenagne, wey impandegpak din ka me diyus-diyus ne diye te me baley, wey ka duma pad ne me diyus-diyus, wey ka langun ne mallindit ne insimba te me etew. Impangawe din ka langun ne iling due diye te Hirusalim wey ka duma pad diye te Huda. Inggimu sika ni Husiyas eyew te pegtuman te me balaud ne nasulat diye te libru ne nakita ni Hilkiyas ne talagpanubad diye te timplu te Magbebaye. 25 Ne warad Hari ne egpekeiling kandin ne migpamakey te Magbebaye te intiru ne pusung din, te gimukud din, wey te langun ne keseg din. Intuman din ka langun ne balaud ni Muwisis, wey warad lein ne Hari ne nekewun-a wey ke nakasinundul naa ne nekeiling kandin.

24 And not only that, Husiyas also drove_away those who will_talk to the spirit_ of the _dead, magicians, and he threw_away the false_gods in the house, and other false_gods, and all the bad/dirty (things) that people worshiped. He removed everything like that there in Hirusalim and the rest there in Huda. Husiyas did that to fulfill the laws that were written in the book that Hilkiyas the sacrificer found in the temple of the Lord. 25 And there was no king like him who worshiped the Lord with all (LIT entire) of his heart, his soul, and all of his strength. He obeyed all the laws of Muwisis, and there was no other king like him before or after him.

26 Piru minsan pad due, nabelu-belu ded iya ka Magbebaye te Huda puun te hinimuwan ni Manasis ne nakapabelu kandin. 27 Purisu migkahi ka Magbebaye, “Eg-engkeran kud ka Huda iling te peg-engked ku te Israil. Eg-engkeran kud degma ka in-alam ku ne siyudad ne Hirusalim wey ka timplu ne egkahiyen ku ne, ‘diya a egsayaa.’ ”

26 But even then, the Lord still very_angry with Huda because of what Manasis had done that provoked him. 27 Therefore the Lord said, “I will_abandon Huda just as I abandoned Israil. I will_ also _abandon my chosen city of Hirusalim and the temple that I was saying, ‘I will_be_praised there.’ ”

28 Ne ka duma ne neyitabu te peghari ni Husiyas wey ka langun ne neyimu rin, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. 29 Taheed te si Husiyas pad ka Hari te Huda, miggendiye te weyig ne Iyupratis si Niku ne Hari te Ihiptu, eyew egbulig te Hari te Asirya. Ne miggendiye si Hari Husiyas duma te me sundalu rin eyew te pegbubunu ki Niku. Piru neyimatayan sikandin ni Hari Niku te nekeglambag sikandan diye te Migidu. 30 Ne in-uyan e te me sundalu rin ka lawa rin ne impeuntud te karwahi peendiye te Hirusalim wey insabal ran e sikandin diye te sabalanan ne in-andam din. Ne si Huwakas[fn] e ne anak din ka in-alam te me etew ne Hari subal kandin.

28 The rest of the events of Husiyas kinging and everything that he did, were written in the writing_document of the kings of Huda. 29 While Husiyas was still the king of Huda, Niku the king of Ihiptu, went to the river of Iyupratis to_help the king of Asirya. Then King Husiyas went there with his soldiers to fight against King Niku. But he was_killed by King Niku when they met in Migidu. 30 Then his soldiers took his body and put it in a chariot to Hirusalim and they wrapped_and_store him in the wrapping_place he had prepared. And the people chose Huwakas[fn] his child replaced him in kinging.

Ka peghari ni Huwakas te Huda

The reigning of Huwakas of Huda

(2 Kru 36:2‑4)

(2 Chr 36:2‑4)

31 Daruwa ne pulu wey tatelu (23) ka idad ni Huwakas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te tatelu re ne bulan. Si Hamutal ne anak ni Hirimiyas ne matig-Libna ka iney rin. 32 Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye, iling te hinimuwan te kaap-apuan din. 33 Ne indakep sikandin ni Niku ne Hari te Ihiptu wey imprisu diye te Ribla ne sakup te nasud te Hamat, eyew kene sikandin egpakahari diye te Hirusalim. Ne immultaan ni Niku ka me matig-Huda te tatelu ne libu wey hep-at ne gatus (3,400) ne kilu ne pelata, wey tatelu ne pulu wey hep-at (34) ne kilu ne bulawan. 34 Ne inggimu ni Niku ne Hari si Iliyakim diye te Huda subal te amey rin ne si Husiyas. Ne inliwanan ni Niku ka ngaran ni Iliyakim te Huwakim. Te peglibed ni Niku diye te Ihiptu, induma rin si Huwakas wey diyad e sikandin migpatey. 35 Ne imbehey ni Huwakim ka me pelata wey bulawan diye te Hari te Ihiptu ne si Niku. Piru impabayad ni Hari Huwakim ka me etew te buhis sumale te kaluag te tane dan wey karakel te karatuan dan, eyew egpakabayad sikandin te buhis ne imbuyu ni Niku.

31 Huwakas was twenty three (23) years old when he became king, and kinged there in Hirusalim for three months. Hamutal the child of Hirimiyas from_Libna was his mother. 32 His deeds in front of the Lord were evil, like what his ancestor had done. 33 And he was_captured/arrested by Niku the king of Ihiptu and imprisoned (him) in Ribla which was under_the_jurisdiction of the nation of Hamat, so_that he can't be kinged in Hirusalim. And Niku had_ the (ones) from_Huda _pay of three thousand and four hundred (3,400) kilograms of silver, and thirty four (34) kilograms of gold. 34 Then Niku made Ilyakim King in Huda in place of his father Husiyas. Then Niku changed the name of Iliyakim into Huwakim. When Niku returned to Ihiptu, he accompanied Huwakas and he died there. 35 And Huwakim gave the silver and the gold to the king of Ihiptu Niku. But Huwakim had the people pay taxes based on how wide their land and how big their possessions, so_that he could give taxes that Niku asked.

Ka pegahri ni Huwakim te Huda

The reigning of Huwakim of Huda

(2 Kru 36:5‑8)

(2 Chr 36:5‑8)

36 Daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma (25) ka idad ni Huwakim te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te sapulu wey sabeka (11) ne leg-un. Si Sibida ne anak ni Pidayas ne matig-Ruma ka iney rin. 37 Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye su mig-ikul sikandin te hinimuwan te me kaap-apuan din.

36 Huwakim was twenty five (25) years old when he became king, and he kinged there in Hirusalim for eleven (11) years. Sibida the child of Pidayas from_Ruma was his mother. 37 His deeds in front of the Lord were evil because he followed his ancestors deeds.

241 Te timpu te peghari ni Huwakim te Huda, inlusuran sikandin ni Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya, wey nasakup sikandin ni Nibukadnisar te tatelu ne leg-un. Piru nataman, migribildi e sikandin te Hari te Babilunya. 2 Ne impalusuran te Magbebaye ne Manama si Huwakim te me sundalu ne me matig-Kaldiya, me matig-Sirya, me matig-Muwab wey me matig-Amun eyew te pegdereet te Huda sumale te inlalag te Magbebaye pinaahi te me suluhuanen din ne me prupita. 3 Neyitabu seeye te Huda puun te suhu te Magbebaye, eyew egkahule ka me matig-Huda tenged te sale ne neyimu ni Hari Manasis, 4 wey tenged man-e te impangimatayan din ne me etew ne ware sale, kenad iya egpakapasaylu ka Magbebaye ki Manasis.

241 At the time of kinging by Huwakim of Huda, he was_attacked by Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya, and he became_subject of Nibukadnisar for (LIT inside) three years. But afterwards, he rebelled against the king of Babilunya. 2 Then the Lord God caused_ the soldiers from_Kaldiya, from_Sirya, from_Muwab and from_Amun _to_attacked Huwakim in_order_to destroy Huda according to what_ the Lord _said by_means_of his servants the prophets. 3 This happened in Huda due to the command of the Lord, so_that the from_Huda would be wiped_out because of the sin that King Manasis did, 4 and also due to his killing of people without sin, the Lord couldn't forgive Manasis.

5 Ka duma pad ne guhuren te peghari ni Huwakim wey ka langun ne neyimu rin, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda. 6 Ne nataman migpatey e si Huwakim, wey si Huwakin e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

5 The rest of the stories concerning the kinging by Huwakim and everything that he did, were written in the writting_document of the stories of the kings of Huda. 6 And afterward Huwakim died, and Huwakin his child replaced him in kinging.

7 Ne warad e mig-abey miglusud ka Hari te Ihiptu tenged su naahew e te Hari te Babilunya ka langun ne tane te Ihiptu ligkat diye te Weyig ne Nilu taman diye te Weyig ne Iyupratis.

7 Then the king of Ihiptu didn't invade again because the king of Babilunya took all the land of Ihiptu from the River of Nilu to the River of Iyupratis.

Ka peghari ni Huwakin te Huda

The kinging by Huwakin in Huda

(2 Kru 36:9‑10)

(2 Chr 36:9‑10)

8 Sapulu wey walu (18) ka idad ni Huwakin te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te tatelu re ne bulan. Si Nihusta ne anak ni Ilnatan ne matig-Hirusalim ka iney rin. 9 Mareet ka hinimuwan ni Huwakin diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye iling te inggimu te amey rin.

8 The age of Huwakin was eighteen (18) when he became king in Huda, and he kinged in Hirusalim for only three months. Nihusta the child of Ilnatan from_Hirusalim (was) his mother. 9 Huwakin's deeds were evil in front of the Lord like his father had done.

10 Te seeye ne timpu, miglusud ka me sundalu ni Hari Nibukadnisar diye te Hirusalim wey inlingutan dan ka siyudad. 11 Ne miggendiye si Nibukadnisar te Hirusalim taheed te inlingutan seeye te me sundalu rin. 12 Ne miggural e si Huwakin diye ki Nibukadnisar duma te iney rin, te me upisyal rin, wey me sundalu rin, lagkes seeye se me upisyal te palasyu. Igkawalu ne leg-un seeye te peghari ni Nibukadnisar te pegpaprisu rin ki Huwakin. 13 Ne impanguyan ni Nibukadnisar diye te Babilunya ka langun ne me kasangkapan diye te timplu te Magbebaye wey ka diye te palasyu. Impamese din degma ka langun ne impeyimu dengan ni Hari Sulumun ne me kasangkapan ne bulawan diye te timplu. Neyitabu seini sumale te ingkahi te Magbebaye. 14 Impandakep din man-e ka langun ne matig-Hirusalim, ka langun ne me upisyal wey ka me mabbulut ne me sundalu. Ne migginguma te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ka naddakep, lagkes ka me due katuenan te pegbebaley, wey ka me mannayab. Iyan naan de nahaat ka egkaayu-ayu e ne subla.

10 At that time, the soldiers of king Nibukadnisar invaded Hirusalim and they surrounded the city. 11 Then Nibukadnisar went to Hirusalim while it was_surrounded by his soldiers. 12 Then Huwakin surrendered there to Nibukadnisar with his mother, officers, soldiers, including those officers in the palace. It was eight years of kinging by Nibukadnisar when he had Huwakin imprisoned. 13 Then Nibukadnisar took all the possessions from the temple of the Lord and from the palace to Babilunya. He also smashed all gold possessions that King Sulumun caused_to_be_made in the temple. This happened according to what the Lord had said. 14 He also captured all (people) from_Hirusalim, all the officers and the brave soldiers. The captives were ten thousand (10,000) in all, including (those) who knows how to build_a_house, and those who_are blacksmith. Only the very poor were left.

15 Ne in-uyan e ni Nibukadnisar si Huwakin diye te Babilunya, minsan ka iney rin, ka me asawa rin wey ka me upisyal rin. Apil degma ka me upisyal te nasud. 16 In-uyan din man-e ka pitu ne libu (7,000) ne mabbulut ne me sundalu, wey senge-libu (1,000) ne me etew ne dakel se katuenan te minsan nekey re iya, lagkes ka me mannayab. Langun dan ne makeseg wey eleg ne egkeyimu ne sundalu.

15 Then Nibukadnisar took Huwakin to Babilunya, even his mother, his wives and his officers. Also including the officers of the nation. 16 He also took seven thousand (7,000) brave soldiers, and one thousand (1,000) people who had knowledge of anything, including those ironsmith. All of them were strong and correct to become soldier.

17 Ne ka anggam ni Huwakin ne si Mataniyas, iyan inggimu ni Nibukadnisar ne Hari subal ki Huwakin, wey inliwanan ni Nibukadnisar ka ngaran ni Mataniyas te Sidikiyas.

17 Then Huwakin's uncle Mataniyas, was_made king by Nibukadnisar to replace Huwakin, and Nibukadnisar changed Mataniyas' name to Sidikiyas.

Ka peghari ni Sidikiyas te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Sidikiyas

(2 Kru 36:11‑12; Hir 52:1‑3a)

(2 Chr 36:11‑12; Jer 52:1‑3a)

18 Daruwa ne pulu wey sabeka (21) ka idad ni Sidikiyas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te sapulu wey sabeka (11) ne leg-un. Si Hamutal ne anak ni Hirimiyas ne matig-Libna ka iney rin. 19 Ne mareet ded degma ka hinimuwan ni Hari Sidikiyas diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, iling te langun ne hinimuwan ni Hari Huwakim. 20 Purisu nalangetan amana ka Magbebaye ne Manama te keet-etawan te Hirusalim wey te Huda, wey indeldel rin e sikandan.

18 Sidikiyas was twenty one (21) years old when he became king, and he kinged there in Hirusalim for eleven (11) years. Hamutal the child of Hirimiyas from_Libna was his mother. 19 And Sidikiyas also did evil to the Lord God, like all what King Huwakim did. 20 Therefore the Lord God was very angry with the people of Hirusalim and Huda, and he drove_ them _away.

Nataman migribildi e si Sidikiyas ki Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya.

Then Sidikiyas rebelled (against) Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya.

Ka pegkatalu te Hirusalim

The defeating of Hirusalim

251 Purisu te igkasapulu (10) ne aldew te igkasapulu (10) ne bulan te igkasiyam ne leg-un te peghari ni Sidikiyas, inlusuran e ni Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya ka Hirusalim. Migkekampu sikandan diye te lihawangan te siyudad, wey inlingutan dan tamunduwi te tane ka matikang wey makepal ne batu ne alad te Hirusalim eyew egpakaseled sikandan. 2 Inlingutan dan ka siyudad taman te igkasapulu wey sabeka (11) ne leg-un te peghari ni Sidikiyas. 3 Te igkasiyam ne aldew te igkeep-at ne bulan te seeye ded ne leg-un, nakasalerep e te bitil ka me etew te Hirusalim. 4 Ne nataman nahebe e te me sundalu te me matig-Babilunya ka matikang wey makepal ne batu ne alad te siyudad. Purisu migpallahuy e si Sidikiyas duma te langun ne sundalu rin te timpu te marusilem minsan inlingutan e te me matig-Babilunya ka siyudad. Diye sikandan migbaye te gumawan ne elat-elat te daruwa ne alad te siyudad, marani te pinamulaan te Hari, wey miggendiyad e sikandan te Araba. 5 Piru inlupug sikandan te me sundalu te Babilunya, wey neumaan iya sikandan diye te napu te Hiriku. Ne in-engkeran e si Hari Sidikiyas te me sundalu rin ne nenekegsuwey-suwey. 6 Ne indakep dan e si Hari Sidikiyas wey in-uyan dan e diye ki Hari Nibukadnisar ne diye te siyudad te Ribla ne sakup te nasud te Hamat. Ne diye, inggukuman e sikandin ni Hari Nibukadnisar. 7 Ne impeyimatayan e ni Nibukadnisar ka me lukes ne anak ni Sidikiyas diye te tangkaan din. Ne impakulewut e ni Nibukadnisar ka mata ni Sidikiyas. Ne impabaku e sikandin te keddina wey in-uyan e diye te Babilunya.

251 Therefore on the tenth (10) day of the tenth (10) month on the ninth year of Sidikiyas' kinging, Nibukadnisar king of Babilunya invaded/attacked Hirusalim. They camped outside the city, then they sieged the soil around the high and thick stone fence/wall of Hirusalim so_that they can enter. 2 They surrounded the city until the eleventh (11) year of kinging by Sidikiyas. 3 On the ninth day of the fourth month on that same year, people of Hirusalim experienced terrible famine. 4 Then the ones from Babilunya broke down part of the high and thick stone fence/wall of the city. Therefore Sidikiyas fled with all his soldiers on the night time even the city was surrounded by the (ones) from_Babilunya. They passed_through the gate between the two wall of the city, near the garden of the king, and they fled there to Araba. 5 But they were chased by the soldiers of Babilunya, and they were caught in the plains of Hiriku. Then King Sidikiyas was abandoned by his soldiers who were scattered. 6 Then they captured King Sidikiyas and they took him to King Nibukadnisar there in the city of Ribla which_was_under_jurisdiction of the nation of Hamat. And there, he was judged/sentenced by King Nibukadnisar. 7 And Nibukadnisar had the male children of Sidikiyas killed there in front of him. Then Nibukadnisar had_ the eye(s) of Sidikiyas _taken_out. Then he was bound with a chain and took (him) to Babilunya.

Ka pegkahuhus te timplu

The destruction of the temple

(Hir 52:12‑33)

(Jer 52:12‑33)

8 Te igkapitu ne aldew te igkalimma ne bulan te igkasapulu wey siyam (19) ne leg-un te peghari ni Nibukadnisar te Babilunya, nakaseled e te Hirusalim si Nibusaradan ne pangulu te me talagbantey te Hari te Babilunya. 9 Ne insilaban din e ka timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka palasyu te Hari, lagkes ka langun ne baley diye te Hirusalim, wey ka me baley te inila ne me etew te Hirusalim. 10 Ne impangguhus e te me sundalu rin ka me matikang wey makepal ne batu ne alad te siyudad. 11 Ne impandakep e ni Nibusaradan ka me etew ne nenasame diye te siyudad, ka nenasame ne mangngateu ne me trabahanti, lagkes ka me sundalu ne miggural e te me sundalu te Hari te Babilunya. 12 Piru immanggaat din de diye te Huda ka duma ne subla ne egkaayu-ayu, eyew sikandan ka egtanggu te me parasan wey te me kamet.

8 On the seventh day of the fifth month of the nineteenth (19) year of kinging by Nibukadnisar in Babilunya, Nibusaradan the leader of the guard of the king in Babilunya was_able_to_enter Hirusalim. 9 Then he burned the temple of the Lord God, the palace of the king, including all the houses in Hirusalim, and the houses of the well_known people in Hirusalim. 10 Then his soldiers tore_down the high and thick stone fence/walls of the city. 11 And Nibusaradan captured(pl) the people who were left in the city, those who were left skilled workers, including the soldiers who surrendered to the soldiers of the king of Babilunya. 12 But he left_behind the rest of the very poor people, so that they (are) the (one) to_take_care of the vineyards and fields.

13 Ne ingguhus te me matig-Babilunya ka daruwa ne sungkaleg ne me burunsi diye te timplu, ka burunsi ne kerumata, wey ka pelenggana ne burunsi ne egngaranan te “Ka Dahat”. Ne impanguyan dan e seini langun diye te Babilunya. 14 Impanguyan dan ka me kuren ne inggimu puun te tane, me pala, ka igpanempug te pebilu te sulu, me yahung, me ubab, wey ka langun ne kasangkapan ne burunsi ne inggamit diye te timplu. 15 Impanguyan dan man-e ka langun ne bulawan wey pelata ne me kasangkapan, lagkes e ka me yahung wey ka duma pad ne egkahamit ne egtahuan te baha. 16 Ne kenad egkatimbang tenged te kabehat ka daruwa ne burunsi ne sungkaleg diye te timplu, ka dakel ne pelenggana ne egngaranan te, “Ka Dahat”, wey ka kerumata ne inggamit te peglaglag te weyig. Ka sika langun, impeyimu dengan ni Hari Sulumun para te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 17 Nekeg-iling ka daruwa ne sungkaleg, su ka tagse sabeka, walu ne mitrus se kalayat, wey ka ulu-ulu ne burunsi, sabeka wey liware ne mitrus se kalayat. Ne impalingutan seini te dayan-dayan ne neelin ne burunsi, ne impeiling te prutas ne egngaranan te granada.

13 Then the (ones) from_Babilunya tore_down the two bronze pillars there in the temple, the bronze wagon, and the bronze basin called “The Sea”. And they took all of it to Babilunya. 14 They took the pots made from the soil, shovels, the cutters/trimmers of the wicks, bowls, mugs, and all the bronze possessions that were used in the temple. 15 They also took all the gold and silver possessions, including the bowls and other things used for putting ember. 16 And the two bronze pillars in the temple, the big basin called, “The Sea”, and the wagon that were used to carry the water will_ no_longer _be_weighed because (they were) heavy. All of that, King Sulumun caused_to_be_made for the temple of the Lord God. 17 The two pillars were_the_same, because each (of it), was eight meters high, and its bronze head, (was) one and a half meters high. And they were_decorated around_about with pure bronze, that were_made_like fruit that's named pomegranate.

Impandakep ka me Hudiyu wey impanguyan diye te Babilunya

The Hudiyus were_captured(pl) and were_taken(pl) there to Babilunya

(Hir 52:24‑27)

(Jer 52:24‑27)

18 Ne impandakep man-e ni Nibusaradan ensi Sirayas ne Labew ne Talagpanubad, si Supuniyas ne sinalihan ni Sirayas, wey ka tatelu ne upisyal te timplu. 19 Ne indakep din degma ka upisyal te me sundalu, wey ka lalimma ne talagtambag te Hari ne diye pad te siyudad, wey ka sikritari te upisyal ne impiyalan te pegpanlista te me etew ne egsundaluwen, wey ka duma pad ne hen-em ne pulu (60) ne me etew ne nakita diye te siyudad te Hirusalim. 20 Ne impanguyan sikandan langun ni Nibusaradan diye te Hari te Babilunya ne diye te Ribla. 21 Ne impahumian sikandan te Hari te Babilunya wey impeyimatayan e.

18 And also Nibusaradan captured Sirayas the High Sacrificer, Supuniyas the entrusted/assistant of Sirayas, and the three officials in the temple. 19 And he also arrested the official of the soldiers, and the five advisors of the king, and the secretary of the officers who was in_charge_of listing people to be the soldiers, and the other sixty (60) people found in the city of Hirusalim. 20 And Nibusaradan took_ them all _with_him to the king of Babilunya there in Ribla. 21 And the king of Babilunya caused_ them _to_be_beaten and killed.

Purisu naddakep wey neuyan e ka keet-etawan te Huda peendiye te lein ne me nasud.

Therefore the people of Huda were captured and were taken to other nation.

Ka gubirnadur diye te Huda ne si Gidalyas

Gidalyas the governor there in Huda

(Hir 40:7‑9; 41:1‑ 41:1‑3)

(Jer 40:7‑9; 41:1‑ 41:1‑3)

22 Ne inggimu ni Hari Nibukadnisar si Gidalyas ne gubirnadur te me etew ne nahaat diye te Huda. Anak sikandin ni Ahikam ne apu ni Sapan. 23 Te pegkarineg te langun ne upisyal te me sundalu te seeye ne guhuren, miggendiyad e sikandan te Mispa ka egpakigkita ki Gidaliyas. Sikandan ensi Ismail ne anak ni Nitaniyas, si Diyuhanan ne anak ni Kariyas, si Sirayas ne anak ni Tanhumit ne matig-Nitupa, wey si Hasaniyas ne matig-Maaka duma te langun ne etew ran. 24 Ne migpahunlibet si Gidaliyas ne migkahi kandan, “Kene kew kaaldek te me upisyal te me matig-Babilunya. Telen kew e kayi wey paruma-ruma kew te Hari te Babilunya, wey ware mareet ne egkeyitabu kaniyu.” 25 Piru te igkapitu ne bulan te seeye ded ne leg-un, si Ismail ne anak ni Nitaniyas wey apu ni Ilisama ne karumaan te pamilya te Hari, miggendiye te Mispa duma te sapulu (10) ne etew rin eyew te peggimatey ki Gidalyas wey te me Hudiyu wey me matig-Babilunya ne duma rin diye. Ne neyimatayan dan iya sikandan. 26 Ne puun due, migpamallahuy e diye te Ihiptu ka langun ne me matig-Israil, me meyaman ma wey se egkengaayu-ayu duma te me upisyal te me sundalu su nenaaldek sikandan ne egsulian te me matig-Babilunya.

22 And Nibukadnisar made Gidalyas as governor of the people who were_left_behind in Huda. He (was) the child of Ahikam the grandchild of Sapan. 23 When all the officers of the soldiers heard that message, they went to Mispa to meet Gidaliyas. They were Ismail the child of Nitaniyas, Diyuhanan the child of Kariyas, Sirayas the child of Tanhumit from_Nitupa, and Hasaniyas from_Maaka with all their men. 24 Then Gidaliyas swore to them saying, “Don't(pl) be_afraid of the officers of the (ones) from_Babilunya. Settle_down(pl) here and be obedient to the king of Babilunya, and no bad_things happen to you(pl).” 25 But in the seventh month in that year, Ismail the child of Nitaniyas who was the grandchild of Ilisama the relative of the king's family, went_there to Mispa together with his ten (10) men in_order to kill Gidaliyas including the Hudiyu and the (ones) from_Babilunya who were with him there. And they indeed killed him. 26 And from that, all the (ones) from_Israil fled to Ihiptu, rich or poor with the officers of the soldiers because they were_afraid that the (ones) from_Babilunya will_revenge them.

Ka pegpalihawang ki Huwakin puun te prisuwan

The setting_free of Hihuwakin from the prison

(Hir 52:31‑34)

(Jer 52:31‑34)

27 Te igkatatelu ne pulu wey pitu (37) ne leg-un te pegkarakepi ki Huwakin ne Hari te Huda, neyimu e ne Hari te Babilunya si Ibil-Mirudak. Te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari din, impalihawang din e si Huwakin. Neyitabu seini te igkadaruwa ne pulu wey pitu (27) ne aldew te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne bulan. 28 In-upianan ni Ibil-Mirudak si Huwakin, wey imbehayan din te dakel ne katungdanan du te duma ne me Hari ne indakep degma wey in-uyan diye te Babilunya duma kandin. 29 Ne warad e migsaluub si Huwakin te kumbale din te pinirisu, wey eglagpu e sikandin te Hari ne egkeen tagse aldew. 30 Ne tagse aldew te manekal pad sikandin, egbehayan sikandin te Hari te Babilunya te langun ne ingkeilangan din.
